name: Azuga Trail Race

price_tiers.distance: Sorica Sunset Vertical iluminat de VARTA

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haiduk Paths Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The route passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses used by haiduks as refuges. It follows ancient paths used by the haiduks and offers the chance to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The route passes 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine terrain with bare rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient haiduk paths and hiking trails
additional: The route passes historic fortresses and natural landmarks. The race takes place in the last week of October, with variations in weather conditions and difficulty.

description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

description: The “Saturday Run” Half Marathon in Călărași is an iconic sporting event for the local community, bringing amateur and professional runners together in a friendly and motivating competition. The course takes place in Central Park, offering a pleasant and accessible experience for all participants. The atmosphere is supportive and welcoming, with amenities to ensure runners’ comfort, including tents for relaxation and first aid. The event promotes personal progress and sportsmanship, making it an excellent opportunity to socialize and test one’s endurance.
course_highlights: Course in Central Park (Parcul Mare) in Călărași
Metal tents for shelter and first aid provided by Expodom
Friendly atmosphere and mutual support among participants
additional: Participants can also run a 5 km race in Central Park, near Queen restaurant. Registration is confirmed by email after online payment via MobilPay (Netopia). The organizers offer a gift voucher for registration and provide tents for relaxation and first aid. The refund and returns policy is available on the website. The event includes a half marathon and a 5 km race, with registration and results available online, as well as gift options for participants.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: The Autumn Hiking Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreation event that brings runners together on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of distances, from ultra-extreme to introductory trails, suited to different fitness levels. The event takes place in Popovica, near Sremska Kamenica, offering a unique blend of challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers also provide transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: Ultra-Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Introductory trails with 1–2 ITRA points
additional: Transport from Novi Sad to the marathon start is organized for Saturday from 6:00. Registration is available for individuals and groups, as well as in “Sport” and “Fun” categories. Race packs are collected before the race. Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories. Terrain: forest and hilly paths. Registration is on the organizer’s website. The focus is on enjoying and promoting nature.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori 2026
description: The Autumn Hiking Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional competitive and recreational sporting event that brings together lovers of mountain running and nature. The races take place on challenging trails through the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora, with varying distances and levels of difficulty to suit different levels of participants. The event is known for its good organization, rich program, and support from numerous sponsors and friends of the marathon. Participants can expect challenging trails with significant climbs and descents, as well as unforgettable views of nature.
course_highlights: Trails pass through the forests and mountain peaks of Fruška Gora
Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points and Ultra Marathon with 4 ITRA points
Novice trails and a Trail of Joy and Enjoyment for less experienced runners
additional: Transportation from Novi Sad to the marathon start is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN trails is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are picked up immediately before the race. The trails are scored using the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories ranging from novice to Ultra Extreme Marathon. Participants can download GPX files of the routes, and the event is open to all healthy and physically capable people. The marathon takes place in autumn in the natural surroundings of Fruška Gora, with a special emphasis on enjoying nature and physical activity.

description: The 14th International Thessaloniki Night Half Marathon is a unique sporting event that combines athletics with the city’s nighttime party. Participants can enjoy a half-marathon route, as well as 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1-mile races, with full support and amenities. The event offers commemorative T-shirts, medals, electronic timing and energy support, creating a welcoming and lively atmosphere for all runners. It also promotes social responsibility and culture, strengthening the Thessaloniki community.
course_highlights: A night route through the city of Thessaloniki
Half-marathon, 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1-mile routes
Full support with water, isotonic drinks, energy drinks and medical cover
additional: Participation amenities include a commemorative technical T-shirt, race bib, electronic timing, commemorative medal, water, isotonic drink, juice, energy drink, non-alcoholic beer, savoury snack, cereal bar, banana, medical services and a certificate of participation through the official website. Group registration is available, with a €5 discount per person for groups of 10 or more. The team captain is responsible for collecting the equipment and representing the team. The event features parallel routes and activities, registration online and at offices, and age restrictions for certain races.

One Step Together Run 2026 – 1.500 μ. Διαδρομή Συμπερίληψης
Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of varying levels. The routes offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and trail runners to enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: 38 km with 1,100 m of elevation gain
26 km with 700 m of elevation gain
11 km with 330 m of elevation gain
additional: The event is associated with mountain running and hiking, and is expected to take place in October 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain race that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic nature trails and offers a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.
course_highlights: Mountain and sea landscapes
Part of the international Kom–Emine route
A range of distances from 4 to 50 km
additional: The event is scheduled for October 18, 2026, and includes various distances suitable for runners with different levels of fitness. The routes pass through scenic natural areas in Elenite.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race gives runners the opportunity to explore unspoiled nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes the combination of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the unspoiled nature of western Serbia
Varied terrain connecting mountains, rivers, and valleys
An authentic experience of nature and local culture
additional: West Serbia Trails is a series of trail races and hiking events that also includes races such as Divča Winter Trail, Jablanik Trail, Vidra Gradac Trail, and others. The races are known for their strong community, international ITRA points, and UTMB Index, motivating runners on an international level. The event is part of the Trail Liga Timova, a team competition scored based on kilometers completed, with the option to register early at a lower price.

description: Kamenica Trail 2026 is the first event in the Jug Trail Series. It takes place on October 18, 2026, at the Dabilo picnic area near Niš. The race offers two routes: a long course of 20.7 km with 810 meters of elevation gain and a short course of 5.6 km with 240 meters of elevation gain. Both start and finish at the same location. The routes pass along forest trails, gravel roads, and a section of paved road, offering a challenge and scenic views. The organizer is the Running club Niš Running and Mountaineering Association. Participants can expect good organization, refreshments, and prizes.
course_highlights: Forest trails and gravel roads, with around 450 meters on paved road
Long course: 20.7 km with 810 m of elevation gain
Short course: 5.6 km with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Race packets will be distributed in Niš on Saturday, October 17. Mandatory equipment includes a charged phone with the organizer’s number, at least half a liter of water, and your own cup or bottle (there will be no plastic cups at refreshment stations). A wind- and rain-resistant jacket is recommended. Timing is manual, with no chip. At the finish, there will be portable toilets, a shower cabin (hot water is not guaranteed), a sound system, and first aid. Refreshments will include water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and salty snacks. All finishers receive medals; prizes are awarded for overall and age-group placings. Parking is limited, so carpooling and arriving early are recommended. The race is the first event in the Jug Trail Series. The start and finish are at the Dabilo picnic area.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αρτας
organizer: Δήμος Αρταίων, ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ηπείρου, Σύλλογος Δρομέων Άρτας

description: The 10th Arta Half Marathon, “The Bridge Run,” is a running race held in the city of Arta, known for its rich history and important historical monuments. The half-marathon course passes by the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the famous Bridge of Arta, offering runners a unique experience. The race is certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS) and also includes city races and children’s races. The start and finish are at central locations in the city, enhancing the local character and festival atmosphere.
course_highlights: AIMS-certified course
Passes by the historic Bridge of Arta
Runs through important historical sites in the city
additional: The races on Sunday 18/10 start at the Gate of the Medieval Castle of Arta. The walking and children’s races take place on Saturday 17/10, starting from Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. All races finish at Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. Races are available for all ages, from children’s races to the half marathon and city races. Courses are certified by the Association of International Marathons, with a time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes. The event includes full medical coverage and electronic timing.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Τιμής και Μνήμης Ανδρών Ηρωικού Τάγματος Εθελοντών Κρητών
34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years, featuring half-marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race-walking tournament has also been held, attracting athletes from various towns in Bulgaria. The organizers, SCA “Spartak - Koynare,” ensure professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for the participation of Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a history spanning more than 30 years
Includes half-marathons, road races, and track meets
A race-walking tournament on a 1 km loop
additional: The race-walking tournament takes place on a 1 km loop. Athletes of various ages from different towns compete. Among the judges is Lyubomir Ivanov, the national record holder in the 20 km race walk. Full results and photos have been published on the event’s Facebook page. A race-walking tournament with participants from across Bulgaria, a 1 km course, held for the first time in Koynare’s history.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes race is an ultrarunning event held in the Krumovgrad area, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The courses pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments, such as Sheytan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the wilderness and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing and photographers, and participants can also run with pets. The use of reusable water bottles is encouraged.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheytan Dere
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
Pets are welcome, with water and treats available at the aid stations
additional: Course marking, medals, timing and photographers are provided. Participants can run with pets, with water and treats available for them at the aid stations. Reusable water bottles or cups are recommended to reduce plastic use. Courses: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious competition that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for challenging races in a natural and demanding setting. The event offers young and experienced runners the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment is used, with live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24. The race will take place in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG. The course is in the area around the town.

description: The Craiova Half Marathon is a community-focused fundraising running event organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event offers timed races for competitive runners over distances of 21 km, 14 km, and 7 km, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including wheelchair users and pets. The urban course starts and finishes at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade and consists of 7 km loops, with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participation supports charitable projects in education, health, and social inclusion, making the event an opportunity for solidarity and community involvement.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race, and 1 for the 7 km race
58 metres of elevation gain, with hydration and medical assistance points along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall from October 10–16 and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade between 08:30 and 09:30. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include security personnel, volunteers, an ambulance with a doctor, and first-aid points. The event has a charitable component, supporting social and educational causes. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and registration is announced as open until October 10, 2026.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Fruška Gora - Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running abilities. Participants can choose courses from 1 km to 22 km, enjoying well-marked terrain and support from volunteers. The race offers electronic timing, medals, promotional T-shirts, as well as refreshments and a meal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with an emphasis on community and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with support from volunteers and spectators
Electronic timing and GPX files available for navigation
additional: Starts are assigned in groups according to registration dates, with no option to change groups. Participants receive a medal, promotional T-shirt, race photos, water, juice, and energy drinks, as well as a meal after the race. Medical assistance is available in case of injury. Trail race, electronic timing, GPX route files available, post-race gathering

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The 22.4 km race, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, runs through forested terrain, technically challenging rocky sections and over two Kablar peaks, offering runners a challenge and beautiful panoramic views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is part of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national series and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club of Čačak, which is celebrating its 75th anniversary this year and guarantees good organisation and safety during the race.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica and Debela Gora
additional: The race is certified and awards 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series and 5 hours for others. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The organiser provides clear course marking and safety on the route. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

name: Timișoara City Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara, offering races over a range of distances from 1 km to the full marathon of 42 km. The event promotes freedom and community spirit, inviting runners of all levels to take part and push their limits. With a strong tradition and dedicated training programs, the marathon is a motivating and energizing experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 1 km, 4 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km
Event held in Timișoara, with urban courses
A strong community and personalized training programs
additional: Training programs are available for all the main distances (5 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km), created by an experienced university coach. The event includes free children’s races over short distances. Relay races are also available for the marathon and half marathon. Participants can benefit from marathon training programs, including plans for beginners and intermediate runners, as well as advice on equipment and physical preparation.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

name: 1ος Συμμετοχικός Αγώνας Δρόμου στο Παραποτάμιο Πάρκο Άρτας
Imittos Epic
description: The Imittos Epic is a demanding mountain race for experienced trail runners, featuring technical, rocky terrain. The route starts in the area of Agios Georgios Koutalas and includes uphill and downhill trails, passes by historic sites such as Kaisariani Monastery, and has two strict time cutoffs at checkpoints. The race requires good race management and support, as the mountain is busy and some sections of the route are exposed. The organizers provide chip timing and commemorative medals for finishers.
course_highlights: Technical, rocky terrain with exposed sections where there is no margin for a fall
Passes by Kaisariani Monastery and trails with significant elevation gain (1,220 m)
Two strict cutoffs at checkpoints CP4 (13.5 km) and CP6 (17.5 km)
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from October 21 to 24 and on race morning. A commemorative T-shirt can be ordered until September 30. The race has cutoffs at two checkpoints (CP4 and CP6). Awards are presented immediately after the winners finish. Registration is canceled if payment is not made within 5 business days. Refunds are issued with deductions depending on the cancellation date. The race includes difficult technical routes, GPS and Garmin route files, and approaches the environment with respect and a commitment to sustainability.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race features three courses of different lengths and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All courses are well marked and pass through beautiful natural scenery. This event is more than just a race; it is a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a comprehensive race package and on-course support. The start is scheduled for October 31, 2026, with time limits tailored to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different lengths: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a race-logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, aid stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.

name: South Olympus Forest Trail
description: The South Olympus Forest Trail 54 km race starts from the village square in Palios Panteleimonas, Pieria, and traverses trails with gentle slopes and impressive views. The route includes uphill and downhill sections, with a total ascent of approximately 2,000 metres, passing through natural landscapes such as Lake Kati and the village of Palia Pori. There are several aid stations and strict equipment requirements due to the season. The race offers a challenging yet enchanting experience on forest trails and in the mountainous landscapes of Olympus.
course_highlights: 930 m ascent in the first 8.5 km, with views of Lake Kati
Route with approximately +2,000 m of total elevation gain
Views of the Thessalian Plain, the peaks of Olympus, and the Aegean Sea
additional: Mandatory equipment due to the season. Aid stations at kilometres 9, 17, 28, 36, and 46. Cut-off points at 17 km (3:30 hours) and 36 km (8:30 hours). The event also includes 10-kilometre routes, and takes place in October 2026. Detailed information is available about registration and the required equipment.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

description: The 11th Panagia Merenta Popular Road Race is organized by the Parish of the Holy Metropolitan Church of St. John in Markopoulo. It is an annual sporting event that attracts runners from the Attica region. The race follows a beautiful route in Markopoulo, Attica, offering an enjoyable running experience for all participants. The event has a long tradition and aims to promote sports and community participation.
course_highlights: Route in Markopoulo, Attica
Organized start and finish in the central square
Friendly environment for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes a road race and activities for children and teenagers, aiming to promote sports and social cohesion in the area.

price_range: δωρεάν για μαθητές, 10€ για 10 χλμ., 5€ για 5 χλμ.
description: The I Run for Korinos race is an established sporting event held in the Korinos area of Katerini. It promotes positive energy and smiles, inviting runners of all ages to take part in a celebration of sport and community. The race offers an opportunity for physical activity in a beautiful natural setting, while supporting the local community and sport. The organizers ensure accessibility and comfort for all participants.
course_highlights: Route in Korinos, Katerini
Natural surroundings with beautiful scenery
Established local race with a positive atmosphere
additional: Registration is available online or by email, and race numbers can be collected one hour before the race. The event is supported by the Central Macedonia Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS).

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
organizer: Балканска атлетика (АБАФ), атлетически клуб „Спартак“ – Койнаре, община Червен бряг
description: The 2026 Balkan Cross Country Championships will be held in Koynare, Bulgaria, on November 7. The event is organized by the local Spartak-Koynare Athletics Club in cooperation with the town hall, Cherven Bryag Municipality, and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The course is designed around the stadium and the athletics club buildings, near the town center, and will welcome more than 600 athletes and guests. Koynare is an established host of running competitions, with a long-standing tradition and experience in organizing sporting events.
course_highlights: The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings in the center of Koynare
Several luxury hotels are available within a 20 km radius
Koynare has actively organized running events for more than 30 years
additional: More than 600 athletes, team representatives, referees, organizers, and fans are expected to attend. The event is part of the sports calendar of Balkan Athletics and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. In late October 2026, Koynare will also host the national cross country championships as preparation for the Balkan Championships. The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings, and hotels within a 20 km radius can accommodate more than 600 participants and guests.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
distance_verbose: 35 km, 35 km, 25 km, 25 km, 10 km, 10 km
description: First Rifle Trail is a mountain running event in Koprivshtitsa that brings together sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy beautiful autumn views, historic sites, and the atmosphere of the old town. The 25 km and 35 km distances are part of the international UTMB Index network, offering the opportunity to take part in the World Series.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in Koprivshtitsa. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance. Children under 13 may take part in the 10 km distance only with an accompanying adult. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be run in the opposite direction. The cutoff time for 25 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes, and for 35 km it is 6 hours and 30 minutes.

description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, taking place on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historic landscapes with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is for both amateur and professional runners, promoting outdoor activity and a passion for mountain running. Participants can choose from three different races, each with its own challenges and attractions.
course_highlights: Routes on the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Marked routes through forests, along forest roads, and through historic areas with traces of Dacian and Roman history
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, a medal for participants who finish within the specified time, refreshment points and support along the route, isotonic drinks at the start/finish and along the route, race results and an electronic certificate, and filming and audio/video editing. The Half Marathon and Marathon routes are for participants over 18, while Fun Run is also open to children aged 8 to 17, who must be accompanied by a parent registered for the same race. Routes of 3 km, 7.5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km; a mountain running event in nature; the 2026 event is scheduled for November 7.

name: 43ος Αυθεντικός Μαραθώνιος
organizer: ΣΕΓΑΣ (Σύνδεσμος Γραμμάτων και Τεχνών) και Μαραθώνιος Αθήνας
description: The 43rd Athens Authentic Marathon, taking place on November 8, 2026, is a historic and iconic road-running event that honors the classic route from Marathon to Athens. The event includes the Marathon, as well as accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race for students, and a 1,200 m children’s race. It offers a unique experience for runners of all levels, with a rich program of events and support. The city of Marathon, with its natural beauty, is an important part of the route and the race’s history.
course_highlights: Historic route from Marathon to Athens
Accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race, and a 1,200 m children’s race
The natural and historic landscape of the city of Marathon
additional: The Marathon includes accompanying events such as Authentic Talks and the Allwyn Marathon Expo. A volunteer program and a runner service center are available at the Faliro Olympic Complex. Race bibs and materials can be collected at the Faliro Indoor Hall (Tae Kwon Do). The races begin with the children’s race at 16:00, the 5 km race at 17:00, the 5 km night race for students at 20:00, and the Marathon at 08:30 on November 8, 2026. The event includes races of 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1,200 m for children, as well as events, volunteer opportunities, and online registration. There is also an accompanying 5 km night race for school students.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the largest classic races in the RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The event offers a unique experience in nature, with varied courses suited to different levels of runners. The routes follow scenic trails and offer challenges that will appeal to both recreational and experienced runners. Organized by Trail Series, the race is part of a seasonal series that brings together runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of the village of German
Scenic trails and varied terrain
Suitable for different levels of runners
additional: The event takes place on 8 November 2026, from 11:00 to 15:00, in the village of German. The organizer is Trail Series. Google Maps directions to the location are available. No specific prices or registration categories have been published on the pages at this time. A trail race on varied terrain, including asphalt and trails; registration details are not specified.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

name: 2ος Δρόμος Υγείας «Αγιος Δημήτριος – Στα Μονοπάτια των Ορυζώνων»
4o Γίδι των Μεθάνων
description: The 4th Methana Goat is a mountain race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Troizinia–Methana, with the participation of the Argolis Hellenic Rescue Team. It is a challenging course offering unique mountain-running experiences in a volcanic landscape of great natural beauty. The race is a celebration for lovers of the mountains and adventure, attracting runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The organizers emphasize the safety and support of participants throughout the race.
course_highlights: The volcanic landscape of Methana
Routes with steep climbs and natural beauty
Extensive views of the sea and mountains
additional: The race includes 28 km and 12 km routes, with elevation gains of up to +1720 m and +680 m, respectively, and offers cultural and entertainment events. The area is known for its thermal baths and unique natural landscape.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

description: The 1st Nafpaktos Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new road race that combines sport with Greece’s cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event also includes a 1 km race for children and a 5 km race for amateur runners and people with disabilities, promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants receive full support, electronic timing, and commemorative gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participant amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic certificate, medical support, bag-drop and changing facilities, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1 km children’s race, with impressive routes through natural and historic landscapes. Participation promotes health and the area’s cultural identity.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Methana GOAT is an annual mountain running race held in autumn on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers courses of 28 km with 1,720 m of elevation gain, 12 km with 680 m, and 5 km with 120 m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge across rugged volcanic terrain. The race stands out for its constantly changing scenery, views of the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep climbs
Frequent views of the sea from high mountain passes
Beautiful landscapes with changing natural surroundings
additional: Courses: 28 km (+1,720 m), 12 km (+680 m), and 5 km (+120 m). The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registration via the official website; scheduled for November 22–23, 2025.

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

description: The International Olympia Marathon is a historic road race held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic “Sacred Way,” following a route rich in cultural memory and sporting ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children’s race, offering a unique sporting experience for everyone. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square in Ancient Olympia, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic “Sacred Way” of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometre markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Runner benefits: race bib with electronic timing chip, commemorative medal and T-shirt, and water, isotonic drink, energy drink, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drink, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory to participate. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall, as well as portable toilets along the course. Runners must keep to the right side of the road. The event welcomes participants from around the world and features celebrations and awards, with an emphasis on cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a landmark event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail-running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. Now in its 9th edition, the main Ultra 50k race is a favorite among trail runners for the challenge and beauty of its course, which includes forests and spectacular climbs and descents. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-stocked aid stations and personalized finisher medals. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: A 50 km course with climbs and descents through the forests around Cluj
Checkpoints and hydration stations offering a variety of refreshments (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweets, and savory food)
Views above Cluj-Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, the Poarta de su’ Feleac Museum, and the Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a personalized finisher medal, and access to aid stations serving sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and fruit. There are children’s races and team races with special rules on the spacing between members. Cut-off times: 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various historical regions of Romania and enjoy varied routes, from trail to cross-country, with registration open and early-bird prices available.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

name: Deliblatska Peščara 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Za prijavu je potrebna uplata akontacije u iznosu od 1000 din.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelikon Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race, organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Telmissos Nea Makri Marathon Runners’ Association in collaboration with the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association. The route follows forest trails, starting at Agia Marina in Nea Makri. The race aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Despite recent fire damage, Mount Pentelikon retains its remarkable beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to efforts to restore the mountains.
course_highlights: A 12 km mountain route on forest trails
Start at Agia Marina in Nea Makri
An area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 a.m. The event aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes by S.E.D.M. (Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association) and follows a trail through a forest that suffered a fire in August 2024. The event includes competitive and volunteer participation, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and promoting mountain running.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

name: SNF Run: First Run
location: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center, Kallithea, Athens, Greece
description: SNF FIRST RUN is an annual charity road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation every New Year’s Day at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center in Kallithea, Athens. The race offers a unique experience combining giving and sport, supporting social causes. The course is different each year, offering participants a distinctive route. The race starts in the first minutes of the new year, creating a lively and festive atmosphere for runners.
course_highlights: Route at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center
Starts in the first minutes of New Year’s Day
Charitable event supporting social causes
additional: The race takes place every year on January 1, starting at 00:04. It is an evening road race with a charitable purpose. No information about prices or registration was found, as places are full and registration has closed. The race is accompanied by events such as a party with live music and fireworks, and is part of the area’s holiday celebrations.

name: 27ος Αγώνας Αλσους Δαφνίου
description: The 27th Daphni Grove Race is a traditional 10-kilometer road race held in Daphni Grove. The course starts on Athens Avenue and passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite, offering a route away from the city noise with beautiful views of the Thriasian Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgats zonas and is a celebration for runners, with traditional hospitality and electronic timing. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their race numbers, and there is a place to store their belongings.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Daphni Grove
Passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite
Views of the Thriasian Gulf, away from the city noise
additional: The start is on Athens Avenue, near Daphni Hospital. Athletes must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their race numbers from the registration desk. Electronic timing and baggage storage are available. It is recommended that participants leave their cars at the end of Iera Odos, near Daphni Monastery, to avoid congestion. Electronic timing and baggage storage are provided. Race-number pickup takes place before the start; arriving at least one hour early is recommended.

name: 13ο Pilabox Trail Race
description: The Pilabox Trail Race is a mountain race held on Mount Penteli, offering a unique experience in a natural setting. There are two routes, a short 6-kilometer course and a long course of about 13 kilometers, with a shared start at the playground on Dionysou Avenue in Palia Penteli. The race is organized by the PILABOX-PILABAR venue, which combines fitness and healthy eating to create a complete athletic and social experience. The event has a long tradition and is an important occasion for trail-running enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain on Mount Penteli
Two routes: 6.0 km and 13.2 km
Shared start at the playground on Dionysou Avenue, Palia Penteli
additional: Start Pack pickup takes place on designated days before the race at PILABAR in Chalandri. The race is accompanied by social events such as a Pasta Party. The event emphasizes healthy eating and fitness, offering a complete experience. The race includes electronic timing, a medal, gifts, water stations, a recovery meal, photos and a DJ, with 6 km and 14 km routes.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: 7ος Βυζαντινός Αγώνας
organizer: Δήμος Μεγαρέων και Αντιδημαρχία Αθλητισμού & Νέας Γενιάς, σε συνεργασία με τους Αθηναίους Δρομείς, τον Απόλλωνα Δυτικής Αττικής και τους Δρομείς Μεγάρων «Ο Όρσιππος»
description: The 7th Byzantine 50-Kilometer Road Race is an ultradistance race held in Megara, starting and finishing at Vasilissa Frederikis Square. The course is entirely paved and passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, wooded sections, and the Alepochori–Dourakou beach, offering a unique experience of the area’s natural surroundings. The race has a charitable purpose and is intended for runners with marathon experience. The event honors the memory of Georgios Panos and promotes running and ultradistance racing.
course_highlights: A 49,600-meter course that is entirely paved
Passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and forests
Approximately 5 kilometers along Alepochori–Dourakou beach
additional: Race-day registration opens at 07:00 and closes at 08:30. The race has a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshment stations are located every 5 km, and medical support is provided. Timing is done using an electronic RFID chip. Participants may donate non-perishable food for charity before the start. The announcement for the 7th event specifies refreshment stations every 5 km, medical support, electronic timing with an RFID chip, and a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. The published details are for the event on January 18, 2026.

name: 10ο Λέβαδος Mountain Trail
description: The 10th Levados Mountain Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Livadeia, Boeotia. It features two courses, 24.2 km and 10.7 km, with substantial elevation gain, offering runners unique moments amid the area’s natural beauty. The start and finish are at the Erkyna Springs, with routes that include trails, forest roads, and pedestrian paths. The race serves as a qualifying event for participation in the Olympus Marathon and is organized by the Livadeia Athletic Swimming Club (A.K.O.L.).
course_highlights: 24.2 km course with 1,530 m of positive elevation gain
10.7 km course with 650 m of positive elevation gain
Start and finish at the Erkyna Springs (elevation 179 m)
additional: The routes are marked with metal signs, signs bearing the letter Λ and yellow-blue markings, as well as course tape. A sweeper carrying fluids, food, and medical supplies follows the last runner. The race starts and finishes at the same location, at the Erkyna Springs area (KRYA). The race program includes courses with technical challenges and impressive views; announcements and participation details are expected soon. The event also includes traditional gifts for participants.

name: 10ο Veikou Trail

price_tiers.distance: Veikou Skull Trail Relay 20 χλμ (2 X 10χλμ)

description: The 10th Veikou Trail is a mountain running race held around and through Veikou Grove in Galatsi, offering a unique running experience within the city. The courses include trails, forest roads and varied gradients, with views of the city and Mount Hymettus. The race is aimed primarily at experienced mountain runners and crosses the boundaries of three municipalities, showcasing an area of particular natural beauty and historical interest.
course_highlights: Routes through the old LATO quarries, with their lunar landscape
Trails, forest roads and steps with varied gradients
Views of the city and Mount Hymettus
additional: All routes start and finish at the Galatsi Municipal Stadium inside Veikou Grove. A 20 km relay race (2 x 10 km) is available. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Galatsi and co-organized by MYSPORTEVENT. It includes a technical T-shirt and a multifunctional neck gaiter, with the start and finish at Galatsi Municipal Stadium, and takes place on natural trails and the mountain of Galatsi.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αιγιαλείας
location: Aigio Seafront near the Old Port, Aigio, Aigialeia, Greece
description: The 14th Aigialeia Half Marathon is organized by the Aigio Sports Club “Athinodoros the Aegian,” with the support of the Municipality of Aigialeia’s Deputy Mayor’s Office for Culture and Sports. The race takes place on Aigio beach, near the old port, on a nearly entirely paved and flat course with minimal elevation change. The course starts on the beach and heads toward the community of Nikolaeika, continuing through local communities and seaside villages along the old railway line as far as Stafidala, before finishing back on Aigio beach.
course_highlights: Nearly entirely paved course
Flat course with minimal elevation change
Passes through local communities and seaside villages along an old railway line
additional: Parallel 5 km and 1.5 km races follow similarly flat, paved routes. The finish is on Aigio beach, near the 12 Fountains and the historic plane tree of Pausanias. The available information concerns the 2026 event and also mentions 5 km and 1,500 m races. Details of the 2027 event have not yet been confirmed.

name: 2ο Kanalaki Run
description: The 2nd Kanalaki Run is organized by the Municipality of Parga to promote mass participation in sport and showcase the area. The race starts from Kanalaki Central Square and includes four different routes for runners of all ages and levels. The event offers an enjoyable running experience amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Epirus.
course_highlights: Starts from Kanalaki Central Square
Four routes: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km (running/power walking), and a 1000 m children’s race
Routes suitable for runners of all ages and levels
additional: Registration opens on Friday, 31/10/2025. A 1000-meter children’s race is available. An announcement about volunteers is expected. Registration opens from 31/10/2025. The event promotes the local culture and natural environment of the area.

name: 15ος Ημιμαραθώνιος «Ιωάννης Καποδίστριας»

description: The 15th “Ioannis Kapodistrias” Half Marathon in Aegina is a historic road race honoring the first governor of modern Greece. The event features races of 21.1 kilometers, 10,000 meters, 3,000 meters for walkers, and children’s races, offering a celebration for runners of all ages and abilities. The event takes place in central Aegina and combines sport with cultural heritage, attracting a large number of participants each year. The longer-distance races start in the morning, while the shorter races start earlier, creating a wonderful sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: 21.1-kilometer half marathon in central Aegina
Children’s races of 200m, 500m, and 1,000m for all ages
3,000m route for walkers and a 10,000m road race
additional: Awards ceremonies take place at 11:00 for the children’s races and at 13:45 for the other races. Age categories are offered for the half marathon and the 10,000-meter race: 18–39, 40–59, and 60+ years. Participants in the longer races must be at least 18 for the half marathon and 16 for the 10,000-meter race. Middle and high school students may also participate in the 3,000m race, under their parents’ responsibility. All participants receive finisher medals, and the top three in each category receive trophies. For the 2026 event, water stations every 2,500 m and isotonic drinks along the half marathon route are listed. Prices and benefits for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering runners of all levels the chance to enjoy mountain running and nature. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, more technical course and a shorter one for beginners. The series has become an established fixture in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with support from Salomon, which invites runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses at each race: a long course (10–12 km) and a short course (4–7 km), both with significant elevation gain
Natural scenery and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Four pairs of Salomon shoes are drawn at each race. There are individual and team rankings for the long distance. Teams consist of 3 people, and the top three teams receive awards. In a recent edition, the race in Penteli started from Semelis Square. The event provided a race number with a timing chip, water stations, snacks at the finish, a commemorative certificate and medical coverage.
