name: Витоша Ски и Дъски
location: Aleko Hut, Vitosha Nature Park, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Ski and Board is an event organized by the Sofia Mountain Club Association, held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut. The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

description: The TSIGGLA Trail Run takes place in Tsigla Forest near Didymoteicho, offering a unique running experience in a natural setting on the borders of Europe. The event includes an 8-kilometre training route through the forest, suitable for runners of all levels. It coincides with the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere. The race is an alternative sporting get-together with a strong local character and tradition.
course_highlights: 8 km training route in Tsigla Forest
Natural setting near the Greece–Turkey border
Recreation area and forest trail
additional: The event includes the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners and is an excursion-style meeting for athletes. The route is intended for training and takes place in the recreation area of Tsigla Forest. The race is held in early February and also includes related events and activities in the Didymoteicho area.

name: 7ο Atlas Trail Running
description: Experience mountain running at the Atlas Trail Running race in the Malakasa area of Attica. The race offers four routes: 34Km, 24Km, 11Km and 6Km, featuring a variety of technical sections, forest roads and trails through scenic, lush green landscapes. During the race, you will pass two chapels: Prophet Elias and Saint Mercurius. Some mountain-race experience is required, and suitable shoes and a hydration vessel are mandatory.
course_highlights: 60% forest roads and 40% trails
The scenic, lush green landscape of Malakasa
Two chapels along the route (Prophet Elias, Saint Mercurius)

Sponsors RUN N TRAIL - BETTER PEOPLE provide a 500ml water flask. The largest team is awarded. The announcement for the previous event recommends experience in mountain races and requires suitable mountain shoes and a hydration vessel. It included timing, a medal and a 500 ml flask.

name: 49ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Υγείας Αθήνας 21 χλμ.
location: Ολυμπιακό Κωπηλατοδρόμιο Σχοινιά, Μαραθώνας, Αττική, Greece
description: The 49th Athens Health Run 21 km is organized by the Athens Health Runners Association and takes place at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre. Since 1978, the race has promoted popular mass participation in sport and running, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The course is paved, completely flat, and loops around the rowing course, offering an enjoyable and fast experience. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, with technical support provided by MyRace.
course_highlights: Paved and completely flat course
Four laps around the water course at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Participants receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Medical support is available, along with the option to print a commemorative certificate showing the participant’s name and result. Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:30 to 09:00. The race has a 3-hour time limit. The top three men and women overall and the winners of the age categories receive awards. Supporters provide energy gels, natural mineral water, and bananas at the finish. 21.1 km course, 600-participant limit, online registration, race pack with chip and medal, water stations, live results, medical support

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: The Gentiki Trail is a mountain race held in the Gentiki area of Larissa. The 21-kilometer course follows marked trails and has a positive elevation gain of +1370 meters, offering a challenging and exciting experience for mountain runners. There is also a shorter 5.1-kilometer course with a positive elevation gain of +250 meters, ideal for those looking for a shorter challenge. The race is a qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon, attracting runners seeking a high level of competition and natural beauty.
course_highlights: 21 km course on marked trails with +1370 m elevation gain
Shorter 5.1 km course with +250 m elevation gain
The race is a qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon
additional: Participant limits: 200 for the 21 km course and 150 for the 5.1 km course. The 21 km race starts at 10:00 and the 5.1 km race at 10:30. Contact Apostolos Goulas at 6932752733. The race is organized by the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Association. The race includes online registration, water and light refreshments, with participant limits of 200 for the longer course and 150 for the shorter course.

name: 2ος Αγώνας για την Πανελλήνια Ημέρα Φιλάθλου
description: The 2nd road race for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day, “In the Name of Alkis,” is organized by the February 1, 2022 Structure, a non-profit association run by volunteers. The race aims to honor the memory of Alkis Kampanos and promote the message that sport unites and does not kill. Participants run wearing the jerseys and colors they love on a route that passes through central parts of Thessaloniki, giving the whole community the opportunity to take part. The event includes 5 km and 1 km races for younger runners.
course_highlights: 5 km route from the intersection of Alexandrou Papanastasiou and Nikolaou Plastira streets toward the Music Hall and the New Waterfront
Finish at the Statue of Alexander the Great
1 km route along the New Waterfront, in front of the “Garden of Sand” (AVENUE)
additional: All participants wear race number 19. The race is dedicated to Panhellenic Sports Fans Day and the memory of Alkis Kampanos. Volunteers can also take part. The first person to register for the 5 km race is a member of the Structure who lives in Munich and will travel to Thessaloniki to run. The routes start at locations in the city of Thessaloniki, and the event also includes social initiatives such as food collection and the inclusion of people with disabilities. Participation is open to everyone, and the event promotes unity through sport and social awareness.

name: 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης
description: The 5th Love Half Marathon in Mytilene will take place over the weekend of February 14 and 15, 2026, offering a rich program of sporting and cultural events. On Saturday, races start in the Tsamakia area, with distances of 1,000 m, 2,500 m, Family Running 2,500 m, and 5,000 m for various age categories. On Sunday, athletes gather in the city center for the 10-kilometer race and the 21-kilometer half marathon. The event has become an important occasion for the city of Mytilene.
course_highlights: Races in the seaside Tsamakia area, in front of the EOT beach
A variety of distances from 1,000 m to 21 kilometers
Races in the city center, with traffic closures to ensure they run smoothly
additional: Saturday’s races start at 12:00 in the Tsamakia area, with traffic closed for approximately 4 hours. On Sunday, athletes arrive at 07:00, and the races start at 09:00 in the city center. There are categories for all ages and a family run. The event includes multiple courses, activities for all ages, and participation packages with special gifts and benefits.

name: 10ο MaskaRun
description: The sporting celebration in Orchomenos, Boeotia, on Sunday, February 15, 2026, brings together the 10th anniversary MaskaRun, the 1st «Asopichos» 5 km Road Race, and events for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day. The event is a major celebration of sport, remembrance, and humanity, with free participation for everyone. Orchomenos Central Square will be the hub of the festivities, which will also include a handball demonstration and prize draws for children. MaskaRun has become an established event with mass participation, and this year it is joined by the certified «Asopichos» 5 km race course, with official timing.
course_highlights: 10th anniversary MaskaRun route through Orchomenos
New certified «Asopichos» 5 km race course with timing
Events at Central Square featuring sporting and community activities
additional: Participation in MaskaRun and the Asopichos road race is free for everyone. The program includes a handball demonstration and activities, as well as prize draws for children. Commemorative medals will be awarded at the end of the event. The program includes the «Asopichos» 5 km race, celebrations for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day, and various sporting activities. Participation is free.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: The 11th Lycabettus Run is a distinctive road race held on the green Lycabettus Hill in Athens. The routes include paved and dirt roads, offering a unique running experience in nature with views of the city. The race includes individual and team categories, with morning starts and full support for runners. The event provides medals, cups, digital certificates, medical coverage, and water stations.
course_highlights: A paved circular route around Lycabettus Hill
A dirt route reaching the hilltop
Routes with multiple laps depending on the distance (5.5 km, 9 km, 11 km)
additional: The routes are circular, with the start and finish at the St George Lycabettus Hotel. There are two water stations with bottled water. Electronic timing is provided with a single-use chip. Medical coverage includes an ambulance and first aid provided by the Samaritans Volunteer Corps. Participants receive a finisher’s medal, cups for the top finishers in each category, and a digital participation certificate. A technical T-shirt is provided. Registration requires age verification and parental consent for minors. The race includes medals, trophies, digital certificates, and electronic timing.

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
location: Δημοτικό Στάδιο Βύρωνα, Βύρωνας, Attica, Greece
description: The Niki Vyronas Training Meeting is organized by the Niki Vyronas Gymnastics Club, based at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. Founded in 2005, the club offers specialized guidance from experienced coaches with outstanding athletic achievements. The meeting aims to promote track and field and improve quality of life through exercise. It offers athletes and sports enthusiasts an opportunity to experience the joy of athletics in a friendly, well-organized environment.
course_highlights: Held at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium
Specialized guidance from physical education teachers and former high-performing athletes
Promotes track and field and exercise for all ages
additional: The club office is open in the afternoons from 17:00 to 20:00. The club offers groups for all ages, from preschool children to adults, with training sessions at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. There is an emphasis on training for road and mountain runners. The event includes training activities and the 6th Vyronas Municipality Road Race, offering a comprehensive experience for athletes and coaches.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 is a popular winter trail-running series in the mountains of Attica, offering new racing experiences for runners of all levels. It consists of three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, each with two routes: a longer, technical and demanding route, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The event aims to connect runners with nature and showcase the beauty of mountain running in Attica. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with Salomon as the title sponsor.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha
Two routes per race: Long (10–12 km) and Short (4–7 km)
Natural beauty and technical trails with significant elevation gain
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in the overall standings are awarded in both distances. Age categories are offered only in the Long Distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. A draw is held for four lucky participants to win Salomon shoes. There are individual and team standings in the Long Distance. The Long Distance starts at 10:00 and the Short Distance at 10:15. Trail races in Hymettus, categories for different distances and age groups, team competitions, medals, prizes, and race amenities.

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Run is a special sporting event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The race offers two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads, both fully marked. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, which is refunded on race day. The money collected from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. There is no electronic timing or awards, as all participants are considered winners and receive a mug as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads
Full course marking and water stations along the route
Held in the natural setting of the former Varympompi forest (Tatoi Estate)
additional: There is no electronic timing or awards. Every participant receives a mug, possibly featuring a personal photo. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, refunded on race day. The money from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. Water stations are available along the route. Routes of 14.5 km and 6.3 km on forest trails and paved roads; no electronic timing; participation with a €10 deposit; a mug with a personal photo as a prize; charitable support for the orphanage.

name: 10ος Δρόμος Αξιών
location: Ιερός Ναός Ζωοδόχου Πηγής, Κεφαλάρι Αργολίδας, Αργολίδα, Greece
description: The 10th Road of Values, organized by the 1st Argos Scout Group, is a running race dedicated to the universal values of life. The race is held on February 22, on the occasion of Scout Thinking Day, and honors the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakides. The start and finish are at Kefalari, Argos, at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a special experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting and finishing at Kefalari, Argos
650-meter children's race at the same location
Special tribute to Stelios Kyriakides and universal values
additional: The event includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The event has a long tradition and is associated with Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural setting, starting and finishing at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes a 650-meter children's race.

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
location: Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour, Alepochori, Attica, Greece
description: The 18th Clean Monday Road Race is a traditional 10,000-meter race held in Alepochori, Attica, starting and finishing at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior. The course is uneven, dirt, and marked, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all levels. There is also a 300-meter children’s race and a carnival costume and dance contest. After the race, a celebration follows with music, wine, and traditional Lenten dishes, creating a festive atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Uneven dirt course
Start and finish at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior
Marked course and water provided
additional: The 10,000-meter race is limited to 250 athletes. Registration is by telephone only. A bus is available for €10, departing from Metaxourgeio (Karaiskaki Square) at 8:00. After the race, participants receive a handmade commemorative medal; trophies and prizes are awarded for the children’s race and costume contest. The post-race celebration features a DJ, dancing, wine, and a picnic with traditional Lenten dishes. For the 18th edition, the limit is stated as 250 participants in the 10 km race, with telephone registration. A bus from Athens is available for a €10 fare. The announced date for the 18th edition is February 23, 2026, different from the date of March 1, 2027, provided in the metadata.

description: The 2nd Spetses Mountain Run “Sotirios Anargyros” is a mountain race held on Spetses, aiming to promote sport and fair play and showcase the trails of the pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea. The event includes 26 km and 10 km courses, as well as a children’s walk, offering a unique experience for athletes and visitors. The event is supported by the Municipality of Spetses and the AKSS Foundation, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and promoting local products.
course_highlights: Trails on a pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea
26 km and 10 km courses in a natural setting
Children’s walk on the grounds of the AKSS Foundation
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. on the previous day at the TITANIA cinema, where the technical briefing and athletes’ meal also take place. On race day, registration is open from 08:30 to 09:45 a.m. After the race, awards are presented at 3:00 p.m., followed by a farewell celebration with local delicacies. The available information concerns the 2026 edition and does not yet confirm the date of March 20, 2027.

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The 5th Koumaria Trail Series is organized by the Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” and offers a challenging off-road course through the mountainous natural surroundings of Petrotó, Achaia. The event includes 40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes, with many runners and volunteers, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The race is marked by strong competition, as well as support and assistance for runners at aid stations. The event honors tradition and the beauty of nature while promoting sport and well-being.
course_highlights: Challenging off-road mountain terrain
40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes
Aid stations in the mountain village of Petrotó
additional: The Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” operates aid stations and assists approximately 600 mountain runners with the help of volunteers. The race is a major organizational success and also honors athletes with personal records. Technical off-road terrain, participation and volunteer involvement, major organizational success, and support activities.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: 2ο Ελάτεια Historic Trail
organizer: Ορειβατικός, Φυσιολατρικός Σύλλογος Ελάτειας και ο Σύλλογος Νεολαίας Ελάτειας
description: The 2nd Historic Trail Elateia is a mountain running event offering three routes of varying distances and difficulty, set in a beautiful natural and historical environment. The course starts from Elateia’s central square and runs along trails, forest roads, and archaeological sites, offering unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is also suitable for runners with little experience in mountain running, with full course marking and aid stations. The event is known for its excellent organization, volunteer support, and involvement of the local community.
course_highlights: Start from Elateia’s central square at an elevation of 180 m
Pass archaeological sites and the chapel of Agios Athanasios
Views of the Maliakos Gulf and the mountains of Kallidromo, Parnassos, Giona, Oiti, and Vardousia
additional: The race starts from Elateia’s central square. There are three routes: 21.2 km, 12.6 km, and 6.2 km. Electronic timing is provided by CHRONOLOG. There are three aid stations. All finishers receive a medal. Payments are accepted by card only. Refunds are available up to 10 days before the race, subject to a small fee. The middle-distance route has a cut-off time of 2 hours 30 minutes. The event also includes 1 km routes for children, aiming to raise awareness and encourage the participation of the whole family. The routes are specially marked and organized with respect for the environment and the local community.

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The “MARATHON - I Run in Marathon” road race is a flat 6.8-kilometer race held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade. It is aimed at experienced runners and athletes over the age of 15, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central small harbor of Nea Makri, with the race starting at 16:30. The event provides hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat 6.8 km route by the sea
Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade
Start and finish at the central small harbor of Nea Makri
additional: The entry package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. Stations provide bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweet snacks, and savory snacks. Participation is open to people over the age of 15, with parental consent required for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes of approximately 8.2 km, participation open to all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snacks provided during and after the race.

name: 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run
description: The 14th Hortiatis Trail Run is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association and takes place on Mount Hortiatis in Thessaloniki. The race aims to introduce runners to Hortiatis’s mountain environment, help them become familiar with the challenges of trail running, and promote the protection of the natural environment. The event is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis and promotes exercise, sports education, and social responsibility. It is a mountain race that combines natural beauty with an athletic challenge, ideal for runners who love the mountains and nature.
course_highlights: Trail running on Mount Hortiatis
Protected forest area with abundant natural beauty
Routes showcasing the natural environment and local history
additional: Registration has been extended until Wednesday 25/2/2026. The race is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis. The Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association was founded in 1993 and promotes popular mass participation in sports, exercise, and the protection of the natural environment. The annual membership fee is 15 euros and can be paid either at the association’s office or by bank transfer. Routes of 24, 10, and 6 km; trail-running races and paths; start and finish in the Hortiatis area, Thessaloniki, with support from the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis.

description: For the third consecutive year, the Oloi Mazi Boroume road races are taking place in Parnitha, Attica, with the aim of reforestation and environmental protection. Participants can choose from three routes, making it possible for everyone to take part regardless of age or fitness level. Entry costs 10 euros for adults and is free for children up to 12 years old. All runners receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event brings participants together to create a sustainable environment.
course_highlights: Three different routes for all ages and fitness levels
Held in Parnitha, an area of natural beauty and ecosystems
Symbolic reforestation through tree planting in the race areas
additional: All participants receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event takes place at three separate locations in Attica. Donations can be made by calling the five-digit number 19817, with a 2-euro donation. The event takes place at three locations in Attica, with an emphasis on reforestation and environmental protection. It includes online registration, commemorative items, and individual timing.

description: The Panhellenic Masters Track and Field Games are held under the auspices of the Hellenic Masters Athletes Track and Field Federation (OEBAS) at the Spiantza Grove in Ilia. The event features cross-country races and a 10 km race walk, and is open to masters and independent athletes. Supported by the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos, it offers a high-level sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting. The races begin in the morning, with the first start at 08:30.
course_highlights: Cross-country races and a 10 km race walk
Location: Spiantza Grove, Ilia
Held under the auspices of OEBAS
additional: The event has been assigned to SEVAS N. Ilia and OEBAS, with the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos as co-organizers. The races take place at two locations: Spiantza Grove and the Port of Katakolo, Ilia. Entries cover various age categories and include cross-country races and race walking, with detailed information about courses and registration varying by category.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering every runner the chance to enjoy mountain running and the area’s natural beauty. The event consists of three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, technical and demanding course, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The series has become an established fixture in the running community, offering incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. The event is organized by MyRace and supported by Salomon, inviting runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses per race: a longer course (10–12 km) with significant elevation gain, and a shorter course (4–7 km)
Natural beauty and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the longer distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Each race includes a draw for 4 pairs of Salomon shoes. Individual and team rankings, with awards, are offered for the longer distance. Teams consist of three people and may be men’s, women’s or mixed. Trail running in Parnitha with multiple distances, categories for individual and team runners, medals and awards, as well as full participant services.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: 10ο Women’s Run
description: The 10th Women's Run is a non-competitive 5-kilometer road race organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Chios, with the aim of honoring women. The course is flat and runs through the center of Chios, starting and finishing at the Central Square (Chios Town Hall). The race offers an enjoyable experience for all participants, with benefits including a T-shirt, medal, and commemorative certificate. The race starts at 11:30 a.m. and is open to women over 18, with minors permitted to participate with parental consent.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course in the center of Chios
Start and finish at Central Square (Chios Town Hall)
Kilometer markers at every kilometer
additional: Registration includes a race bib bearing the participant’s full name, a T-shirt with logos, a commemorative certificate, and a medal. Medical coverage is provided, along with support stations offering bottled water at the start and finish. The time limit is one hour (race ends at 13:00). The race-pack collection point is Chios Town Hall, open Friday 6/03/2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 7/03/2026 from 10:00 to 13:00. Cancellations are accepted only until 28/2/2026, with refunds issued after deductions. The race takes place at Chios Central Square and promotes women’s sport and health, with participants from across the island and beyond.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αθήνας

price_tiers.distance: Special Olympics Hellas και ΑμεΑ Cosmote Telekom

description: The 14th Athens Half Marathon is one of Greece’s most popular road races, held in the historic center of Athens. The 21-kilometer course offers a unique experience through the city, with support stations and comprehensive organization. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over and is a celebration of sport and participation. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event prioritizes participants’ safety and comfort, providing support along the entire course and an expo area before the race.
course_highlights: A 21-kilometer course in the historic center of Athens
Support stations with water, energy gels, isotonic drinks, and sponges
Start at 08:00, with the finish open until 11:30
additional: Race materials can be collected from the Runners’ Service Center & ERGO Half Marathon Expo at the Palaio Faliro Indoor Stadium – Taekwondo Venue. Full hydration and energy support is available along the course. Participants compete at their own risk, and no medical certificates are required. A cancellation policy allows refunds until February 8, 2026. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event includes the Family Run, the Special Olympics Hellas race, and activities such as the ERGO HALF MARATHON EXPO, with major courses and activities for everyone.

name: Στα Βήματα του Ζορμπά
description: The “In the Footsteps of Zorba” race is held in Kolindros, Pieria, and features 13 km and 4 km courses, as well as a 500-metre children’s race. The event highlights the area’s historical and cultural heritage, offering participants a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings, with panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains. The race is open to athletes aged 12 and over, with special requirements for minors. It is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which is responsible for organizing and supporting the event.
course_highlights: 13 km and 4 km courses in Kolindros, Pieria
Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains
500-metre children’s race for younger athletes
additional: Athletes aged 15 and over may enter the 13 km race, while athletes aged 12 and over may enter the 4 km race when accompanied by an adult. The event also includes a 500-metre children’s race. SMF SPORTS provides event organization, electronic timing, and sportswear sales services. Technical courses, online registration, medical support, commemorative medals and participant gifts, cultural events, and local traditions.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: DRC X URC Run is a friendly running event in central Athens, offering a chance to enjoy a light run and socialize with other runners. The route offers 5 km and 8 km options, with different paces to suit each participant. The run starts at the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion, creating a lovely atmosphere for a running morning. Participation is free and limited to 200 places, so runners are encouraged to sign up quickly.
course_highlights: 5 km and 8 km routes in central Athens
Starting point: the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion
A chance to enjoy a light run at different paces (5 km at 6:30 pace, 8 km at 6:00 pace)
additional: Participation is free and limited to 200 places. Participants can choose the pace that suits them and run with other runners in central Athens. The event also includes an open light run and activities in central Athens, and is part of a series of running events organized by DRC and URC.

name: 7ο Via Egnatia Run
description: The VIA EGNATIA RUN is a sporting event organized by the Regional Unit of Evros and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace. It is an innovative initiative that connects the history and culture of the Ancient Via Egnatia with sport, offering runners a unique experience. The route follows the ancient Via Egnatia, which once linked Constantinople with Rome, and aims to bring people together through sport and culture. The race includes certified half-marathon and 5-kilometer routes, offering options for runners of different abilities.
course_highlights: 21.0975-meter route (half-marathon) certified by AIMS
5,000-meter route certified by AIMS
Route following the ancient Via Egnatia, a historic and cultural trail
additional: The race includes various categories, with participants of all abilities, and takes place in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli, with an emphasis on the community and cultural heritage of the area.

name: 17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα – Τρίκαλα
description: The 17th Kalambaka–Trikala “Thanasis Stamopoulos” Half Marathon is one of the fastest half marathons in Greece and Europe, with a slightly downhill course that starts in historic Kalambaka and finishes in the heart of Trikala. The event honors the memory of Thanasis Stamopoulos, a founding member of the Trikala Runners’ Club, and attracts thousands of runners from across Greece and abroad. Alongside the classic half marathon, the event offers 5K, 5K for people with disabilities, and a 1K children’s race, making it a celebration for all ages and levels. The course features beautiful scenery and both historic and modern landmarks, while the atmosphere is full of excitement and support from spectators.
course_highlights: Slightly downhill course from Kalambaka to Trikala
Route through the Thessalian plain, with beautiful scenery
Passes historic and modern landmarks in the city of Trikala
additional: The race starts at Kalambaka Central Square and finishes at Trikala Central Square. There is one water station every 5 kilometers in the half marathon and every 2.5 kilometers in the 5K. All participants receive a technical commemorative T-shirt, and finishers receive a medal. There are parallel races for people with disabilities and a 1K children’s race. The event emphasizes safety and smooth organization in accordance with EOSLMA-Y regulations. It includes parallel events and volunteering opportunities, with registration through the official website.

name: Piraeus Port Run
description: The Piraeus Port Run is a landmark road race held in Piraeus in memory of Piraeus-born runner Christos Vartzaki. The event offers 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 1 km race for children, with an emphasis on a safe, high-quality running experience and showcasing the city’s seafront. It is an established event in Piraeus’s sporting calendar and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Piraeus and the Piraeus Health Runners’ Club. The event places particular importance on supporting runners and providing medical care during the race.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km races, plus a 1 km race for children
Piraeus seafront
Medical support at the start, along the course and at the finish
additional: Medical support at the start, along the course and at the finish. Bottled water and a banana are provided at the finish. Participation is available by age category and for people with disabilities, with this indicated during registration. Minors participate under the responsibility of their guardians. The event takes place along the seafront and features 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races for children. Online registration.

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: 4ο Serres Circuit Run
description: The 4th Serres Circuit Run is a major running event returning to Serres, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The race takes place at the Serres Autodrome, a purpose-built venue combining safety with an exciting course. The event is supported by the Municipality of Serres, with the aim of promoting sport and the local community. It brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, dynamic setting.
course_highlights: Course at the Serres Autodrome, a purpose-built racing venue
A safe, well-organized environment for runners of all levels
Organized by the Municipality of Serres, with an emphasis on the local community and sport
additional: The event includes various categories and ultradistance races, with certified courses and international participation. It takes place at the Serres city autodrome on March 27, 2027.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The 1st Igoumenitsa Road Race (Igoumenitsa City Run) is organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners’ Association in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The event features 10,000m and 5,000m races, as well as a 1,000m children’s race for primary school students. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center, offering a unique experience on a beautiful urban route. The race is dedicated to the memory of young Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: 10,000m and 5,000m routes through the city of Igoumenitsa
A 1,000m children’s race for primary school students
Start and finish at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:35 a.m. The race is dedicated to the memory of Maximos Lamprousis. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center. Organized in the coastal zone, with participation open to all ages and levels, plus a celebration and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kalligonios Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual road race offering events for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race combines an athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s scenery, attracting runners of all ages and abilities. The event is friendly and offers all participants an enjoyable experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km and 9 km routes featuring natural scenery and historical monuments
1,000 m race for Special Olympics participants and children
Discounts on accommodation and transport for participants
additional: An event focused on cultural and athletic experiences, with entries in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to be opening soon.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: The 9th Spercheios Half Marathon “Athanasios Akridas” is held in Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the support of the Municipality of Makrakomi and the Spercheiada Municipal Community. This road race celebrates the area’s traditions and natural beauty, offering a unique experience for runners who love running and nature. The event is a celebration of sport and social responsibility, aiming to promote grassroots sport and encourage volunteering.
course_highlights: Route in Spercheiada, Phthiotis
Natural surroundings and local history
Support from local organizations and environmental awareness
additional: The race is supported by the Municipality of Makrakomi, the Spercheiada Municipal Community, and Goulinas Adventure. The Thessaloniki Runners’ Health Association (S.D.Y.TH.) organizes accompanying training sessions and night training sessions in the Seich Sou area. The race promotes sports education, social responsibility, and environmental protection, especially of the Seich Sou suburban forest. A technical course in Spercheiada’s central square, with road races, children’s races, and participation from local clubs. Rules and participation instructions are available.

name: 44ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Δήμου Φιλοθέης – Ψυχικού
description: The 44th Filothei-Psychiko Municipality Road Race is an annual sporting event held in the areas of Filothei and Psychiko in Athens. The race offers runners of all ages the chance to take part in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko and promotes physical activity and social solidarity in the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, race day.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer route in the Filothei-Psychiko area
Organized by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko
An opportunity for runners of all levels to participate

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The “I Run for the Spring of Life” road race is held under the auspices of the Attica Region and with the support of the Friends’ Association of P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. It is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 4 km races, as well as a 500 m race for people with disabilities. The races start and finish on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The courses are looped and pass by notable landmarks in the Municipality of Dionysos, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The event is open to runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Looped 10 km course (2 × 5 km), starting and finishing on Drosias Avenue in Stamata
4 km course for middle-school boys and girls and adults
500 m race open to people with disabilities
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in the Municipality of Dionysos. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veterans’ categories. Runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes are eligible to participate. The start and finish are at the corner of Drosias–Stamata Avenue and Solomou Street, with designated turnarounds on the 2.5 km and 2 km courses. All participation supports charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The start and finish are on Neapoli’s pedestrian street, and the course runs along the old Tsotyli–Neapoli national road. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over, offering a pleasant experience on a public road with support from the local traffic police. The event uses wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a public road, starting from the Tsotyli Health Center
5 km course, starting from the junction in the village of Peristera
1 km children’s race, starting from the kiosk at the entrance to Neapoli
additional: Participants collect a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave starts, with runners assigned to start blocks based on their times. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own risk on the sidewalk. The event includes courses on public roads and pedestrian streets, with support from volunteers and awards for the winners. The event takes place on 28 March 2027.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Велинград Ултра
price_range: 23 евро за тениска, други цени не са посочени
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the Spa Capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose from 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event offers professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: Courses of 11 km (520 m elevation gain), 27 km (1,420 m elevation gain), and 43 km (2,100 m elevation gain)
Mountain terrain with marked trails and aid stations
Start and finish in the center of Velingrad—the Spa Capital of the Balkans
additional: Race packs include a medal, an event-logo souvenir, timing, and a race number. Registration and race-pack collection are from 07:00 to 11:00 on race day. Cutoff times are set for the 27 km and 43 km distances. Event T-shirts are available for purchase for 23 euros. Mandatory additional equipment is not included in the race pack. The courses include different distances; registration is on 4 April 2026. The event includes medals, photos, and aid stations; additional equipment is required.

name: Gârboavele Trail Run
location: Pădurea Gârboavele, Tulucești, Galați County, Romania

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Road Race “The Park 10K” is being held for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritsis Park. This is a cross-country race with 5- and 10-kilometer courses, supported by the Metropolitan Park Management Agency and organized for charity, benefiting MDA Hellas. The race attracts runners of all ages and abilities who enjoy running in nature and supporting their community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Antonis Tritsis Environmental Awareness Park
5- and 10-kilometer courses through a natural setting
Access through five main entrances, with Entrance A recommended as it is near the start
additional: Tritsis Park can be accessed through five entrances; Entrance A, near the start, is recommended. The race is supported by the Park Management Agency and benefits MDA Hellas. It promotes social awareness, the protection of Tritsis Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while offering people of all ages the chance to enjoy sports in a natural setting.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
location: Център на село Марково, Plovdiv Province, Bulgaria
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains, around the village of Markovo in Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22 and 44 km—as well as a 700-metre children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo mayor’s office and organised by the Plovdiv and Rhodope Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Club.
course_highlights: Courses of 8, 12, 22 and 44 km in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains
Aid stations with water, electrolytes, fruit, snacks and special food
Well-marked and secured routes with timing and electronic results tracking
additional: Race packs include a race number, gifts and surprises from sponsors. The 8 km race includes a designer headband; the 12 and 22 km races include a designer organic cotton T-shirt; and the 44 km race includes a designer fleece vest. A headlamp is mandatory equipment. The children’s race is 700 metres long and free for children up to 8 years old. Parking is arranged on streets marked in red; motor vehicles are not permitted in the start/finish area. The awards ceremony begins at 12:00 and takes place in stages. In editions for which information is available, the start and expo area are in the centre of Markovo. Information about the distances and conditions refers to previous editions.

name: 1ος Μαραθώνιος Ηπείρου «Βασιλιάς Πύρρος»
description: The Epirus “King Pyrrhus” Marathon is a historic, fast marathon held in the city of Arta, on a course certified by World Athletics. The course is flat and runs along the Arachthos River, offering ideal weather conditions for runners aiming for a personal best. The race honors King Pyrrhus, an important ancient leader of Epirus, and combines sport with the region’s history and culture. The event includes a marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Arachthos River
Passes the historic Bridge of Arta
Start and finish at the statue of King Pyrrhus, Kilkis Square
additional: There are ample refreshment stations with bottled water on all courses. Timing uses a disposable chip that does not need to be returned. Electronic timing is provided, with checkpoints. Awards are presented after the races. Group registration is available for teams of 10 or more, with no restrictions on race selection. The event includes road races and regional routes, with an emphasis on the area’s cultural and historical significance. Registration opens soon, and the event is expected to attract runners from across Greece and abroad.

name: 2ο Amanitis Trail
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The Amanitis Trail 2027 offers a unique mountain-running experience in central Chios, starting from the picturesque semi-mountainous village of Avgonyma, with views of the Aegean Sea. The 40-kilometer route passes through historic and natural landscapes, including the medieval village of Anavatos and remote Agios Sideros, with a mix of trails, dirt roads, and panoramic views. The finish is back in Avgonyma, completing an authentic adventure through the island’s nature and history. Shorter 7- and 21-kilometer routes are also available, suitable for beginners and more experienced runners, respectively.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the traditional village of Avgonyma, overlooking the Aegean Sea
Route passes through the medieval castle-village of Anavatos
Sections through lush ravines, trails, and dirt roads with panoramic views
additional: Participants receive a race bib and timing chip, aid stations along the route, a commemorative finisher’s medal, and a technical race T-shirt, with a choice of two designs available until 20/2/26. There are age categories and participation requirements for the 40KM race relating to previous experience in mountain races. Participants enjoy aid stations along the route, commemorative medals, and technical T-shirts, subject to athlete eligibility requirements and detailed race regulations.

name: 2ο DUTH Campus Half Marathon
organizer: Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης και Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ροδόπης
description: The DUTH Campus Half Marathon is being held for the third consecutive year at the Democritus University of Thrace campus in Komotini. It features two distances, 7,000 meters and 21,000 meters, on a smooth, flat dirt course within the university campus. Entry is free, and electronic timing is provided, along with a commemorative medal for all finishers. In addition, the top three finishers in each race and age category receive trophies. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with the start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science.
course_highlights: Smooth, flat dirt course within the DUTH campus
Two distances: 7,000 m and 21,000 m
Start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science
additional: Entry is free. Electronic timing and overall and individual results are provided. All finishers receive a commemorative collectible medal. Trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in each race and age category. A medical examination is required for all athletes and for the parents or guardians of underage athletes. The event is held with the support of the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science, with commemorative medals, trophies, and family activities. The course is flat and suitable for all runners.

name: 2ο Vertical Challenge
description: The 2nd Vertical Challenge is an international “vertical kilometer” mountain running race held in Gerakas, Xanthi, organized by the Xanthi Mountaineering Club in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi. Athletes start in the village of Gerakas and follow a 3.5 km uphill route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m. The Gerakas Trail and Gerakas Path races are also held, featuring circular routes of varying difficulty and distance. The event welcomes runners aged 12 and over, with special requirements for younger participants. Registration is individual and takes place online through the club’s website.
course_highlights: Vertical Challenge: 3.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain on trails, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m
Gerakas Trail: circular 8.5 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Gerakas Path: easy circular 5 km route with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Maximum number of participants in the 2nd Vertical Challenge: 80. ITRA score must be provided if available. Individual registrations only. Open to participants aged 12 and over, with special requirements for ages 16–18. Organized in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi, with limited places and registration through the website.

name: 3ος Παράκτιος Ημιμαραθώνιος Θερμαϊκού Αντώνης Ματζάρης
description: The Thermaikos Coastal Half Marathon “Antonis Matzaris” is a distinctive running event in eastern Thessaloniki, offering unique routes along the coastline of the Municipality of Thermaikos. Held on a fixed date and attracting large numbers of runners, the race combines sport and social action, drawing families and runners of all levels. The event aims to establish itself as an important sporting occasion with a quality focus and a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A coastal route of unique beauty
Routes suitable for the whole family
Impressive performances and runner participation
additional: A limited number of new registrations are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the Registration Centre on Friday 27.3.2026 and Saturday 28.3.2026. The race includes parallel events and volunteering. The event follows the standards of major international races and is held on a fixed date. It is supported by local clubs and organizations, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and community participation, and includes starts and finishes from Wellness Santa Hotel.

name: 5ος Μυρμιδόνων Αθλος
description: The 5th Myrmidons Athlos is a challenging mountain running race organized by the Municipality of Farsala in collaboration with the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Clubs, the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Club, and Running Team Farsala. The race covers 21 kilometers, with approximately 1,000 meters of both elevation gain and loss, offering an exciting experience in a natural mountain setting. The 2nd Myrmidons Mini Trail is also organized alongside it, covering a shorter distance for runners seeking a shorter route. The event aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the Farsala area.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance with +1,000 m of elevation gain and loss
Mountain running in a natural setting around Farsala
A shorter mini-trail race is held alongside the main event
additional: The race features highly challenging routes, with an emphasis on showcasing the area's natural and cultural wealth, and welcomes participants from various age categories.

name: 5ο Pravi Trail Run
description: The EleftheroupoliRunners Sports and Cultural Association of the Municipality of Pangaio organizes the 5th Pravi Trail Run in Eleftheroupoli. The race offers three routes of 21.5 km, 12 km, and 5 km, all starting and finishing in Eleftheroupoli. The 21.5 km route is of moderate difficulty and includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt. The 12 km route is also of moderate difficulty. The 5 km route is easy and suitable for beginners, offering an introduction to trail running.
course_highlights: 21.5 km route with 16 km of trails, 2.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
12 km route with 8 km of trails, 1.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
Easy 5 km loop route for beginners to trail running
additional: Maximum participants: 300 for 21.5 km, 200 for 12 km, and 200 for 5 km. Time limit: 5 hours. Minimum age: 15; parental consent is required for participants aged 15–18. Start and finish at the Eleftheroupoli public market venue. Registration includes a commemorative gift. Registration deadline: 23/03/2026.

name: 8ος Δρόμος 21 Μαθητών
description: The Makrochori Cultural Association of Imathia “PSIFIDOTO,” in collaboration with the Sports Department of the Municipality of Veria and the Local Folklore Association of Makrochori and Surrounding Areas, is organizing the popular memorial race “8th Race of the 21 Students.” The event includes races for adults and children: a 10,700-meter main race, a 2,500-meter health walk, and races for primary and secondary school students. The course is on paved roads, with no significant elevation changes, and takes place in Makrochori, Imathia. The event has a charitable purpose and honors the memory of the 21 students.
course_highlights: 10,700-meter paved course with no significant elevation changes
2,500-meter health walk for adults
1,000-meter and 1,500-meter races for primary and secondary school students
additional: Online registration has closed for all categories. Late registrations are accepted only if race numbers are available, on Saturday or Sunday morning at the Makrochori Cultural Association office. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:15. Courses are on paved roads; participants take part at their own risk. Registration is through the website, with categories separated by age and race distance.

name: 10ος Αραφήνειος Δρόμος
location: Δημοτικό Κολυμβητήριο Ραφήνας, Ραφήνα, Ανατολική Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 10th Araphineios Road Race is a major celebration of sport in the Municipality of Rafina-Pikermi, which has become an established event with strong community and athletic participation. The event brings people and organizations together, showcasing the city as a vibrant center of sport and culture. Rafina’s central square is transformed into a hub of activity and entertainment, with sports activities, music, and events for all ages.
course_highlights: Event held in Rafina’s central square
Sports activities and fitness activities by PROTYPO FITNESS CLUB
Cheerleading performance and music by the Rafina-Pikermi Municipal Philharmonic
additional: Race bibs and athlete kits can be collected from 09:00 to 19:00. Activities, refreshments, and event sponsors are present throughout the day. The event includes music and sports demonstrations. The event features races on certified courses, with participants aged 6 and over, and is held with the support of the police and volunteers. Participation is free or requires a small fee, and the event is accompanied by cultural and community activities.

name: 10ος Μαραθώνιος Ναυπλίου

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Προθεσμία ολοκλήρωσης εγγραφών και πληρωμών: Παρασκευή 20 Μαρτίου 2026

description: The Nafplio Marathon is a special road race that combines sport, history, and natural beauty in the beautiful city of Nafplio. Runners of all levels have the opportunity to enjoy courses passing through historic and natural landscapes while taking part in a friendly, well-organized event. The event offers a range of benefits and gives participants the opportunity to visit archaeological sites in Argolis free of charge. The Marathon is a celebration for the city and its runners, with a strong cultural character and social dimension.
course_highlights: Courses combining sport, history, and natural beauty
Free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis for participants
Showcasing monuments and archaeological sites in Nafplio, Palamidi, Tiryns, Mycenae, and Epidaurus
additional: Participants receive a race number (BIB), electronic timing, a technical T-shirt, printed informational materials, a participation certificate, race photos, a finisher’s medal, and a bag. Registration fees can be paid only by card or IRIS. Unpaid registrations are automatically canceled. Volunteers are an important part of the event. Runners receive free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis on race day and the following day. The event includes accompanying cultural, educational, and social activities, races for the marathon, half marathon, 5 km, and a 1 km race for students, as well as cultural programs and trips.

name: 10ος Εύκλειος Αγώνας Βουνού & 6ο Υμηττός Marathon
description: The 10th Efkleios Mountain Race and the 6th Hymettus Marathon are organized by the South Athens Runners Association “EFKLIS” and offer a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Hymettus. The routes include a variety of distances and elevation profiles, with certified courses and water stations. The event is supported by volunteer groups and local organizations, and provides electronic timing, medals, and refreshments for participants. The start is in Argyroupoli, and the atmosphere is friendly and safe for all runners.
course_highlights: 18 km course with electronic timing and live location tracking
47 km Hymettus Marathon with +2,150 m elevation gain and 2 ITRA points
Water stations at key points along the course
additional: Electronic timing uses a chip, and runners’ locations are displayed in real time. The race office distributes race packs from 07:00, strictly for athletes from outside Attica. Payment is by card online only and must be made within five days of registration. Volunteers receive an event T-shirt, a backpack, snacks, water, juice, and a medal. Mountain races and marathons, routes on Mount Hymettus, road and mountain race entries, technical T-shirts and equipment, electronic timing.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Βόλου
price_range: Half Marathon 15€, City Race 10€, Family Run 5€, Kids Run 500m δωρεάν
description: The 10th Volos Half Marathon is a celebratory sporting event held under the auspices of the Thessaly Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and EOSLMA-Y. The event includes the half marathon, the 5 km City Race, the 2 km Family Run, and the 500 m Kids Run, attracting thousands of participants each year. It is co-organized by the Volos Health Runners’ Club, the Municipality of Volos, the Region of Thessaly, the Magnesia Chamber of Commerce, and the University of Thessaly. Registration is exclusively online, with payment by card, and the participation package includes a commemorative T-shirt for the anniversary race. The start and accompanying races offer a unique running experience in the city of Volos.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km half marathon through the city of Volos
Accompanying races: 5 km City Race, 2 km Family Run, and 500 m Kids Run
Celebratory participation package with an anniversary-race T-shirt
additional: Registration is online only, with payment by card. Participation in the 500 m Kids Run is free, with on-site registration. Participation cannot be canceled with a refund after March 20, 2026. Runners who do not collect their participation package on the day and at the time of the start will not be able to collect it later. Routes for the half marathon, 5 km race, family race, and children’s race; online registration by card; registration period from 27/10/2025 to 14/2/2026; discounts and participation packages.

name: 14ος Βαλλιάνειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 14th Vallianeios Popular Road Race in Argostoli is one of Kefalonia’s most important and beloved sporting events, with a continuous presence for 14 years. The main 10-kilometer race follows a beautiful, accessible route along the waterfront, combining sea views with the natural landscape. Children’s races and a dedicated route for people with disabilities are also organized, reinforcing the event’s inclusive character. The event is accompanied by music, dance, and sporting activities, offering a complete celebration of sport for everyone.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the waterfront promenade lined with palm trees
Turnaround near the “Oscar” restaurant and return to the Central Square
Dedicated route for people with disabilities and children’s races ranging from 50 to 100+ meters
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal, and winners in each category are honored with special awards. The event is co-organized with the Municipality of Argostoli and held under the auspices of the Vallianeios Bequest. Last-minute registration is available for a limited number of runners only, on a first-come, first-served basis. Various routes and age categories, volunteer participation, and events for the public. Includes 10 km and children’s routes.

name: PepsiCo Gives Back – Kifissia
location: Πλατεία Ηρώων Πολυτεχνείου, Κάτω Κηφισιά, Greece
description: The PepsiCo Gives Back - Kifissia event is a charity road race held in Kato Kifisia, starting and finishing at Heroes of Polytechnic Square. It features timed 5 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities. The event is open to runners of all ages, and proceeds go to charitable causes. RUNAWAY provides technical support, making this an enjoyable and socially beneficial sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the circular road around Heroes of Polytechnic Square
Timed 5 km and 10 km races
Untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities
additional: The 5 km and 10 km races are timed. The 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races are untimed. Companions of people with disabilities and parents may participate without a race bib, starting at the back of the course. The event is charitable, with proceeds going to charitable causes. Registration is available through an online form, with various categories and age groups and a participation fee. The event takes place in Kato Kifisia, starting at Heroes of Polytechnic Square.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

name: 3ο Kefalonia Backyard Ultra
price_range: Τελικές Τιμές για Αθλητές (μετά την έκπτωση 50%)
description: The 3rd Kefalonia Backyard Ultra is an ultra-distance backyard ultra race held in Argostoli, Kefalonia. Runners are invited to run a 6,706-meter loop, completing one lap every hour until only one winner remains. The event aims to bring participants closer to nature and challenge them to push their limits, offering a unique endurance and sporting experience on the beautiful island of Kefalonia.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop
Run one lap every hour until only one runner remains
Kefalonia’s natural setting, with mountains and sea
additional: The event offers athletes significant benefits, including free travel with Ionion Pelagos Lines and a 50% discount with Levante Ferries. The race consists of consecutive one-hour laps, with participants aiming to run for as long as they can. Supported by local sponsors, the event has continued to improve, offering a high-standard endurance and hospitality experience. The race features continuous laps on a loop course, with a fueling strategy and support from the organizing team. Registration is required, and the course is suitable for runners with endurance and strategic skills.

name: 78ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιέρας Πόλης Μεσολογγίου
location: Ιερά Μονή του Αγίου Συμεών, Μεσολόγγι, Greece
description: The 78th Road of Sacrifice of the Sacred City of Mesolongi is a historic road race held as part of the celebrations marking the anniversary of the historic Exodus. The race honors the people of Mesolongi who sacrificed themselves for the ideals of freedom and is the oldest road race in the country. The route starts at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon, where the Besieged Free Greeks took refuge, and finishes in the city’s Garden of Heroes, covering a total of 9,800 meters. This route has special historical and symbolic significance, offering participants a unique athletic and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Start at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon, a historic refuge for the Besieged Free Greeks
Finish in the Garden of Heroes in the city of Mesolongi
Total distance of 9,800 meters, with historical and symbolic significance
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. The route starts at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon and finishes in the city’s Garden of Heroes. The race honors the historic sacrifice of the people of Mesolongi and the Philhellenes during the Exodus of Mesolongi. The event includes three participation categories, participation for over-2500s, ages up to 17, participation via QR code, and takes place on a walking route around Mesolongi.

name: Evia Ultra Trail
description: The Evia Ultra Trail is a demanding mountain race held in the area of Steni, Evia. It offers a unique experience for runners who love the mountains and adventure, with routes crossing natural trails and scenic landscapes. The race is an important event for the local community and attracts runners from across Greece and abroad. The event is professionally organized and welcoming, with an emphasis on participant safety and support.
course_highlights: Mountain route with natural trails
Impressive landscapes of Steni, Evia
Support stations along the route
additional: The race includes 30 km routes with recorded support stations. It is included in the ITRA - UTMB Index for 2026. The organizers provide a technical briefing and race regulations for participants. The race includes aid stations, medical support, and different routes for runners of all levels, with an emphasis on safety and enjoying nature.

name: Helicon Mountain Race
description: The Helicon Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held at the Krya Springs in Livadeia. It offers courses of various distances, from 5.6 km to 38 km, through a captivating natural environment with rugged terrain and lush vegetation. The race is certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and offers nature and adventure enthusiasts a unique opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable mountain-running experience. A free yoga session is also offered for relaxation and recovery.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 5.6 to 38 km in a mountain setting
Certified by the International Skyrunning Federation
Natural landscape with lush vegetation and rugged terrain
additional: A free yoga session will be held on Saturday 4/4 at 15:00 at the Krya Open-Air Theatre; registration is required. You can also volunteer at the event by completing a dedicated form. Multiple courses, environmental awareness, local hospitality and cultural experiences, with a focus on mountain nature and adventure.

name: Run Greece Syros
