description: The Run Greece race in Syros offers a unique road-running experience, with 10 km and 5 km races, a children’s race, and a Family Run. The races start at Miaouli Square and combine urban and coastal scenery, making them ideal for runners of all levels. The event provides electronic timing, medical coverage, and finisher medals, creating a friendly and safe environment for all participants. Adults and children can take part, with special rates for students in group registrations.
course_highlights: Start in front of the Town Hall on Eleftheriou Venizelou Street
10 km and 5 km routes through the town and coastal area
Organized support with stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Entry to the 10 km race includes a race bib with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher medal, a participation certificate with times, and an official T-shirt. Medical coverage is provided by medical services and volunteer rescuers along the route. Registrations are automatically canceled if the entry fee is not paid. Race numbers and materials are collected before the race, with instructions sent by email. The race consists of four laps of the 10 km route, starting at Miaouli Square and finishing in front of the Town Hall. Registration closes a few days before the race.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race held in Băneasa Forest in Bucharest. Since its first edition in 2018, it has grown organically to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country race (11 km), sprint (6 km) and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The varied routes include trails, dirt roads and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment points. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country race 11 km, sprint 6 km and Family Run 3 km
Refreshment points at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9 and the finish, with water, isotonic drinks and food
additional: The routes may have uneven ground, roots and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized for different paces, with coordinators. Refreshment points along the routes offer water, isotonic drinks and food. The edition scheduled for April 11, 2027 has been officially announced, and registration is due to open.

name: Hydra’s Trail Event
location: Hydra, Hydra Regional Unit, Attica, Greece
description: Hydra’s Trail Event is an annual trail-running race held on the island of Hydra. It offers a variety of routes for runners of all levels, from a marathon to shorter, fun runs. The event combines the challenge of nature with the beauty of the landscape, attracting large numbers of participants and volunteers. It has a long tradition and a reputation for excellent organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes with a strong mountain character and natural beauty
A variety of races, from a marathon to routes for beginners and children
Routes crossing the picturesque island of Hydra
additional: Race T-shirts and medals are offered to participants. Volunteers can help support the athletes. The schedule includes multiple start times for different routes, with the first start at 07:00. The event includes medals, T-shirts, volunteer opportunities, and entries in various categories, with an emphasis on natural beauty and community.

name: 3ος Γιτάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 3rd Gitaneios Road Race is an important sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with showcasing the historical heritage of Thesprotia. It includes 21 km and 5 km road races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race for children aged 6 and over. The course is paved and finishes at the archaeological site of Gitana, at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana. The event aspires to become an institution connecting sports with the history and culture of the region.
course_highlights: 21 km course from the Igoumenitsa bicycle path to the Archaeological Site of Gitana
Passes along the seafront, through the plain of Ragio–Kestrini and by the Kalamas River
Finish at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana
additional: Participation is free. Buses will be available from the Pantheon in Igoumenitsa to the Archaeological Site of Gitana (08:00–08:30 a.m.), with return buses after the awards ceremony. For safety reasons, vehicle traffic at and around the Ancient Theatre of Gitana will be suspended before the start of the 5 km race and the children’s race. Paved routes, cultural monuments, refreshment stations, medical coverage, age requirements for participation

name: 3ο Γρεβενά City Run
description: The 3rd Grevena City Run is a distinctive road race held in the city of Grevena. Participants will run along the city’s main streets, climb steps and pass through picturesque alleys, enjoying views of the Grevenitis River. The race offers 10 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. The start and finish are at Aimilianou Square in Grevena, offering a lovely opportunity to discover the city and experience Grevena’s hospitality.
course_highlights: Routes along the city’s main streets
Pass through alleys and climb steps
Views of the Grevenitis River
additional: A 1,000-meter race for children and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. Start and finish at Aimilianou Square, Grevena. The race’s theme is “Sports for All,” and it emphasizes strengthening social cohesion and health through sport.

name: 5ο Race For Autism Gr
description: The 5th Race For Autism Gr takes place in the Kavouri area of Vouliagmeni, with the aim of raising awareness and promoting equal participation in sports for neurodivergent people. The event is supported by the Race for Autism Gr nonprofit civil company, which organizes amateur sporting events throughout Greece. The race promotes social inclusion and the acceptance of autistic people and their families. The event is held in collaboration with the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and aims to raise awareness about autism.
course_highlights: Location: Kavouri, Vouliagmeni
Amateur 5-kilometer race
Promotes equal participation in sports for neurodivergent people
additional: The event is supported by the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and local government. A parallel swimming event, “I Swim for Autism,” takes place at the Kallithea Swimming Pool. The event promotes the acceptance, participation, and inclusion of neurodivergent people in sports. It includes running races and other awareness-raising activities, with support from the Municipality of Vouliagmeni and local organizations. The event is open to all ages and abilities, promoting social inclusion and acceptance.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Πεδίου Αρεως «Στις Γειτονιές της Αθήνας»
location: Pediou Areos Park, Athens, Attica, Greece
description: The 9th Pedion tou Areos Race “In the Neighborhoods of Athens” is organized by the “Athenaioi Dromeis” Athletic and Cultural Association to showcase Pedion tou Areos Park and raise awareness of environmental issues. The race includes 5 km and 10 km routes that start and finish inside the park and pass through the surrounding Athens neighborhoods, as well as a 1.3 km children’s race inside the park. The event emphasizes culture, fair play, and environmental awareness, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Statue of Athena inside Pedion tou Areos Park
5 km and 10 km routes through the neighborhoods around the park
1.3 km children’s race inside the park
additional: The children’s race consists of one lap inside the park. The 10 km race has a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes; after that, runners are required to run on the sidewalk at their own risk. The race is held under the auspices of several organizations, including the General Secretariat of Sports and the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Associations (EOSLMA-Y). The event emphasizes green races and environmental awareness. The routes pass through the park and surrounding neighborhoods; the event includes an environmental program and electronic timing. Participation is limited to 650 runners in total for the 5 km and 10 km races.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Γερανείων
description: The 10th Geraneia Mountain Race is a challenging trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Geraneia Mountains, near Loutraki in the Peloponnese. Celebrating a decade of challenges and participation, the race offers runners a unique experience on trails and mountain routes. The event is supported by the Municipality of Loutraki and is an important sporting event for the area. It brings organizers and athletes together in a friendly, energetic setting.
course_highlights: Mountain course in the Geraneia Mountains
Natural scenery with trails and varied terrain
Challenging course celebrating 10 years of history
additional: The event is organized by the Municipality of Loutraki. No information was found about registration prices, start times, or special participation categories. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary and highlights the challenge of every kilometer in the mountains. The race features trail running focused on nature and challenge, and offers opportunities for preparation and training at different levels of difficulty.

name: 12ος Φιλανθρωπικός Αγώνας Βουνού Αυτισμός – Ελπίδα 2026
location: Περιφερειακό δάσος Δήμου Ωραιοκάστρου, Ωραιόκαστρο, Θεσσαλονίκη, Greece
organizer: Σύλλογος Φίλων Αυτιστικού Ατόμου της Μονάδας «ΕΛΠΙΔΑ»
description: The 12th Charity Mountain Race “Autism - ELPIDA” takes place in the peri-urban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro, Thessaloniki, and includes 1 km, 5+ km and 15 km courses. The 15 km course features changes in elevation, with a total elevation gain of 500 metres, offering runners a challenging and beautiful experience. The race aims to raise awareness about children with autism and support the “ELPIDA” Autism Unit. Registration includes official timing, medical support, a medal, a commemorative certificate and a snack at the finish. There is also a baggage storage area and toilets at the start/finish venue.
course_highlights: Location: peri-urban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro
15 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain
Aid stations and official timing on the 5+ km and 15 km courses
additional: Registration includes a personal bib number, official timing for the 5+ km and 15 km courses, medical support, a certificate of participation, an electronic commemorative certificate, a medal, a snack at the finish, and gifts for the three youngest participants in the 1 km race. There is a baggage storage area and toilets at the start/finish venue. Online registration has definitively closed. The full name will be printed on the bib number for those who registered by 22 March 2026. Courses: 1 km, 5+ km and 15 km; participation includes a personal bib number, official timing, medical support, a medal, gifts and baggage storage.

description: The Poikilo Rocky Mountain race takes place on Mount Poikilo in Attica, starting and finishing at Panorama Square in Petroupoli. It offers routes for everyone, from the 1 km children’s race to the longer 29 km and 18 km races, catering to runners of different levels. The event provides full support, including timing, live results, and participant amenities. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with awards and special packages for teams.
course_highlights: 29 km, 18 km, 10 km, and 4 km routes, plus a 1 km children’s race
Start and finish at Panorama Square in Petroupoli
A variety of routes in the mountainous surroundings of Mount Poikilo
additional: Group registration offers a €2 discount per athlete for teams of more than 10 people. The start pack includes a keepsake, race bib, timing chip, sponsor gifts, an energy bar, coffee, baggage storage, live results, and photography services. The race office is open the day before for the longer races and on race day for the shorter ones. The event includes a 1 km children’s race and a 4 km fun race, starting and finishing in Petroupoli. The event takes place on 11 April 2027, with an emphasis on sporting quality and environmental protection.

name: Sougliani Trail
description: The Sougliani Trail is a mountain running race held in Stavros, Thessaloniki. The course is a 50-kilometer figure-eight loop with 3,000 meters of positive elevation gain, offering a demanding and varied experience through mixed forests and natural landscapes. It includes trails, forest roads, and paved sections, with 7 aid stations and 6 checkpoints. The race starts in the center of Stavros, next to the park and Town Hall.
course_highlights: 50 km circular figure-eight course
Varied vegetation, including mixed evergreen and deciduous forests
3,000 meters of positive elevation gain, with 7 aid stations
additional: The race starts in the center of Stavros, Thessaloniki, next to the park and Town Hall. There are 7 aid stations and 6 checkpoints along the course. The course is 77% trail, 15% forest road, and 8% asphalt. The positive and negative elevation gain is 3,000 meters. The route crosses a variety of forest habitats with rare wildlife, including wolves and jackals. The event includes several race categories, registration is required, and the event also hosts other activities and trail races.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sporting event in Stara Zagora featuring trail running and mountain biking. Organized by the Zaratа Cycling and Tourism Club Association, with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality and TD Sarnena Gora, the competition offers various running and cycling distances in Ayazmoto Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Trail running and mountain biking in Ayazmoto Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km and 38 km (ultra)
eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course
additional: Registration and race-number pickup from 07:00 to 08:00. Cyclists must wear helmets. Payment is accepted only by bank transfer or at an EasyPay counter after online registration. The cycling courses will include an approximately 32 km hobby course and a 42 km ultra course; online registration, payment by bank transfer; valid insurance and helmets are required for cyclists.

name: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2026
location: Satul Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania
description: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA 2026 is an official endurance running competition organized by the TIME TRIAL RUNNING community, with the support of Chiajna Town Hall and local parishes. The event takes place in the village of Roșu, Chiajna commune, on April 17, 2026, starting at 14:00 at the sports hall of “Doamna Chiajna” Technological High School. It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single 6.706 km event alternating between two different courses, one by day and one by night. The challenge is to complete the course in under 60 minutes and be present for every hourly start; the last competitor remaining in the race is declared the winner.
course_highlights: A single 6.706 km distance, with two different courses completed alternately
Day course along the embankment/western side of Lake Morii
Night course on the streets of Roșu village and along the Chiajna commune Promenade
additional: The race starts on the hour, every hour, and participants must complete the course in under 60 minutes to continue. The base camp includes indoor facilities (the sports hall, with changing rooms and toilets) and outdoor space (the park with synthetic grass). Food and hydration are available in the start/finish area, and hot meals will be served according to the schedule. Awards go to the winner (Last One Standing), second place (Assist), and the highest-placed woman (Last Woman Standing). Each participant receives a personalized trophy at the finish. The event features courses along the shores of Lake Morii and the Chiajna promenade, is limited to 100 competitors, and offers hot meals and personalized trophies.

description: The Dolichos Delphi–Olympia Road Race is a challenging 255-kilometer ultramarathon with a 48-hour duration. It starts in Delphi and finishes in Ancient Olympia. The course combines 60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails with 40% paved roads, crossing central Greece and the Peloponnese via the Rio–Antirrio Bridge. The mountainous route reaches an altitude of up to 1,100 meters, with significant elevation gain and loss. The race is organized by the OLYMPIOI sports club and invites runners to test their endurance in a pioneering Greek race.
course_highlights: A 255-kilometer route with a 48-hour duration
60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails; 40% paved roads
A mountainous route reaching up to 1,100 meters, with 5,420 meters of total elevation gain
additional: Included are transfers from Athens to Delphi and from Olympia to Athens; accommodation and meals in Ancient Olympia after the race; supplies and medical support during the race; transport in the event of withdrawal; a medal and commemorative certificate for finishers; and a guided tour of the archaeological site and museum of Ancient Olympia the following day. The race offers multiple distances (255 km, 144 km, and 111 km), with scenic surroundings and a challenging course, and takes place over three days in April. Support points and electronic tracking are available.

description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on the hiking trails of the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the area’s natural and historical heritage, linking Șoimoș and Șiria fortresses, as well as other points of interest, along its routes. The courses offer an adventurous experience amid spring scenery and a medieval atmosphere, and are suitable for both amateur and professional runners. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars.
course_highlights: Mountain routes featuring hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation gains: 445 m (9 km), 1026 m (22 km), 2075 m (44 km)
additional: Participant kits are guaranteed for registrations made by April 12, 2026. The routes are marked with tape and arrows, and participants must pass through all checkpoints. Medical assistance and route monitoring are provided. On-site registration is available only for the 9 km cross-country race and the 22 km half marathon, without a guaranteed kit. Cancellations made by 28.02.2026 receive a 50% refund of the participation fee. The routes include hiking trails in the Zărand Mountains, with details about registration and participation requirements; the event takes place on April 18, 2026.

name: Maratonul Argonauților
location: Dobrogea Gorges, Gura Dobrogei, Constanța County, Romania
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, a scenic area in Romania. The marathon course has 1,600 metres of positive elevation gain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and offers participants a unique experience in nature on routes that showcase the beauty of Dobrogea’s nature reserves. In addition to the marathon, other races are held, including a half marathon, a cross-country race, a family race, and the Cheile Circuit, catering to a broad range of runners. The marathon has a tradition and a story inspired by the Argonauts, heroes of Greek mythology, which adds a special charm to the competition.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 1,600 metres of positive elevation gain
Route through Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, protected nature reserves
Scenic landscapes and promotion of the local tourist route
additional: The event includes several races: Marathon, Chifu Ioan Half Marathon, Cross-Country Race, Family Race, and Cheile Circuit. The organizer is the Activ Pontica Sports Association. The routes are promoted as part of Dobrogea’s natural and tourist heritage. The event promotes local tourism and Dobrogea’s natural beauty, with varied routes and multiple race categories.

description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

description: The Ypsilanteios Road Race in Nea Trapezounta, Pieria, is a sporting event offering three routes for everyone: a 10-kilometer race, a 1.1 km children’s race, and a 5.3 km walking route. The 10 km course is challenging, with elevation changes and beautiful views of Mount Olympus. It starts and finishes in the central square of Nea Trapezounta. The children’s race and walking route offer opportunities for younger participants and non-competitive runners. The event provides participants with medals, a light meal, and juice, while timing is overseen by the organizing committee. With medical coverage and a Pontian celebration after the race, it is a festival for the local community and runners.

Medical coverage is provided by the Samaritans and Rescuers Volunteer Corps of the Hellenic Red Cross. A parent or guardian’s declaration of consent is required for minors participating in the children’s race. The awards ceremony begins at 19:00, followed by awards and a Pontian celebration. Three routes: 10 km, children’s race 1.1 km, and walking route 5.3 km. The race has +155 meters of elevation gain and a challenging course. Registration is on race day. Medal, meal, juice, manual timing, and medical coverage.

Spectacular landscapes and promotion of the local tourist route

The course includes trail terrain, registration details, the event schedule, and post-race activities.

Electronic timing and medical support throughout the event

My Adventure, with many years of experience organizing sporting events in Epirus, supports the event, bringing together the area’s natural surroundings and mountainous terrain. The race is for runners who want to enjoy nature and an athletic challenge in a beautiful mountain landscape.

The natural surroundings of the village of Koutselio
Event held under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina

The Municipality of Servia actively supports the event and invites volunteers to help make it a success. Mountain running in a natural setting
additional: The Municipality of Servia is calling for volunteers to support the race. The event takes place in a natural setting with a strong mountain character at the foothills of the Pieria Mountains. The race is held on trails with gorges and forests; volunteer support, free participation and medical care, online registration, and a race in a natural setting with historic monuments.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιστίμπεη
location: Οχυρό Ιστίμπεη, Νέο Πετρίτσι, Σιντική, Σέρρες, Greece
description: The 5th Istibey Sacrifice Run is a 14-kilometer mountain race with 600 meters of positive elevation gain, held at Istibey Fort, near Neo Petritsi, Serres. The race is organized by the Friends of Istibey Fort Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Sintiki, as part of the 85th anniversary of the Battle of the Forts. The event aims to preserve historical memory through sport and showcase the area’s natural wealth. The course passes over the surface of the forts of the Metaxas Line, where defenders faced the German war machine in 1941.
course_highlights: 14.6 km mountain race with positive elevation gain
Course at Istibey Fort and along the Metaxas Line
Passes historic sites from the Battle of the Forts
additional: The race takes place on the Greek-Bulgarian border, in the northern part of Serres Prefecture. The event commemorates the Battle of the Forts and showcases the area’s natural wealth. No information was found about entry fees or the registration process. Routes of approximately 14 km and 600 m; historical and cultural significance; includes a race with historical and cultural character; routes with GPS and smartwatch; start at 10:00 a.m.

name: Lake Plastiras Trail
description: Lake Plastiras Trail is a festive mountain-running event held in the beautiful Lake Plastiras area of Karditsa, Greece. The race routes cross the historic Agrafa mountain range, offering unique natural scenery, varied terrain, and significant elevation gain. The race starts at the Botanical Garden of the Municipality of Lake Plastiras, beside the lake, and participants can enjoy routes that combine trails, dirt roads, and asphalt. The event promotes sport, recreation, and the natural environment and local history of the area.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
Significant elevation gain with views of Lake Plastiras and the Agrafa mountains
Start and finish at the Botanical Garden of Neochori, on the lakeshore
additional: The event includes five races: 42 km (+2,400 m elevation gain), starting at 08:00; 23 km (+1,150 m elevation gain), starting at 10:00; 10 km (+100 m elevation gain), starting at 11:00; 5 km (+100 m elevation gain), on Saturday 18/4 at 18:00; and a 600 m children's race at 11:10. Water and refreshment stations are available. The 23 km route includes a technical descent and reaches its highest point at 1,808 m. The 5 km route is a loop and is suitable for beginners. The event promotes health, recreation, and the natural environment and local history. It includes routes with technical challenges, participants from Greece and abroad, and safety and health programs. Activities and accommodation options are also available in the area.

name: 10ο No Finish Line Athens
description: No Finish Line Athens is the largest charity running event in Greece, combining sport, recreation, and social contribution. Participants run or walk freely for 100 hours, recording kilometres that are converted into funds to support children’s programmes through the “Together for Children” Association. The event takes place at Pedion tou Areos and is a leading social and sporting event, attracting many participants and making a significant contribution to society.
course_highlights: Held at Pedion tou Areos
100-hour duration, with participants free to choose when and how far they take part
Charitable event where kilometres are converted into financial support
additional: The event lasts 100 hours, and participants can run or walk whenever they wish, with no time or distance limit. It is supported by the international organisation No Finish Line International and the “Together for Children” Association. It has had a strong social impact, with more than 50,000 participants since 2017 and significant funding for children’s programmes. The event includes various races, with the goal of recording more than 100,000 kilometres, and takes place at Pedion tou Areos, emphasising collective effort and social contribution.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletic talents. The tournament takes place at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of different ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series
Memorial tournament honoring Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Khristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in the natural surroundings of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event features mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, giving participants and guests the chance to enjoy the region’s nature and landmarks. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers a range of distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at people who enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with checkpoints and time limits for the longer distances
Running and cycling events held on two separate days
Opportunity to visit local landmarks and enjoy evening entertainment between the event days
additional: The race includes children’s starts over short distances, cut-off times, and stops at set kilometre points for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). Cycling distances range from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at Acad. N. Haytov Square in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The events include mountain running and cycling over various distances; participation is subject to rules covering equipment and physical fitness. Online registration is available, with different participant categories.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000-Metre Track Championship in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s top athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometre track distance. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: A track race over the classic 10,000 m distance
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s national sports calendar
additional: The first national 10,000 m track championship in Hisarya is included in the 2026 sports calendar.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and no-kill shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to the 21 km half marathon. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social interaction.
course_highlights: Course: 50% asphalt and 50% gravel park paths
Aid stations at different kilometer points depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Race bib pickup is available April 21–23, from 9:00 to 19:00, in the South Wing of the Rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and awards ceremony. Games, raffles, opportunities for social interaction, and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and many prizes.

description: La Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by the Alergotura Sports Club Association in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances on scenic routes through the Petro Vaselo vineyard. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience on well-marked courses with aid stations, in a friendly and well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, offered on presentation of their race number.
course_highlights: Nature running routes through the vineyard, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route consists of two laps of the 14 km route, with the second lap run in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at direction-change points
additional: Participants should arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. The 14 km and 28 km races start at 09:00, and the 5 km race starts at 09:15. Each race has a finish time limit (5 km – 10:15, 14 km – 11:05, 28 km – 13:00). After the race, participants receive goulash and wine on presentation of their race number. Depending on the weather, parts of the routes may be muddy. Transfers between races are permitted before the start, subject to availability. Participants can register and check the participant list online; the event combines sport with the vineyard scenery of the Recaș area.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run Bucharest is an untimed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are showered with colored powder at every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the finish. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas, offering a festive experience for all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, featuring special moments such as the colored powder cloud and live music.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas of Bucharest
Colored-powder stations at every kilometer
A colored powder cloud at the finish, accompanied by music
additional: Race kits can be picked up at Mega Mall Bucharest between April 18 and 24, with extended hours. Access to the event area begins at 12:00, staggered starts take place between 14:00 and 14:20, and the colored powder cloud takes place from 16:00 to 16:15. Children aged 0–6 can participate for free without a kit, and multiple participants can be registered by adding them to the form. The event is untimed and open to all ages; people with disabilities also receive free access. The route includes urban areas; registration includes medals and colored powder; the event has multiple start waves and kit pickup points.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The 5th edition of Maratonul Codrului is an event organized by Club Sportiv Pro Racers and the Romanian Cycling Federation, taking place on 25 April 2026 at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition for both amateurs and professionals, featuring MTB and Trail Run events on spectacular forest routes, with challenges for all levels. The event offers new, more challenging MTB routes, as well as hobby events with shorter routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants receive a race pack, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, a pasta party, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, without the road section in the final 5 km
Varied Trail Run routes from 6 km to 43.5 km, with significant climbs
Kids Race for children, with a 2 km route and 70 m of elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race pack with a race number and sponsor products, on-course photos, hydration points along the route and at the finish, emergency medical and mountain rescue services, timing, a finisher medal, and a pasta party. Routes may be modified up until race day. MTB and Trail Run routes, age categories, online registration, finisher medals, technical T-shirts, an event for families and the community

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a moderately difficult trail running competition held in the deciduous forest near the city of Marghita. The event is organized by Clubul Sportiv Run For Freedom together with Clubul Sportiv XTERRA Sport Bihor and offers four different routes suited to various levels of runners. The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are clearly marked along forest roads. The competition promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on properly marked forest roads
Moderate elevation gains: 460 m for the half marathon, 230 m for the cross, and 20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through registration; it costs 100 lei and must be purchased separately. Participants under 18 must present a medical certificate and parental consent. Organizers may withdraw competitors who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is available exclusively through the official webshop. Trail-running routes in the forest, three different routes, organized by local sports clubs, first edition in spring 2022

name: RotaRUN for Charity

The event on April 25, 2026, includes 3 km and 9 km races and a 2-hour race, giving participants the opportunity to run for a good cause and help create a modern, welcoming environment for children with cancer. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, race bib, and timing chip, as well as access to hydration and refreshment stations. All funds raised from entry fees go toward completing the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department.
course_highlights: Running course along the Someș Promenade, Cluj-Napoca
3 km race (one lap of the course) and RotaRun 9 km (three laps of the course)
Long Run — a 2-hour endurance race

Participants receive a race bib and timing chip, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and supplements. The top three male and female finishers in each race will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age group. The event also supports the purchase of modern furniture and medical equipment for the Pediatric Oncology Department, as a community fundraising and awareness project.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.

30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.

The event on 25 April 2026 aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race, all held along the Someș Promenade, with the start and finish near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds collected from registration fees go directly to the charity project.

3 km run (one lap) and RotaRun 9 km (three laps)
Long Run — a 2-hour race covering the maximum distance possible
additional: T-shirt size is guaranteed for registrations made by 10 April 2026; after that, sizes are allocated while supplies last. Participants receive a race number and timing chip, access to hydration and refreshment stations, and photos at the start/finish and along the route. The top three male and female finishers in each event will be awarded prizes in both the Open and age categories. The event supports the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department; details about the route and registration are expected to be announced soon.

The event takes place in Recaș, Romania, and features three races on scenic vineyard trails, covering 5 km, 14 km and 28 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere supported by the community and local partners, with refreshment stations and a chance to socialise after the race. The routes are well marked and designed for comfort and safety, and the event is organised with the support of local authorities and sponsors.

Transfers between races are permitted before the start, subject to availability. The event includes trail activities and cultural races, and is open to runners of all levels. description: 140 BPM is a running race held in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău) in Bucharest, scheduled for April 25, 2026. The event offers routes for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.

6 km route for adults (Tortoises) – one 6 km loop
Located in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău), an attractive urban natural setting

The event has a history of previous editions in the same park, with photo galleries and results available online. The event also includes results and photo galleries from previous editions, offering an opportunity to socialize and promote an active lifestyle.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail: Trail of Strength is a demanding race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 m of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija’s hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Zamah course: 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain
Highest point: Cerovi Peak at 775 m; lowest point: 330 m
additional: Race-pack collection is available only on race day, from 08:00 to 09:45 in the start area. Time limits are 5h30min for Prkos and 3h30min for Zamah. The race pack includes a medal, a dry-fit shirt, a chip-equipped race bib, refreshments, professional photos, a marked course, aid stations, and a surprise lunch. Prizes are prepared for the top finishers on the shorter course, separately for men and women. The event is scheduled for 25 April 2026, at Kragujevac / Adžine Livade. More information will be available on the organizer’s Instagram page.

description: Staza snage is a trail race in the beautiful natural surroundings of Adžine Livade, for runners who want to push their limits and experience challenging terrain. The race has two courses: Prkos, 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, and Zamah, 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain. The course combines steep climbs and technical descents down water channels, requiring sure footing, concentration, and courage. At the finish, the winner is not the fastest runner, but the one who has conquered the course and its strength. The race starts on April 25, 2026, in Adžine Livade: the longer course starts at 10:00 and the shorter one at 10:30.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Zamah course: 8.0 km with 450 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Technical descents down water channels requiring sure footing and concentration
additional: Each participant receives a race pack with a race number and chip, a T-shirt, refreshments at checkpoints and the finish, a marked course, a GPX track, and a finisher medal. No additional registration is available after registration closes or on race day. Course distances: 17.5 km and 8 km; elevation gain up to 1,000 m; technical terrain; registration via the MyRace.rs platform. Race packs include T-shirts, medals, and a marked course.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometres long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 metres, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course distance: 34 km
Total elevation gain: 1,837 metres
Mountain terrain in western Serbia
additional: Early registration offers discounts before 25 March 2026, and the race is part of a series of events promoting nature and outdoor activities in the region.

name: Η Μάχη στο Λεβίδι 14-04-1821 «Αναγνώστης Δημήτριος Στριφτόμπολας»
organizer: Δήμος Τρίπολης, Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Αρκαδίας, Σύνδεσμος Σωματικής Αγωγής
description: The Municipality of Tripoli, in cooperation with the SEGAS Regional Association of the Peloponnese, the Arcadia Gymnastics Club, and the “Orchomenos” Physical Education Association, is organizing road races and a power-walking event under the name “The Battle of Levidi 14-04-1821 (Anagnostis Dimitrios Striftompolas).” The races are dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turkish occupiers, which took place in Levidi 205 years ago. The event includes 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes and takes place in Levidi’s central square. The event honors the historic victory and offers a celebration of sport and remembrance for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes in Levidi’s central square
Dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turks in 1821
A historic and sporting event with a strong local and cultural character
additional: Race schedule: 16:00 registration opens and race packs are distributed; 18:00 start of the 10 km; 18:10 start of the 5 km; 19:20 start of the 1,000 m; 19:45 finish line closes; 19:50 awards ceremony; 20:15 event concludes with a celebration and recognition of the historic battle. Routes through a historic area, entries in various age categories, start and finish in Levidi, with commemorative gifts and cultural activities.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is Bulgaria’s largest spring mountain running event, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a beginner-friendly 10 km race, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The courses pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, the Balkan Mountains, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by Begach Sports Club and attracts more participants every year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain through Lozen Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain to Mount Bachun
10 km courses with around 100 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Race kits can be collected on the Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. There are aid stations and medical assistance along the courses. The race provides no cups, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A bag drop is available, but the organizers are not responsible for lost belongings. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are stationed at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear their race bib on their chest or abdomen. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hiking; an event focused on nature and social activities; date: April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of Bankya and heading toward Ostra Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which features a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The figure-eight course starts on the northern outskirts of Bankya
Each loop is 6.4 km long with 217 m of elevation gain
Choose one or two loops (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course was designed by Miroslav Spasov. The race is held at the site of a spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar, alongside other events in Sofia and across the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The course crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is excellent strength and endurance training, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.

Panoramic views of Sofia and an opportunity to rest and refuel at Kamen Del Hut

Competition for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation

description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.
course_highlights: Routes along marked trails in Rășinari and the hills at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains
Varied terrain: asphalt, forest roads, natural trails, and meadows
Picturesque spring scenery at the foot of the mountains
additional: Participation is at your own risk, and participants must sign a liability waiver. The minimum age is 14 for the Fuguț race and 18 for the Cros, Semi, Maraton, and Ultra Maraton races. Children under 14 may participate in dedicated races. The registration pack is not mailed. The organizer may prohibit a participant from starting or continuing the race if they are not in suitable physical condition. The event also includes cultural activities, hikes, and a local products fair, offering an opportunity to discover the traditions and beauty of the Rășinari area.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering both a challenge and the pleasure of enjoying the natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to take part and enjoy running together, the results, and socializing at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.
course_highlights: A 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac
A route through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened trail
Significant uphill and downhill sections
additional: Race-pack pickup from 7:00 to 8:30 in Gornji Milanovac. Organized transport to the start in Takovo at 8:30. Refreshments during and after the race. Awards ceremony at 12:30 in central Gornji Milanovac. Participants run at their own risk. The event includes timekeeping, medals, T-shirts, and other logistical arrangements for participants.

description: The 3rd Pallini Run is a sporting and cultural gathering held in Pallini, Attica, offering 5 km and 10 km road races as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The race takes place on a World Athletics-certified course, mostly through beautiful Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves, on paved routes with gentle elevation changes. The start is at Eleftherias Square in Pallini, at 8:30 a.m. The event is supported by local clubs and has a charitable purpose. Participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration during the race.
course_highlights: World Athletics-certified course
Routes through Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves
Paved routes with gentle elevation changes
additional: Registration is online only and requires a debit or credit card. No registrations are accepted on race day. Group registration is available, with special rates for families with many children. All participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration. Paved routes with gentle elevation changes; participation from age 6 with parental consent; registration open until April 15, 2026; no race-day registration.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Ορεινού Τρεξίματος «Αλέξανδρος Παναγούλης»
description: The 5th “Alexandros Panagoulis” Mountain Running Race in Sivros, Lefkada, is a celebration of sport and nature, offering a unique experience on trails filled with springs and lush green landscapes. The race honors the memory of Alexandros Panagoulis and attracts athletes of all ages who enjoy the mountain course and friendly atmosphere. The event is marked by energy, smiles, and impressive performances, creating an unforgettable sporting experience.
course_highlights: Trails among springs and lush green landscapes
Mountain course in Sivros, Lefkada
An event honoring Alexandros Panagoulis
additional: An event focused on safety, hospitality, and showcasing the area’s natural beauty, with online registration and detailed results.

name: 8ο Kissavos Marathon Race Ευάγγελος Κουμπάρος
description: The Kissavos Marathon Race «Evangelos Koumbaros» is an annual mountain running race held in the area of Agia, Larissa. The route starts from Agia’s central square and crosses enchanting forest trails, picturesque mountain villages and natural springs, reaching the summit of Kissavos at 1,978 metres, with stunning views of the Aegean Sea. The race offers a unique experience in a protected forest of outstanding natural beauty, included in the NATURA 2000 network. The event also includes shorter routes and a children’s race, with full support and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Route through fairytale forests of fir, beech, oak and chestnut trees
Natural springs and picturesque mountain villages with squares and small chapels
Kissavos summit at 1,978 metres, with views of the Aegean Sea
additional: ITRA and UTMB scoring. Amenities: distance-marker signs, medical support, a medal for all participants, chip timing for net times, refreshments at numerous points, and food, dessert and fruit for athletes. The race will take place on 2 May 2027 in Agia, Larissa, with online registration through the official website. It includes various routes on mountain terrain, highlighting the area’s natural beauty.

name: 10ο Run For All
description: The 10th Papagou–Holargos City Road Race «RUN4ALL» is an annual event that honors World Autism Awareness Day and promotes the participation of people with intellectual disabilities and congenital heart conditions. The race includes a 1 km route for children and 5 km and 10 km races for adults and students, with electronic timing and commemorative gifts for all participants. Proceeds support the «Champs» basketball teams of the Holargos Basketball Club, which are for children on the autism spectrum. The event takes place in the Municipality of Papagou–Holargos and offers residents a 50% discount with a special coupon.
course_highlights: A 1 km children’s route, with children on the autism spectrum taking part
5 km and 10 km races with electronic timing and rankings
Event in the Municipality of Papagou–Holargos, supported by local sports clubs
additional: A 50% discount is available to residents of Papagou–Holargos with coupon DC2550. Primary and middle-school students can take part in the 1 km children’s race free of charge. All participants receive a technical T-shirt, medal, water, snack, and surprises. Group registration requires two steps: payment and submission of participants’ details before the race. Distances: 5 km and 10 km, plus a 1 km children’s route. Water and snacks are provided, along with medals and commemorative gifts. A doctor and ambulance will be present.

name: 17ος Διεθνής Ποσειδώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
price_range: 35€ - 50€ (ανάλογα με την ημερομηνία εγγραφής και το πακέτο)
description: The 17th International Poseidonios Half Marathon in Palaio Faliro offers beautiful, fast seaside routes, ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes parallel races such as a relay, a quarter marathon, a 5 km race, fitness walking and a children’s race, creating a celebration of sport and social contribution. Participants receive high-quality technical T-shirts and can download race certificates and photos. The event supports runners’ comfort and keeps them informed with a digital registration assistant and a full race schedule.
course_highlights: Beautiful, fast routes beside the sea
Routes for the half marathon, relay, quarter marathon and 5 km race
Race-pack collection at the Palaio Faliro Municipal Indoor Gymnasium
additional: Race-pack collection takes place at the Palaio Faliro Municipal Indoor Gymnasium “Sofia Befon.” Participants receive a high-quality technical T-shirt, and children and adults receive cotton T-shirts. A digital registration assistant, “Floisvos,” is available for immediate support. After the race, runners can download their performance certificates and photos from the official results website. Routes pass notable landmarks such as the Battleship Averof and Flisvos Marina, with the start and finish at the Palaio Faliro Municipal Sports Center. There are parallel races and events, as well as online registration and photography activities.

name: 17o Μονοπάτι Παρνασσού
description: The 17th Parnassos Trail is a major mountain-running celebration held in Amfikleia, Phthiotis. The event includes seven races for all ages and fitness levels, with routes starting and finishing in 25th of March Square. The two-day event features children’s races, the Amfikleia City Trail through the traditional settlement’s narrow lanes, and mountain races of 6, 12, and 25 kilometers with significant elevation gain. The event combines sporting activity with local tradition and natural beauty, offering participants a comprehensive experience.
course_highlights: Technical 25 km mountain route with 1,610 m of elevation gain
4 km route through the cobbled lanes of the traditional settlement of Amfikleia
A variety of races for all ages and fitness levels
additional: All races start and finish in 25th of March Square in Amfikleia. Race registration is located in the courtyard of the Cultural Center in the square. Saturday afternoon features children’s races and the Amfikleia City Trail, followed by a Pasta Party for participants in the evening. Awards are presented on Saturday evening for the children’s races and City Trail, and on Sunday afternoon for the mountain races. The event also includes children’s races, online registration, and supporting events such as a pasta party. The event takes place on April 25 and 26, 2026, with the aim of promoting sport and nature.

name: 20ός Διεθνής Μαραθώνιος «Μέγας Αλέξανδρος»
description: The Alexander the Great International Marathon covers the route from Pella, the ancient capital of Macedonia and birthplace of Alexander the Great, to Thessaloniki, the modern Greek metropolis. It is a race that combines sport with history and culture, offering a unique experience along a route steeped in Greece and ancient Greek civilization. The marathon is a major international sporting event, with accompanying activities and races for all ages and categories.
course_highlights: Route from ancient Pella to Thessaloniki
Beautiful scenery and historic sites along the route
A combination of sport and culture
additional: Road races of 1,000 m are offered for primary school students, along with 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Panhellenic Marathon Championship for athletes with disabilities. There are accompanying activities, information sessions, and cultural events. Group registration is available for teams of 10 people or more. Technical instructions and participation certificates are provided. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races and a marathon, as well as accompanying activities and exhibitions.

name: Ηετιώνιος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The Hetionian Dapetsona Road Race, under the auspices of the Municipality of Keratsini-Drapetsona and the Region of Attica, invites runners of all ages to take part in a celebration of sport and culture. The route starts at the old Drapetsona town hall and is designed with respect for the area’s historical and cultural heritage. With a friendly atmosphere and excellent organization, the race offers an opportunity to participate, stay healthy, and share a sense of community. Routes are available for adults, children, and people with disabilities, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the old Drapetsona town hall
5 km route heading east
Children’s race and 500-meter race for people with disabilities
additional: The time limit for the 5 km route is 1 hour, after which runners proceed at their own risk. Participants under 18 need a declaration of consent from a parent or guardian. Registration is not available on race day. Ceremonies and results at a local event, participation in various categories, and respect for the area’s history and culture.

name: Go Kea
description: GO KEA is an exciting two-day sporting event combining trail running and open-water swimming on the beautiful island of Kea. The event aims to offer an authentic experience of sport and connection with nature, establishing Kea as a unique sporting destination. The two-day event brings together athletes and enthusiasts from across Greece and abroad, offering a variety of activities in a captivating Cycladic landscape.
course_highlights: Trail running on Kea’s natural trails
Open-water swimming in the island’s clear waters
A connection with nature and the unique Cycladic landscape
additional: The event is organized in collaboration with GOEvents. Information is provided about ferry routes from Lavrio to Kea and local transportation. You can sign up for a mailing list to receive updates about the Municipality of Kea and its events. The event includes trail running and open-water swimming routes, with an emphasis on safety, preparation, and enjoying nature. Participants can register in advance and enjoy a complete outdoor activity experience.

name: 2o Rodopi Backyard Ultra
description: The Rodopi Backyard Ultra is a demanding backyard ultra held in the Komotini area. It is an endurance race in which runners must complete repeated 6.7-kilometer laps every hour until only one winner remains. The course is mountainous and showcases the unique natural beauty of the Rhodope region, combining technical trails with changes in elevation. The race is organized by the Rodopi Runners club, which ensures smooth organization and supports participants.
course_highlights: Mountain course with technical trails
Repeated 6.7-kilometer laps every hour
Unique natural beauty of the Rhodope region
additional: The race is run in one-hour cycles, with runners required to complete the 6.7 km lap within the hour to continue. Refreshments are available along the course, and the organizer provides support. Race regulations governing safety and participation are available on the official website. The event takes place outdoors on a competitive course, with an emphasis on endurance and participant support. The event includes organizational and medical support.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and runs through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized course with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat course suitable for all levels
Runs alongside the Maritsa River and relaxation areas with water views
The 10 km course consists of 2 laps of the park
additional: Race packs can be collected in advance on May 1 from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. The starts are on May 2: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and the 1 km children’s run at 10:20. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at 11:40. 40% of entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, while the winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. Sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a prize raffle are planned. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kodzha Kaya is the first fully self-supported ultramarathon in Bulgaria, held in the village of Bilka, in the area of Mount Kodzha Kaya. The race offers a range of distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. It is an event for adventure and mountain-running enthusiasts that leaves a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4,400 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
42 km marathon with over 2,700 m of elevation gain and no aid stations
30 km Sky with 1,950 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
additional: All distances are fully self-supported, with no aid stations. There is also an additional challenge: a vertical climb up Kodzha Kaya, 3.6 km with 500 m of elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural setting rich in flora and fauna, offering stunning views and challenging terrain. The race is held on May 1–2, 2026, and participants can choose from a range of distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to age 14, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, paths, river, relaxation area, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is available online or on site on the event day, subject to the availability of race bibs. Late registration is available after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and cash and in-kind prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children’s race and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and the community.

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, Semimaraton, 5 km
