description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is a trail-running event held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture and fun, offering an opportunity to escape the everyday and enjoy the beauty of nature with loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony and themed workshops for all ages.
course_highlights: Routes through nature reserves, hills and meadows
Areas with waterfalls and caves unique to the region
Natural setting between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, at an altitude of 700–1,400 m
additional: Race kit distribution on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. Starts in order: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) at 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) at 09:30, and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m) at 10:00. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00. The event includes themed workshops for children and adults during breaks. Participation includes various race categories, with details about registration requirements and the schedule; all are scheduled for May 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run organized in the heart of the Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolorului Square, bringing together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and the race celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.
course_highlights: Start in Tricolorului Square, in the historic center of Târgoviște
Urban course with views of the Citadel and Chindia Tower
Event for all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The start area is in Tricolorului Square, Târgoviște. The event has a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, with a recommendation to bring suitable shoes and plenty of stamina. The event is part of Carpat Race and is supported by the local community, offering an opportunity to promote health and physical activity in Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail-running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a friendly atmosphere, music, and a bar on site. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly terrain known as “Világlátó”
1.6 km lap with 60 m of elevation gain
2-, 4-, or 6-hour challenge, with a Nordic walking option
additional: Nordic walking poles are available in limited quantities by requesting them via email. There will be music and Wunderbar on site. Each participant receives a starter pack with a race bib and other promotional materials. The event combines running with a mental challenge, with participants aiming to complete as many laps as possible within their chosen time. A trail challenge with 1.6 km loops and running or Nordic walking options, held as part of Szent György Napok.

name: 14ο Corfu Mountain Trail
description: The 14th Corfu Mountain Trail is a series of four unique mountain running races held on the island of Corfu. The routes include the 103 km CMT Ultra, which climbs Mount Pantokrator; the 44 km Rain Trail; the 24 km Olive Tree Trail; and the 12 km Quick Trail, offering stunning views of the sea and traditional villages. Each race finishes in the heart of Corfu Town, at Liston, giving every runner a distinctive experience. The event works with the Municipality of Central Corfu and the Diapontia Islands to offer an unforgettable sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Climb to the island’s highest point, Mount Pantokrator
Routes pass through traditional villages and beaches overlooking the Adriatic Sea
Finish in the historic center of Corfu Town, at Liston
additional: The 103 km Ultra Trail starts in the village of Ipsos at 06:00, with transport from central Corfu. The other routes start on the same day, with transport from Liston. All races finish at Spianada Square in Corfu Town. RaceTracker is used for the 103 km and 44 km routes. A free children’s race takes place on Sunday, May 9. Multiple routes, scenic mountain and beach trails, registration through the official website from June 2025 to April 2026, a detailed schedule, and transport information.

name: ROC 50 Miles
description: The Rodopi Challenge 50 Miles (ROC) is an introductory 89-kilometre mountain ultra trail race with 4,800 metres of positive elevation gain, held every spring in the Rhodope mountain range by the non-profit company Rodopi Ultra Trail AMKE. The loop course starts and finishes at the Erymanthos Forest Village and passes through villages, primeval forests and mountain trails. The race is aimed at experienced athletes who want to be introduced to the spirit of ultra trail racing, offering a demanding and unique mountain-running experience. The race starts early in the morning, and participants have a time limit of 19.5 hours to finish.
course_highlights: 89-kilometre course: 72% trails, 25% dirt roads and 3% paved roads
Total positive elevation gain of 4,800 metres
Passes through primeval forests, villages and mountain trails of outstanding natural beauty
additional: Maximum of 300 participants. The race closes at 00:30 on the same day, allowing a time limit of 19.5 hours. To participate, runners must have finished or withdrawn from a mountain-running race of at least 40 kilometres after 1/1/2024. The course is part of the ROUT Classic 100 miles and is a loop. The race includes routes on natural trails and offers accommodation options at campsites and hotels, with access mainly by road and rail. Family events and other shorter-distance routes are also available.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: Полумаратон, Полумаратон, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gain, challenging participants with a true mountain experience. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and in-kind prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain ranging from 420 m to 1,640 m
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets will be distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at Olympic Square. Participants under 16 may take part only in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and the prizes for the top three places are cash and in-kind prizes. Participants are advised to complete the participation declarations in advance. Payment is currently accepted only by bank transfer. The distances are 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km, with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1,640 m, respectively; the start and finish are at Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses run through mountain and forest terrain.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as boys and girls under 20, under 18 and under 16, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18 and 16
Held in the scenic area of Chepelare
additional: For any questions, participants should contact the organizer directly at the email address provided to them. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is held with official support. It is part of the national mountain running calendar and offers the opportunity to compete in different age categories.

name: 1ο Φάλανθος Trail
description: Falanthos Trail is the first mountain running race on Mount Mainalo, organized by the Arcadian Mountaineers Ecologists Association. The race highlights the rich natural and cultural environment of mountainous Arcadia, promoting the protection of biodiversity and the landscape. The course makes use of Mainalo’s extensive trail network, offering a unique experience for runners and hikers. Falanthos Trail 29km is an official qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon, confirming the race’s quality and prestige.
course_highlights: 29 km course through Mainalo’s dense trail network
Rich natural and cultural environment of mountainous Arcadia
Official qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon
additional: The race promotes the protection of the natural environment and biodiversity. There are parallel 11 km hiking routes alongside the running races. A technical T-shirt is available; CHIP timing, water stations, refreshments, medical coverage, registration with a card and chip, and limited entries (150 for 29km, 200 for 11km, 100 for 11km hikers).

name: 3ος Εργατικός Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 3rd Workers’ People’s Road Race, organized by the Athens and Piraeus Labour Centres, is a race with historical and political significance, dedicated to the memory of the 200 communists executed in Kaisariani on May Day 1944. The route starts at the Haidari Camp and finishes at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, honoring their sacrifice and keeping historical memory alive. The race has been embraced by the unions and is open to everyone who wants to follow in the footsteps of History. The race starts early in the morning, and all participants receive commemorative medals. The top three men and women in the overall standings are awarded.
course_highlights: Route from Haidari Camp to the Kaisariani Shooting Range
Historical and political event dedicated to the 200 executed communists
Commemorative event with awards and medals
additional: The race starts at Haidari Camp “Karaiskaki A” – Block 15 and finishes at the Kaisariani Shooting Range. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 11 a.m. PAME invites people to participate. All finishers receive commemorative medals. Ceremonies and road race, with registration open until April 30; finish at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, awards and commemorative medals.

name: 5o Pamvotis View Trail
description: The 5th Pamvotis View Trail is a mountain-running race held in Drosocori, Ioannina, offering two routes against the backdrop of the enchanting Lake Pamvotis and the area's impressive mountains. The start and finish are in the village square, and the routes pass scenic spots such as Mavili, Driskos, Gerakari, and Iliokali. The race is open to runners of all levels, offering a unique experience of nature and adventure near the city of Ioannina. The organizers provide medical coverage and aid stations to ensure participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Two routes: 21 km with +1,150 m elevation gain and 9 km with +420 m elevation gain
Aid stations at 6, 13, and 17 km on the 21 km route
Potable water springs at 7, 15, and 19 km on the 21 km route
additional: Medical coverage is provided by volunteers from the Ioannina Red Cross and a private doctor, with a portable defibrillator available. Participants must be over 18; minors need a signed parental declaration and must be accompanied by a parent. Routes have aid stations and medical coverage from the Red Cross and a private doctor, with time limits of 2 and 5 hours to finish, respectively.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Λιμένων Μεγάρων – Νέας Περάμου
location: Λιμάνι Νέας Περάμου, Νέα Πέραμος, Μεγαρέα, Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 9th Megara–Nea Peramos Ports Road Race is a sporting celebration organized by the Local Councils of the Municipal Communities of Megara and Nea Peramos, in collaboration with the Deputy Mayor for Sports & the New Generation of the Municipality of Megara and the “Athinaioi Dromeis” athletic club. It features 9- and 18-kilometer routes, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race. The race aims to promote sports and showcase the area’s natural beauty and history. The race starts at the port of Nea Peramos and the port of Pachi, Megara, with a shared finish at the port of Pachi, Megara.
course_highlights: 9,050 m and 18,100 m routes
Start at the port of Nea Peramos (9 km) and the port of Pachi, Megara (18 km)
Shared finish at the port of Pachi, Megara
additional: Timing is electronic, using an RFID chip. Refreshment and water stations and medical support are provided. The time limit for the 18 km race is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Adults and minors with a signed parental consent form may participate. A 1,000 m children’s race is available for children born between 2014 and 2020. The event is organized in collaboration with local municipal bodies, with an emphasis on promoting sports and social cohesion at the port of Nea Peramos.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Πυθαγόρας ο Σάμιος
description: The 9th “Pythagoras the Samian” Half Marathon is a major sporting event held on Samos, starting at the Heraion’s Kolona. The race honors the memory of Pythagoras, the great philosopher and mathematician of antiquity, and attracts runners from all over Greece. The course offers a unique running experience in a historic and picturesque setting, combining sport and culture. The event is organized by the Directorate of Primary Education of Samos, which ensures the smooth running of the event and the safety of participants.
course_highlights: Start at the Heraion’s Kolona, a historic site on Samos
Course with views of the Aegean Sea
A blend of cultural and sporting surroundings
additional: Courses through natural and cultural sites, starting at the Heraion’s Kolona and finishing at Pythagoras Central Square, with water and isotonic drinks provided, as well as cultural activities.

name: 15η Ανοπαία Ατραπός
organizer: Δήμος Λαμιέων και Σύλλογος Δρομέων Φθιώτιδας
description: The 15th Anopaia Trail is a landmark mountain running race held at Thermopylae, an area of historical significance and natural beauty. The race is at the heart of mountain running in the region, offering a unique experience for runners who love a challenge and the outdoors. It is organized by the Municipality of Lamia, which supports the promotion of sport and the area’s natural environment. The event attracts runners from across Greece and is a celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Route through historic Thermopylae
Mountain scenery and striking natural beauty
Challenging terrain for mountain runners
additional: Technical T-shirt available, finish at a historic site, registration until April 24, 2026, written permission from a parent or guardian required, and online registration available.

name: 15ος Ιπποκράτειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 15th Hippocratic Road Race is a popular running event held in the city of Larissa, featuring a 10 km race, a 3 km Fun Run, and a 1,000-meter children’s race. The 10 km course is paved, with no significant climbs, and passes along the bed of the Peneus River and by city monuments, offering runners a beautiful experience. The race has a family-friendly character, and minors may participate under their parents’ responsibility. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, electronic timing, a commemorative medal, and water.
course_highlights: Paved course with no significant climbs
Route along the bed of the Peneus River
Passes by monuments in the city of Larissa
additional: What’s included: technical T-shirt, electronic timing, commemorative medal, and water. A parent/guardian declaration of responsibility is required for minors. The start and finish are at the Ancient Theatre of Larissa. The children’s race is free, with commemorative medals for all finishers. Registration is open until 27 April 2026; payment is made at the club’s offices. Entries are available in various categories and distances, with an emphasis on the region’s cultural and sporting traditions.

name: Εορδαία Run
description: Eordaia Run is an important sporting event hosted by the Municipality of Eordaia. The event aims to promote the values of sport, foster the spirit of fair play, and strengthen grassroots running. It includes a 10-kilometer road race and a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering an enjoyable sporting experience for all participants. The event emphasizes safety and the smooth running of the races, with transportation provided for runners and a registration desk for race-number collection.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race
1,000-meter children’s race
Bus transportation for runners from the community of Kryovrysi
additional: The registration desk opens at 15:30 for race-number collection. Buses transport runners from 16:15 to 16:45. Due to a date change, those who have already paid cannot participate and should contact the organizers by email for a refund. 10-kilometer road race and 1,000-meter children’s race, tradition and events, date: April 17, 2026, Ptolemaida, Greece

name: Run Greece Καβάλα
description: Run Greece Kavala is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 5 km races, a power walking event, and races for families and children. The event promotes sport and healthy living in the city of Kavala, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and levels. It is supported by SEGAS and is part of the national Run Greece programme. The start and finish are at central locations in the city, with safe and scenic routes.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes in an urban setting
Power walking and races for children and families
Organised event supported by SEGAS
additional: The event includes road races for adults, power walking, a Family Run, and races for children. It promotes the I Run Clean programme and safety in sport. There is a mobile app related to the race. Participants can register online, and race materials can be collected from the service centre in Kavala. The route includes two laps around the city, and the event promotes sport and social participation.

name: Voio Race Series – Μπούρινος
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, aiming to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion. The event is organized on a non-profit basis with the help of volunteers and is open to people over the age of 15. The courses are mountainous and offer an opportunity to walk, run, and enjoy nature. Taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph, promoting sport as an important part of life.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain courses
Promotion of health, well-being, and social responsibility
additional: People over the age of 15 may participate. Minors require parental consent. The event is organized with the help of volunteers and promotes social cohesion and environmental responsibility. Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, with varied courses and activities that support the local community and an active lifestyle.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow competitors.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop
Held in St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance: 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Each race day starts at 8:00. Each participant must wear a visible race number on the front. Laps are counted by a judge, who changes every six hours. A camera-based backup counting system is also in place. If a participant pauses the race or leaves the course, they must inform the judge. A “hotel lap” may be counted when leaving and rejoining the course at designated points. Alcohol consumption, smoking, and drug use are prohibited in the camp and on the course. A minimum running dress code applies in the park, and running shirtless is not permitted. Official results are published the following day at around 9:00 on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Course: paved track, 785 m; registration until 1 April 2026; personal assistant fee: 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Haydushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete to climb the iconic path from its starting point to the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel. The route offers several variations of differing difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who climbs the path in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for lovers of mountain running and nature.
course_highlights: Climb the iconic Haydushka Path in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with several variations—the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder’s name is added to a special sign at the start of the path. Results for participants with a time under 1 hour are published on the website of the Old Elm Foundation. The event features trail running on different routes and has no categories or prizes, with an emphasis on personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honour of Haji Dimitar’s birthday and St. George’s Day—the Day of Bravery. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a vojvoda. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, with alpine-type terrain
The course follows ancient hajduk trails and passes near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
An area with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the Old Elm Foundation’s traditional patriotic initiatives and is held in honour of historical figures and events connected with the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Sinite Kamani Nature Park Information Centre; competitions include stone and knife throwing. Participants are encouraged to wear traditional folk costumes.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding courses and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurous spirits, offering a unique experience across forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, promise a great atmosphere and smooth organization for all participants.
course_highlights: Courses through the forests and mountains of Western Serbia
Challenging climbs and technical sections of the course
Beautiful natural landscapes and unspoiled nature
additional: The organizer is West Serbia Trails, known for putting on the best trail parties in Western Serbia.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Mladost” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This competition has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from different countries to compete in a range of track and field events. The tournament focuses on developing youth sport and offers talented athletes under 18 an opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize that registered performances are required for entry in some events, such as the girls’ long jump.
course_highlights: Competitions at the City Stadium in Ruse
International participation by boys and girls under 18
21 track and field events
additional: Registered performances are required to enter the girls’ under-18 long jump; competitors without them will not be admitted. The competition includes 21 events and more than 300 participants. Results and start lists are publicly available. The competition is open to young athletes under 18 and is part of their preparation for European championships and international competitions.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, crossing the Rui, Ezimir and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: The routes pass the peaks of Mali Rui, Orlovets and Rakitski Kamik, and the Erma River Gorge
Varied terrain: soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes and panoramic views
additional: All courses are circular, starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. There are aid stations with water and food along the courses, but cups are not provided. Every participant is covered by mandatory insurance. Medical staff and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. The courses are circular, with aid stations and medical assistance; participants must carry mandatory equipment and use GPS tracks. The race is part of a series of courses and is certified by ITRA.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and consists of three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final ascent via a via ferrata. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all proceeds go toward restoring the hut. It’s a chance to test yourself against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.
course_highlights: MTB cycling: 21 km with +350 m elevation gain
Running: 10 km with +220 m elevation gain
Final ascent via the newest via ferrata in Northern Bulgaria
additional: The start is in front of Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo village. Relay teams consist of two people, and the entry fee is for the whole team. Relay categories are men’s, women’s, and mixed. The event supports the restoration of Alpinist Hut. Courses: MTB 21 km, running 10 km, via ferrata; categories: individual and relay; location: Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo; date: May 9, 2026.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held near the village of Zheleznitsa, close to Sofia. The course is just over 5 km and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometre completed, Amusnet donates €5 to support Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 0–3 km: Flat and beautiful forest trail
3–4 km: A demanding climb of around 1 km
4–5+ km: Descent and a final sprint to the finish
additional: Professional timing, with results published after the event. Parking near the start is limited; participants are advised to use the large car park at the edge of the village, around 2 km from the start/finish area. Participation is free. The course is just over 5 km with varied terrain; support for Paralympians; registration via the form; limited parking capacity; prizes for participants and staff.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Trun Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the scenic Kraishte region, with the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality, as its hub. The race offers four courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, crossing the Ruй, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas. Organized by the Trun Tourist Association with the support of Trun Municipality, the race provides course markings, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.
course_highlights: Four loop courses of 14 km, 23 km, 43 km, and 64 km, with elevation gains from 700 to 3,300 meters
Routes through the Rui, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views
Varied terrain with soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas
additional: All courses are loop routes starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. Aid stations along the courses provide water and food, but cups are not provided. Mandatory insurance is taken out for every participant. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. Multiple courses of different lengths, with routes through scenic Bulgaria, are awaiting ITRA certification.

description: Thermal Trail Race is a trail running competition held in Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, on the scenic forest trails in the area. The event offers two races, one of 14 km and one of 7 km, suitable for different age groups and experience levels. The courses are well marked and offer a sporting experience in nature, with prizes for the top competitors. Participants benefit from electronic timing and an official event T-shirt.
course_highlights: The course follows the forest trails of Băile 1 Mai, with clear markings and signs
The start and finish are in the Betfia Sinkhole area (parking lot)
Timing with an electronic chip integrated into the race bib
additional: Awards for the top three finishers in the OPEN category and in the age categories. Timing with an electronic chip attached to the back of the race bib. Registration may be transferred to another person until 20 May 2026, for a fee of 25 lei. The participation fee is refundable until 10 May 2026, subject to a 25 lei deduction. The official event T-shirt is included. The trail running courses take place in the Betfia / Baile 1 Mai area, with registration fees in lei, based on the BNR exchange rate. The event date is set for 9 May 2026, and registration is open to participants from across the country and beyond.

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
location: Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud, Romania
description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is an outdoor running event for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. The event offers three different races: a 2 km course for children and families, an intermediate 5 km course with short climbs and forest paths, and a 10 km course for runners seeking an authentic trail-running challenge. Participants can enjoy a supportive atmosphere, socializing, and fair play, with hydration points along the courses and a Starter Kit included for the 5 km and 10 km races.
course_highlights: A 2 km course for children and families, with 1 hydration point
A 5 km course with short climbs, forest paths, and views of the hills around the city of Năsăud
A 10 km course with 2 hydration points, for runners who love authentic trail-running challenges
additional: The start and finish of each course are at Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Car access to the start is prohibited; the organizers provide minibuses from the parking area by the chapel in Năsăud (meeting point and parking). The courses are available on Strava, with GPX files available to download to a smartwatch or phone. The Starter Kit includes the official T-shirt and medal for 10K, the medal for 5K, and the certificate for 2K. First place in the 10K Challenge also receives 2 nights of accommodation at Casuțele din Plai. The event includes courses for all ages and levels, emphasizing nature, community, and fair play, with the start in Valea Caselor, Năsăud.

description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: a marathon, a half marathon, and a cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes of the Rimetea area in Alba. The routes pass through spectacular locations such as Piatra Secuiului, Colțești Fortress, Plaiului Gorge, and Huda lui Papară Cave, offering a mountain-running experience with significant elevation changes and impressive views. The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants receive access to hydration and refreshment points, medals, and prizes. Registration is limited and available online.
course_highlights: The marathon route includes a steep climb to the Bedeleu Plateau and passes through the Plaiului Gorge Geological Reserve
The half marathon climbs Piatra Secuiului and crosses Creasta de Cocoș, with views of the Trascău Cliffs
The cross-country race offers an accessible mountain-running experience, with peaceful scenery in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif
additional: Limited places: 100 for the marathon, 250 for the half marathon, and 200 for the cross-country race. Race kits are distributed in Cluj-Napoca and Rimetea. Technical briefings are held before the start of each event. Medals are awarded only to participants who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the raffle after the awards ceremony; attendance at the draw is mandatory. Trail race with multiple categories, picturesque mountain terrain, cultural and natural landmarks, registration open until September 2026, free participation for people with disabilities

name: THERMAL TRAIL RACE Aleargă în capitala apelor termale
Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands, giving participants the chance to choose from three distances: a 5 km recreational race, a challenging 12 km race, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, in Čardak, and is intended for everyone who loves nature and running, whether beginner or experienced. The course is carefully designed to offer an authentic trail-running experience, with fitting challenges and the beauty of the sands.
course_highlights: The course winds through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands
Three distances: 5 km, 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon
Aid stations with water, fruit, and other refreshments
additional: One aid station on the course will offer water, fruit, peanuts, and sugar. There are two drinking fountains along the course for additional hydration. Registration is open until April 22, 2026; the event is intended for trail-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Πλατανοθεραπεία»
description: The 2nd “Platanotherapy” Road Race in Davleia is a unique event held amid the village’s natural beauty. The event features three courses and is intended for runners who want to enjoy the scenery and the sporting experience in a friendly environment. It is organized by the Municipality of Livadeia, the Davleia Community, and the Pandavleiakos team, with a start time of 17:30. This is a lovely sporting event that strengthens the local community and promotes a love of sport.
course_highlights: Three different courses through the natural beauty of Davleia
Held in the mountainous surroundings of Mount Parnassus
Start at 17:30 for an enjoyable late-afternoon sporting experience
additional: The race is organized by the Municipality of Livadeia, the Davleia Community, and the Pandavleiakos team. The race starts in Davleia, in the Mount Parnassus area. No information was found about registration fees or the registration process. Pre-registration is required. The race starts on Saturday, 15/05/2027, between 17:30 and 17:50. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and includes natural scenery and sporting activities.

name: 4ο Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races
description: The 4th Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races are organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania area. These mountain races feature courses along trails and dirt roads, with beautiful natural scenery and significant elevation gain. The race starts from Tornos Square, and the 10 km course includes trails such as the Waterfalls Trail and the Pilgrims’ Trail. The race is aimed at runners who love mountain running and being in nature.
course_highlights: Scenic trails, including the Waterfalls Trail
650 meters of elevation gain on the 10 km course
Courses along dirt roads and trails in South Evrytania
additional: The races are held under the auspices of local authorities and sports organizations, with participants competing over various distances on spectacular routes through mountain trails and villages.

name: 6ο Thrace Night Run
description: The 6th Thrace Night Run in Alexandroupoli is an annual sporting event offering 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1,500 m races for runners of all ages. The race starts and finishes on the city’s seafront avenue, on a 2,500 m loop course, with both power walking and running. The event combines sport and culture, with the registration centre hosted at a gallery of post-Byzantine visual arts. It features electronic timing, extensive medical support and awards for winners in various age categories. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and is supported by the Municipality of Alexandroupoli and other organisations.
course_highlights: A 2,500 m loop course along Alexandroupoli’s seafront avenue
Power walking and running over 1,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m distances
Start and finish on the seafront avenue, with electronic timing
additional: Race-pack collection is available on the Friday and Saturday before the race at the Old Town Hall of Alexandroupoli. Water and bananas are provided at refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. All participants receive a sports backpack. Dry-fit T-shirts, windbreakers and thermal garments are available for purchase. The race has a total limit of 1,200 participants. Medical support includes medical examinations and cooperation with the National Centre for Emergency Care (EKAB), the Hellenic Red Cross and the Hellenic Rescue Team. The race takes place on 15 May 2027, with participants from across Greece and the Balkans. The event promotes unity, sport and culture, while offering a unique night-running experience.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run across the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vast sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature lovers and runners seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km of rugged coastal beauty with an endless horizon
17 km along breathtaking cliffs with a sea breeze
7 fast and impressive kilometres along the coast
additional: Race packs are collected in the cities of Varna and Shabla, with a signed participation declaration. To collect a race pack for another participant, their signed declaration is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, the waves, and the journey, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from partner Villa Daros. The event features races over different distances, is supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amid the natural scenery of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to the cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot “Slancheto” in Borisova Gradina and take part using the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular “Slancheto” area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of paved park paths
1.2 km of dirt-and-gravel path, followed by 1.8 km of wide paved road
additional: The race is accessible to wheelchair participants. The virtual Catcher Car begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to take part and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or in person. The event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race included in the XLkmrun calendar and organized by 5kmrun. It takes place around the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—over open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The course is open, with no shade and varied terrain
Held in the Plana Mountain, near Sofia
additional: A choice of three distances of varying lengths. The course is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May around the village of Plana. Trail race; distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km; held around the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. It attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. The event is part of Lukovit Municipality’s sports calendar and offers a mass 800-meter start for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The 8.8-kilometer course runs from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass 800-meter start for younger participants
Takes place in scenic natural and urban surroundings
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. Winner Ismail Senandzhi has won the race five times. The event also includes a mass 800-meter start. It takes place on 10 May 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular with running enthusiasts in the region.

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for all running enthusiasts. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak. The course passes through urban areas, bike paths, and a secondary road network, with approximately 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and features aid stations every 5 km, as well as prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: The first 10 km pass through urban areas
The course follows bike paths and a secondary road network
Approximately 100 meters of elevation gain
additional: Race packs can be collected on May 8 and 9, 2026, at the Orlovo Gnezdo Tourist Association office, and on May 10, 2026, at the start/finish area in Rosarium Park. Aid stations along the course provide water, drinks, and fruit approximately every 5 km. The start/finish area has designated personal-bag storage zones with tags bearing race numbers. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00 and includes overall and youth categories. On-site registration is from 08:00 to 09:00, and the start is at 09:00. The event offers different distances and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The 20th anniversary edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, creating opportunities for young talents and established sportspeople to compete. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports officials.
course_highlights: City stadium in Lukovit with a well-maintained track
Events from 100 m to 1500 m for different age groups
More than 200 athletes from 35 clubs across the country
additional: The competition includes different age groups, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m. Representatives of Lukovit Municipality and sports officials attend the awards ceremonies. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and attracts national-level athletes and young talents. It is held at the city stadium in Lukovit, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m, includes children and adults, and features participants from across the country.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers different distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.
course_highlights: The course runs along Shumen Reservoir
Options for individual and relay running
A range of time formats: 1, 2, 3, and 6 hours
additional: Options include individual runs lasting 6 hours and 3 hours, as well as mixed relays lasting 2 hours and 1 hour (under 18 years old).

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, with no fixed finish line. Participants run to stay ahead of the Virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed until everyone is caught. The event in Oradea, Romania, on 10 May 2026, takes place on a 1.7 km paved circuit in the heart of the Nokian Tyres factory. All entry fees and donations go entirely toward spinal cord injury research.
course_highlights: 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory
Open to runners and wheelchair users
The Virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed
additional: The event is accessible to wheelchair participants. The start is simultaneous worldwide, and the Virtual Catcher Car begins the chase 30 minutes after the start at an initial speed of 14 km/h, increasing gradually. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord injury research projects. Participants can run any distance, with no fixed finish line, and can register through the app. Participants can run individually or in groups, and all funds raised go toward spinal cord injury research.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 invites you to run in the heart of Transylvania, through the center of Târgu Mureș, on May 10, 2026. The event offers a range of races: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4x5 km relay, and a children’s race. All start and finish in the central area, making it ideal for support from family and friends. Participants will discover the city’s notable tourist attractions in a vibrant spring atmosphere, enjoying prizes, medals, and good energy every step of the way. The organizer is Mureș Runners Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and community through sport.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș, passing notable tourist attractions
Start and finish in Piața Teatrului, in the city center
A range of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay, and children’s race
additional: The registration package includes an official T-shirt, race number, timing chip, finisher medal, sponsor brochures, online certificates, official photos, and access to hydration and refreshment stations. Required equipment at the start includes running shoes, sportswear, and a clearly visible race number. The event promotes environmental protection; littering outside designated areas is prohibited. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, relay, and children’s race. The event promotes physical activity and local tourism in Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running is a mountain running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Budureasa Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes two main races: the 8 km Eco Cross and the 16 km Cross, intended for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The routes start and finish in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with climbs and descents on gravel roads, trails, and paved roads. Refreshment points along the course provide water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. The race is open to all runners who are fit to participate, with special conditions for participants under 18.
course_highlights: The 8 km Eco Cross and 16 km Cross share a route until km 4.5, where there is a refreshment point
Steep climbs and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with 170 m of positive elevation gain
The final kilometers are on paved roads, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Race check-in takes place on Saturday from 16:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. The technical briefing is on Saturday, 09.05.2026, from 19:00 to 19:30, and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 refreshment points on the 16 km Cross course and 1 on the 8 km Eco Cross course, providing water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. Registrations are validated only after payment of the entry fee, and changes or cancellations can be made in writing only until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not eligible to participate. The route may be modified due to weather conditions; online registration is open until 3 May 2026, and registration may also be available on site; restrictions apply to minors; anti-doping rules apply.

description: The Urbana Desetka Sports Association invites you to take part in the Urbana Half Marathon in Smederevo on May 10, 2026. The event features the second edition of the 21 km half marathon and the third edition of the Dunavska Desetka 10 km race. The routes run along the Danube, through the city center, past Villa Obrenović and through the Jugovo neighborhood. Runners will enjoy a mix of flat terrain and rolling vineyards, with the start at Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Every participant receives a race number with a timing chip, a unique T-shirt and a medal, as well as refreshments during and after the race.
course_highlights: The route follows the Danube and passes through central Smederevo
Passes Villa Obrenović and the Jugovo neighborhood
A mix of flat terrain and rolling vineyards
additional: The start area is Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Every participant receives a race number with a timing chip, a distinctive-quality T-shirt, refreshments during the race and after the finish, and a medal. Categories are overall men and women, juniors up to 18 years old, and veterans aged 46+ for both distances. Details about the terrain, registration and exact schedule are not available, but the event is expected to be well organized with support from local authorities.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run is a charity race taking place on May 10, 2026, at Ada Ciganlija in Belgrade. Runners will complete a 7.7 km loop around the lake, enjoying nature and a sporting challenge. The race is an opportunity to come together, socialize, and support a charitable cause, and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.
course_highlights: A loop around the lake at Ada Ciganlija
7.7 km course
Natural surroundings and a sporting challenge
additional: The race is charitable and intended for all ages and levels of running experience. Registration and participation details are not specified, but the event is intended for a broad audience and supports a good cause.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin Run is a race held in Ugrinovci on May 10, 2026, starting at 10:00. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked course with two water and fruit stations. In addition to the main races, fun children’s races are organized for different age groups. They are free of charge with parental consent. Participants receive a unique medal at the finish, while merchandise prizes and trophies are provided for the top finishers.
course_highlights: The course is highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked
Two water and fruit stations along the course
Fun children’s races for preschool and elementary school children
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:00 to 09:30 at Stanko Marić Elementary School, Učitelja Cveje Street 5, near the start. Changing rooms and a baggage drop are available at the race-pack collection venue. Medical support is provided along the course and at the finish. Overall categories for men and women in both distances, with prizes for the best and fastest male and female runners from Ugrinovci. Ugrin Run 2026 is scheduled for May 10, 2026, with details about the organization, timekeeping, T-shirts, and medals. Participants can expect a well-organized event with support for runners of all categories.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: The Kozomor Mountaineering and Running Association and the PSS Mountaineering Trekking Commission invite competitors to the second round of the Serbian Trekking and Trail League, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Kosjerić. The race brings together enthusiasts of mountain trekking and trail running, offering a challenging and scenic course through nature. Participants can expect a well-organized event supported by experienced mountaineering and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Trails through the mountain landscapes of Kosjerić
Challenging terrain for trekking and trail running
Organized as part of the Serbian Trekking League
additional: Participation includes mountaineering and trail activities, and the event is intended for lovers of nature and sport.

name: 1ο Kotroni Trail
description: The 1st Kotroni Trail Run is a new mountain running event held in Kapandriti, Attica. It features 20 km, 12 km and 5 km routes, with natural trails, forest roads and varied terrain, offering an authentic trail running experience. The event also includes a 1 km children’s race, making it accessible to everyone. The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gymnasium, and the route is marked and supported by volunteers. The event welcomes hundreds of runners and mountain running enthusiasts, creating a festive atmosphere with music and traditional dancing.
course_highlights: 20 km, 12 km and 5 km routes featuring natural trails and forest roads
A cleared and marked route with refreshment points
Lush vegetation and varied terrain (dirt, rocks, streams)
additional: The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gymnasium. There is a 1 km children’s race, with more than 40 children taking part. The event includes a pre-pasta party and a music stage featuring The Retro Sofa. The total entry limit is 400 participants, with 100 places for the 20 km and 300 for the 12 km and 5 km races. Group entries are available for teams of more than 10 people. The routes include trail running and paths, with an emphasis on nature conservation and cultural heritage. The event also includes cultural and environmental activities, as well as a 1 km children’s race.

name: 3ο Koziakas Trail
description: The 3rd Koziakas Trail is a mountain race held in the beautiful village of Elati, Trikala, with distances of 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for young athletes. The course starts and finishes in Elati, crossing fir forests and the alpine landscapes of Koziakas. The race is dedicated to the conservation of the Egyptian vulture, an endangered bird species in Greece. The area is a popular mountain tourism destination with many natural and cultural attractions. This year, the event is included in the ITRA listings, giving the race international recognition.
course_highlights: Routes through beautiful fir forests
Alpine landscapes of Mount Koziakas
Start and finish in Elati, Trikala
additional: Trail races of 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for children; part of ITRA; natural landscapes, bird conservation, and environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Koutouki Trail Run

The event welcomes hundreds of runners who enjoy the natural surroundings and beauty of the mountain. It is ideal for runners of all levels looking for a distinctive trail-running experience in a friendly, well-organized setting.
