Scenic natural surroundings
10 km and 1 km options
additional: The event includes two distances, 10 km and 1 km, on dirt trails on Mount Hymettus. No information was found about prices, start times, or registration. Course details: approximately 10,000 m, on trails and forest roads. Difficulty: moderate, with small elevation changes. Water and first-aid stations are provided. Volunteers will monitor the course, and there will be a 1,000 m children's race. Participation also includes exercises and kilometers on trails and “χιλιόχρονα”.

name: 6ο City Trail Αγρίνιο
description: The 6th Agrinio City Trail is a 16.4 km running race organized by the Agrinio Health Runners Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Agrinio. The race takes place as part of the celebrations for the city’s patron saint, Saint Christopher, and starts and finishes in the city’s central Dimokratias Square. A 6 km race and a 1 km race for younger runners are also held on the same day. The course includes trails and dirt roads in the Saint Christopher grove and Papastrateio Municipal Park, and is marked to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 16.4 km course featuring trails and dirt roads
Passes through the Saint Christopher grove and Papastrateio Municipal Park
Starts and finishes in Agrinio’s central Dimokratias Square
additional: The 6 km and 1 km races for young participants are held on the same day. All races start from Dimokratias Square. The course is marked to ensure runners’ safety. The events include 16.4 km and 6 km races, as well as a 1 km race for children, all starting from Dimokratias Square. The event aims to promote sport and health, with local runners and visitors taking part.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Ιωαννίνων
description: The 9th Ioannina Half Marathon is a distinctive road race held around Lake Pamvotida and the historic center of the city of Ioannina. It offers races for everyone, from the 21 km half marathon to 10 km and 5 km races, a 1 km children’s race, and a 1 km race for people with disabilities. The event is dynamic and comprehensive, attracting many participants and featuring strong performances, establishing it as an important event in the Greek running scene. The races take place on May 15 and 16, 2027, with starts and finishes on the city’s lakeside.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Pamvotida
Passes through the historic center of Ioannina
Lakeside scenery with beautiful views
additional: The 1 km children’s race takes place on 15/05/2027 at 17:00 for children aged 3–12, with free registration and limited places. There are also 10 km and 5 km races and a 1 km race for people with disabilities, with specific start times. The event includes refreshment stations and is supported by volunteers. Late registration is available for a limited period before the race. The event is supported by the Municipality of Ioannina and the Region of Epirus, and includes activities and events in the city, attracting runners and visitors from all over Greece.

name: 9ος Λαϊκός Δρόμος «Παναγιώτης Αφαλής»
description: The 9th Panagiotis Afalis Community Road Race in Neapoli, Thessaloniki, is an annual sporting event that promotes sports and community participation. The race offers runners of all ages the opportunity to enjoy a route through the city, fostering community spirit and healthy living. The event is named after Panagiotis Afalis, honoring his memory and contribution to the local community. The Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies actively supports the event, providing a well-organized and welcoming sporting experience.
course_highlights: A route through the city of Neapoli, Thessaloniki
Welcoming to runners of all levels
Organizational support from the Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies
additional: The event includes running and walking in Neapoli, Thessaloniki, with participation from organizations and clubs, and requires a signed registration form. It is held with safety measures and medical support, and includes traffic interruptions and bus diversions.

name: 10ο Panorama Charity Fun Run «Μελίνα Λαζαρίδου»
description: The 10th Panorama Charity Fun Run “Melina Lazaridou” is a charity road race organized by the Municipality of Pylaia-Chortiatis in collaboration with SEGAS and the “Panorama Lions” sports club. The event features three routes—10 km, 5 km, and 2 km—through the streets of Panorama, finishing at the Olympic Sports Center. The race has a charitable purpose, with proceeds going to charitable associations and organizations. Everyone is welcome to take part, and runners of all ages turn out in large numbers, creating a celebration of sport and solidarity.
course_highlights: Three routes: 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km
Routes through the streets of Panorama
Finish at the Olympic Sports Center
additional: The event is supported by SEGAS and the “Panorama Lions” sports club. Proceeds go to charitable associations such as the Northern Greece Parents’ Association of Children with Neoplastic Diseases “Lampsi,” the Friends of Papageorgiou Hospital Association “Antirida,” and “SOS Children’s Village Filyro.” Registration is available online or in person at the Panorama Olympic Sports Center every day from 17:00 and on weekends from 11:00. Routes with special traffic arrangements, participation open to all ages, proceeds for charitable causes, collaboration with SEGAS and local clubs.

name: 13ο Paggaio Trail Run
description: The 13th Paggaio Trail Run is organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Kavala and offers two mountain races: a challenging 27-kilometer race for experienced runners and a 10-kilometer race for less experienced runners. The routes start and finish in the village of Domatia, at the foot of Mount Paggaio, and pass along trails, forest roads, and a few meters of asphalt. Mount Paggaio offers unique natural scenery and an unforgettable experience for those who love mountain running. The event welcomes both experienced and new runners to discover the area’s beauty through the race.
course_highlights: Routes along trails and forest roads, with a few meters of asphalt
Start and finish in the village of Domatia, at an elevation of 150 meters
Natural scenery and ridgelines of Mount Paggaio
additional: The event also includes routes for children, while the area’s natural beauty and cultural heritage are important features of the event.

name: «Τρέξε για τη ζωή» για τη γιορτή της Μητέρας
description: “Run for Life” is a sporting event organized by Lesvos Runners in Mytilene to mark Mother’s Day. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and love, where runners and walkers are invited to join a large group at Tsamakia Grove. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and promotes well-being and social participation through sport.
course_highlights: Route through Tsamakia Grove in Mytilene
Friendly, family-oriented setting for runners and walkers
Event dedicated to Mother’s Day
additional: The event takes place at Tsamakia Grove, starting at 11:00 a.m. No specific distances or categories are listed; participation is encouraged for everyone, regardless of ability. The event has a friendly, social character and celebrates Mother’s Day. It includes running or walking, with the aim of promoting health and the local community, and takes place on the Tsamakia pedestrian path on May 16, 2027.

name: Kassios Dias
description: Kassios Dias is a challenging technical mountain race held on the trails of northeastern Corfu, offering two distances of 25 and 12 kilometers. The routes pass through traditional semi-mountainous villages and the unique ecosystem of Erimitis, a protected NATURA area, combining mountain scenery with coastal beauty. The 25 km route passes caves and peaks with panoramic views, while the 1,200 m children’s race gives children the chance to experience the joy of running. The race is organized by the Kassios Dias Running and Hiking Association to promote sports and volunteerism.
course_highlights: 25 km route with +1,300 m of elevation gain, passing through the Peristerograva Cave
Passage through the protected NATURA ecosystem of Erimitis
Panoramic views from the summit of Matagonas (640 m elevation)
additional: Race-bib collection and new in-person registrations take place on Thursday and Saturday in Corfu and Kassiopi, as well as on race day before the start. The start and finish are at Kassiopi Harbor. A pre-race meal (Pasta Party) is held on Saturday. Registration is not required for the 1,200 m children’s race. Car access to Kassiopi Harbor on race day is limited due to traffic restrictions. Paid private parking is available, along with free parking spaces on a nearby peripheral road. On-site registration is also available, and the event offers accommodation and transport options to make participation convenient for runners. The area is a popular summer destination with easy access via the airport, road networks, and ferries.

name: Kifissia Runners In The Night
description: Kifissia Runners in the Night is an exciting 5-kilometer night race held in the center of Kifissia, starting and finishing at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium. Now in its fourth year, the event offers a unique running experience along the city’s illuminated streets, welcoming summer with a major celebration of sport. The race is organized by the Municipality of Kifissia in cooperation with the Region of Attica and is aimed at runners looking for a lively, energetic night route.
course_highlights: 5 km night race in the center of Kifissia
Start and finish at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium
Route along the city’s main streets, which are illuminated
additional: The race includes chip timing and a race number sent by email. Volunteers can take part and support the event. Registration and volunteer options are available. It is a major celebration of sport in the heart of Kifissia, with runners of all ages and abilities taking part.

name: Megalopolis Theater Run
description: The Megalopolis Theater Run is a road race held in Megalopolis, Arcadia, dedicated to the city’s ancient theater, the largest theater in the ancient Greek world. The race includes a 10 km route with a newly updated course, as well as 5 km and 1 km routes for everyone, offering a unique running experience in a historic setting. The organizers invite runners and volunteers to take part and embrace this celebration of sport and culture. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce.
course_highlights: 10 km route with a newly updated course
5 km and 1 km routes for everyone
Dedicated to the ancient theater of Megalopolis, the largest ancient theater
additional: A volunteer program is available for residents and anyone interested. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce. The event includes multiple routes, registration for runners and volunteers, and takes place at a historic site dedicated to ancient Greek theater.

name: Sohos Mountain Games
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος «Σώκος Ερμής» και Τοπική Κοινότητα Σοχού
description: The Sohos Mountain Games are the largest mountain running race held in Sochos, Thessaloniki, offering an unforgettable trail-running experience amid natural beauty and a variety of routes. Participants can choose from 30km, 10km, 5km, and a 1-mile route for children, with all races starting and finishing in the central square of Sochos. The race combines sport, local tradition, and a social gathering, with a party, DJ, and traditional kourbani after the finish. It is a celebration for all runners, from elite athletes to families and children.
course_highlights: 30km route with 1,300m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
10km route with 520m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
5km Fun Run around Sochos, suitable for everyone
additional: All races start from the central square of Sochos. Race amenities include a technical T-shirt, Buff, Pre-Race Pasta Party, race bib, electronic timing, finisher’s medal, full refreshments, medical services, a traditional after-race meal, and an electronic participation certificate. There is also a big celebration with a DJ and traditional kourbani after the race. A discounted package is available for unemployed people, university students, school students, people with disabilities, and members of the Armed Forces and Security Forces. The event includes multiple trail routes, post-race activities, a party, free transport for early registrations, and a warm welcome.

name: Crosul T.E.A.M.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: înscriere gratuită (în limita a 200 de locuri în total)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: după epuizarea locurilor gratuite, înscrierea este cu plata unei taxe de 50 RON

description: The T.E.A.M. Fun Run is a charitable sporting event held in Timișoara, combining physical activity with solidarity to support children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association. The event is participatory, with no timing or rankings, and offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, with races for babies, children, and adults. The routes pass through central areas of the city, and the funds raised support the “Casa InimiiLor” project, a therapeutic refuge for children. Taking part is an expression of solidarity and hope for those in need.
course_highlights: The routes include Piața Libertății and Piața Victoriei, with distances adapted to age categories
A participatory event with no timing; all participants receive participation medals
Charitable support for children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association through the Casa InimiiLor project
additional: Participant kits are distributed in the days leading up to the event at the Wendhill Academy premises in Iulius Mall (2nd floor). The start and finish are in Piața Libertății. Participants in the baby races are carried in a baby carrier or in their arms, while the children’s races have special rules regarding accompaniment by parents or legal guardians. There will be an official opening and a technical briefing before the start. The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, offering an opportunity to support children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association by participating and donating.

name: 26ος Ευχίδειος Άθλος
description: The Euhideios Athlos is a historic ultradistance race that crosses the region between Delphi and Plataea, honoring the feat of the long-distance messenger Euchidas. Runners pass through historic battlefields and natural landscapes, with routes featuring uphill stretches on Mount Helicon and panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth. The race offers a unique experience combining sport, history, and culture, with starts and finishes at significant historic sites. The event includes three ultradistance routes, covering different levels of difficulty and distance.
course_highlights: 107.5 km route from Plataea to Delphi, passing historic battlefields
Climbs on mythical Mount Helicon with panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth
A short 5 km section on a dirt road along the Mornos Canal
additional: The 215 km Euhideios Ultra-Athlos starts at 07:00. A pasta party and technical briefing are held the previous day. The route is mainly paved, except for a short 5 km dirt-road section. There are checkpoints and aid stations along the route. After the finish, a Delphic Light lighting ceremony, awards ceremony, and reception take place at the European Cultural Centre of Delphi. The event features multiple routes, historical and cultural significance, and a focus on showcasing the area’s natural beauty. Registration usually opens in late October or early November.

name: Business Run Varna

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Цена: 19 евро на дете. Регистрацията е индивидуална и отделна.

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the biggest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard Shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km before handing the relay baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams of 4, each running 4 km
The course is in the industrial zone of BulYard Shipbuilding Industry and Bulport Logistics
Each lap is 2 km, and each participant runs 2 laps
additional: Each participant receives a race bib and safety pins. The relay baton is equipped with an electronic timing chip. The start is at 9:00, and the first runner must be at the start with the baton at 8:50. Parking and a cloakroom are available next to the start area. Laser engraving on medals is available for an additional fee. Branded team tents are available for an additional fee. Registration deadlines are in early 2026. The event includes certificates and gifts, as well as the opportunity for companies to take part and enjoy team-building.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inscriere gratuita pentru copiii 0-6 ani, fără tricou, doar număr de concurs, medalie și pudră colorată

description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is an energetic 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is untimed, focusing on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of having color applied at every kilometer. The urban course starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple consecutive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.
course_highlights: An urban 5 km course in central Cluj, starting and finishing in Piața Unirii
Colored powder applied at every kilometer
An explosion of colored powder at the finish, accompanied by live music
additional: The event has multiple consecutive starts at 5-minute intervals, and participants must wear their race number visibly on their T-shirt. There is no luggage storage. Bicycles, rollerblades, scooters, and pets are not allowed. The access wristband is issued at the entrance to the event area upon presentation of the participation number and T-shirt. The medal and colored powder are given at the finish. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, race number, bandana, tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle; pets and vehicles are not allowed on the course.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a top mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The competition includes Marathon, Half Marathon and Cross races, as well as a children’s race, EcoKids. The courses are made up of 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic running experience in nature, with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Approximately 42 km marathon course with 2,400 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 28 km half-marathon course with 1,350 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 14 km cross-country course with 750 m of positive elevation gain, mostly on forest roads and mountain trails
additional: The Cross and Marathon races will have two start waves, at 9:00 and 9:15, depending on the estimated time provided during registration. Marathon participants will start at 9:00; the time will be displayed on their bib. There is a relaxation area and a Pasta Party after the race at Vlahia Inn. EcoKids has separate starts by age category, beginning at 15:00. Registration for the main races opens on March 8, 2026, and closes on May 1, 2026, subject to availability. Mountain trails, activities such as a pasta party and floral ceremonies, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a sub-mountain running competition held on marked trails in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering spectacular natural scenery and a challenge for all fitness levels. The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced runners to those looking for a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering amenities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. It’s an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.
course_highlights: Routes on natural trails, a forest road, and meadows
Spectacular scenery at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains
Three races suited to all fitness levels
additional: Participants receive a medal, race bib, an optional sweatshirt for an additional fee, a meal voucher, and a carbohydrate gel. Regenerative massage and stretching sessions are offered after the race. The evening before the competition, camping is organized, with a campfire and an outdoor film screening. There is a painting workshop for children during the race. The routes include technical descents and pass through scenic areas, making them ideal for mountain trail-running enthusiasts.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: Crosul Cetăților Suceava is a popular running race held in the city of Suceava, offering participants an outdoor sporting experience with courses suited to all ages and fitness levels. The event includes children’s races, a popular race, and a cross-country race, promoting physical activity and community spirit. Participants can run routes through historic and picturesque areas, surrounded by fortresses and local scenery. The organizers provide a participation kit and prizes for competitors, encouraging involvement and athletic performance.
course_highlights: Routes through historic areas and fortresses in Suceava
Races for children, a popular race, and a cross-country race
An event for all ages and fitness levels
additional: The participation kit is guaranteed only for people who register and are confirmed by June 30, 2025. The event includes children’s races, a popular race, and a cross-country race, with prizes and participation kits. There is an active TRIB community that organizes other runs and charity events. The event includes community activities and various race categories, with registration details and rules available on the official website.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills is a mountain running race held in Crasna, Sălaj County, on May 16, 2026. The event invites running enthusiasts to explore the area's picturesque hills, offering a sporting experience in nature. It's a great opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy beautiful scenery and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route in the Crasna area, Sălaj County
Picturesque natural scenery
Outdoor event held on May 16
additional: The event has had previous editions, with positive results and feedback, and is a local tradition promoting sport and health.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: The Fetești Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings runners from the region together for races of various distances, including a half marathon and cross-country races. The organizers, the Feteștiul Aleargă Sports Association, promote sports and health in the community, offering an enjoyable and competitive experience. The event has a tradition in the area and takes place on varied courses suitable for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon course
10 km and 5 km cross-country races
Special category for school champions (ages 6–13)
additional: half marathon, registration information available on the website and Facebook, local course

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: the longer red course, 21 km with 1,400 meters of elevation gain, intended for seniors, and the shorter blue course, 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain, for juniors. The courses pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race attracts competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series is governed by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.
course_highlights: Two loop courses: 21 km with 1,400 m of elevation gain and 10 km with 500 m of elevation gain
The courses pass over the peaks of Ljujaš (1,269 m), Orlić (1,235 m), Jelova Gora (1,311 m), Bandera-Tornik (1,496 m), and Liska (1,346 m)
The race passes through unspoiled nature and lesser-known parts of Zlatibor
additional: The race headquarters are at the primary school in the village of Jablanica. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series, which includes five rounds for seniors and three races for juniors. Participation requires a validated PSS competition booklet or a medical certificate. Senior scoring includes bonus points for the national championship and ultra-trail races. The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain courses, and the race is part of a wider national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

name: Nebeski visovi 2026
description: The "Tornik" Mountaineering Club from Čajetina and the Mountaineering Association of Serbia invite you to take part in the unforgettable "Nebeski visovi" skyrace in the fairytale setting of Zlatibor, in the village of Jablanica. This race is the first event of the year in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national mountain running series and is intended for athletes, recreational runners, and nature lovers. The race offers two loop courses, starting and finishing by the school in the center of Jablanica, and passing through areas with spectacular views. Participants can choose between the 21 km red course with 1,400 m of cumulative ascent and the 10 km blue course with 500 m of ascent.
course_highlights: Red course: 21 km, 1,400 m of cumulative ascent
Blue course: 10 km, 500 m of ascent
Loop courses start and finish by the school in Jablanica and pass through areas with beautiful views
additional: Race packet pickup on race day by the school in Jablanica, from 8:00 to 9:45. Red course start at 10:00; blue course start at 10:15. Categories include overall men’s and women’s, team, junior, senior, and veteran categories. Time limits are 4h30min for the red course and 3h for the blue course in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia competition, and 6h and 4h, respectively, in the open competition. Terrain includes mountain trails with significant climbs; on-site registration; categories for different age groups and team competition categories.

description: The 5th “5ο RUN PYRGOU” road race in Pyrgos, Elis, offers a celebration of sport for all ages, with 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes. The start and finish are at Pyrgos Central Square, with categories for adults and children, as well as special categories for people with disabilities. The race is co-organized by Pirgos AthleticEvents and the Municipality of Pyrgos, with the aim of promoting exercise and participation by the local community. The event awards medals and cups to category winners, creating a friendly and encouraging atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes at Pyrgos Central Square
Categories for all ages, from toddlers to adults, as well as people with disabilities
Start and finish at the central square, in an urban setting
additional: Medals are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, and cups to the overall category winners. Minors aged 15–18 may participate with parental consent. All routes start at Pyrgos Central Square at different times between 18:30 and 20:30. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pyrgos and includes various routes and categories for all ages and athletic levels. Participation promotes health and well-being, while electronic timing and results make it easier to track runners’ performance.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κάστρου Διδυμοτείχου «Κώστας Γκατσιούδης»
description: The 8th Didymoteicho Castle Road Race “Kostas Gatsioudis” is an annual road race held in Didymoteicho. It includes 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, a race for people with disabilities, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The race began in 2016 on the initiative of military personnel, with the support of the Municipality of Didymoteicho and the Division. It is an important sporting and cultural event for the area, honoring the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay
Includes a race for people with disabilities
Takes place at the historic Didymoteicho Castle
additional: The event honors the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis and General Charalambos Lalousis, and includes celebratory events. The course passes through the city’s historic castle, and participation is open to everyone, with registration via Google Form.

name: Ποσειδώνια
organizer: Δήμος Πόρου, Γυμναστική Ένωση Πόρου Τροιζηνίας

description: The Poseidonia races in Poros are a popular running event that attracts more than 900 runners from across Greece and abroad. They are organized by the Municipality of Poros and the Gymnastics Association of Poros Troizinia, offering races over different distances on the picturesque island of Poros. The event includes courses ranging from 300 meters to 10 kilometers, with electronic timing and free participation in all events. After the races, participants are treated to a free Pasta Party, creating a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses from 300 m to 10,000 m on a picturesque island
Electronic timing for athletes in the 5 km and 10 km races
Free Pasta Party after the races
additional: Registration includes a race T-shirt, a bottle of water, a banana, electronic timing, and a commemorative medal. Athletes traveling from Piraeus and Aegina receive a 50% discount on ferry tickets. The race office is open on Friday afternoon and Saturday morning for collecting race bibs, bags, and T-shirts. Travel to Poros is available by road and ferry. The event includes road races and mountain running, children’s races and family activities, with electronic timing and events for everyone.

name: Goulinas Trail
description: The Goulinas Trail mountain running race is held in the area of Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the aim of showcasing the region through sport and a love of nature. It includes three routes of different lengths and elevation gains, offering an unforgettable experience to all participants. The start and finish are in Spercheiada’s central square, and the race emphasizes protecting the natural environment and sustainability. The event promotes fair play, cooperation, and a healthy lifestyle through sport.
course_highlights: Three routes: 6 km, 12 km, and 30 km, with elevation gains of 220 m, 700 m, and 2,000 m, respectively
Start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square
A nature-sensitive setting, with an emphasis on protection and a low environmental footprint
additional: All routes start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square. The 30 km race has a 7-hour finish time limit and an intermediate cutoff at 12.5 km, at 2 hours and 45 minutes. The race is environmentally friendly, with measures to reduce its impact on the natural environment. It includes different routes focused on nature and adventure, and offers information about accommodation and registration.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professional runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The event brings together sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty: 3 km with 75 m of elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m of elevation gain, and 26 km with 1,514 m of elevation gain
Routes follow historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: The organizers are Apriltsi Municipality, the Troyan in the Future Association, and the National Society “Tradition” – 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with funds raised allocated to causes related to the fight against cancer and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event is organized to bring together sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different levels of difficulty and welcoming both professional runners and enthusiasts. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and scenic sea views. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon tests endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course runs along Varna’s coastline, with sea views
The race takes place in Bulgaria’s seaside capital
An atmosphere of support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late on-site registration is possible if places are available at the information center, which is open May 12–16, 2026. Race numbers can only be collected in person on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square, next to the Varna Opera House. The event also includes a 2 km city run with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; online and on-site registration; an event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Pleven Friendship Marathon is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. The organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a varied program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turn-around points
Refreshment stations every 5–6 km and water stations every 3 km and along the course
The course passes through Kaylaka Park and scenic parts of Pleven
additional: Race packets are distributed at the Children’s Activity Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed in on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and an ambulance on the course. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIZ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 and people with disabilities upon request and submission of documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Course, registration, charitable cause, children’s marathon

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held in the foothills of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event brings together sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: The Hobby route is 37 km with 1,274 m of elevation gain, suitable for cyclists of all levels.
The Difficult route is 47 km with 1,781 m of elevation gain, featuring challenging climbs and technical descents for advanced riders.
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the cycling route overlapping the Hobby route.
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, aid stations with food and drinks, a medical team, and festival activities at the start/finish area, including live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children’s race for children up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start/finish area. It includes a children’s race, a tent campsite, insurance, aid stations, and charitable giving.

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
location: Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition featuring tests of strength, speed, agility, and skills, held at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition, scheduled for May 17, 2026, challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.
course_highlights: Obstacle course testing strength, speed, and agility
Location at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park, Cluj-Napoca
Available distances: 6 km and 12 km
additional: The event includes technique and strength obstacles. Registration and participation details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Crosul Sport4All
location: Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, Lugoj, Timiș County, Romania
description: Crosul Sport 4 all is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. It includes untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The courses loop around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places offered by sponsor Mondial S.A.
course_highlights: Loop courses around Drăgan European University and along the central streets of Lugoj
Races for all ages, including untimed races for children and timed 4 km and 6 km races
Participation medals for all participants in the untimed races
additional: Register online by 10.05.2026 at 23:59 or until all 400 free places are filled. Race kits are distributed on Saturday and Sunday at Drăgan European University. The event includes an awards ceremony for the timed races, as well as warm-up sessions and a technical briefing before the start. Volunteers receive a volunteer kit and a volunteer agreement in accordance with the law. Races for children and adults, untimed and timed races, urban courses, online registration, race kit, medals and diplomas for participants, event organized in partnership with Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University.

name: MARATONUL NISIPULUI Run&Fun
location: Plaja Zoom Beach, Constanța, Constanța County, Romania
description: The Nisipului Run & Fun Marathon, taking place on May 17, 2026, at Zoom Beach in Constanța, is a sporting event that combines competition with fun and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. The event offers six different races, from the 42 km marathon to recreational runs for the whole family, held on the sand of the Romanian coast. Participants can enjoy spectacular routes with the sea breeze, in an atmosphere full of energy and community spirit. The marathon is a celebration of movement, nature, and adventure, aimed at both professional and amateur runners.
course_highlights: Routes on the sand of the Romanian coast with the sea breeze
Water stations at the start/finish and at km 2.5 on Reyna Beach
A moderately challenging course, with multiple loops and clear markings
additional: The start will be in the vibrant heart of Constanța on May 17, 2026. The marathon course consists of 7 km loops on sand, with a 6-hour time limit. Race changes are free until 01.05.2026; after that, an additional fee applies. Participation kits will not be sent by courier if a participant does not attend. Multiple race categories, routes on the coastal sand, activities for families and the community, and an event promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, making for an accessible experience
The classic Bucharest–Snagov route
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrain and diverse scenery, making this a landmark mountain biking event in Romania.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, featuring a new course through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together many runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with special attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has fostered Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.
course_highlights: New course through Somborica
Organized transportation for participants
Medal for all participants
additional: Organized transportation to Somborica is available for participants; the contact person is Milan Kovačić. The celebration of ARK Somaraton’s 16th anniversary is part of the accompanying activities. Runners receive a medal for participating. The club has around 65 members, with active training sessions and support for runners of all levels. The event also includes organized city tours, cultural activities, and support during the race, and is open to all age groups.

name: 1ο «Το Καλωσόρισμα των Πελαργών»
description: The 1st “Welcoming the Storks” road race in Aiginio, Pieria, is a spring sports celebration held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros. The event includes 11-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering athletes and visitors an opportunity to take part. The welcoming town of the Storks welcomes runners on a route that combines natural beauty and sporting spirit, promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region.
course_highlights: 11-kilometer race: Kolindros–Katachas–Aiginio route
5-kilometer race: circular route in Aiginio
1,000-meter children’s race: circular route in Aiginio
additional: The event takes place as part of the 1st Stork Festival and includes sports activities aimed at promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region. The event is supported by local clubs and organizations. Races for different levels and age groups; event on May 23, 2027; accompanying activities and environmental awareness.

name: 4ος Axios Running Festival
description: The Axios Running Festival is a multi-day sporting and cultural celebration held in the Axios Valley, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages and abilities. The event includes 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1-mile road races, with certified courses and accompanying social, cultural, and environmental events. The race combines sport, tourism, and history, showcasing the region and supporting the local community. The event is held under the auspices of the Region of Central Macedonia and follows World Athletics regulations.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting at the Koufalia Town Hall and finishing at the Balkan Wars Military Museum
Courses that cross the Axios Valley, the Axios Dam, and the old Thessaloniki–Evzoni National Road
Courses certified in accordance with World Athletics regulations
additional: The race is held on the first Sunday of April each year (in this case, May 23, 2027) and forms part of a two-day, wide-ranging experience featuring environmental, cultural, and social events. Participation certificates can be printed for all distances. The event provides high-quality safety and support services for runners of all ages and abilities. It includes road races, health activities, and a walk, with an emphasis on environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Belles Historic Trail
description: The Belles Historic Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event that combines the natural beauty and historical memory of the Neou Petritsi area in Serres. The routes cross trails rich in natural vegetation, historic forts, and offer magnificent panoramic views, providing a unique experience for runners of all levels. The event includes races of different distances, from 1 km for children to 22.66 km for experienced athletes, with a welcoming atmosphere and local delicacies at the finish. Belles Historic Trail is a celebration of sport, culture, and nature that brings the community and visitors together.
course_highlights: Routes on trails with abundant natural vegetation and waterfalls
Historic forts and trails of the Battle of the Forts (1941)
Panoramic views of Lake Kerkini and Mount Belles
additional: Electronic timing with prompt, reliable results. Refreshment stations along the routes. Commemorative gifts for all athletes (windbreaker jacket, buff, socks). Medical coverage throughout the races. Traditional local delicacies at the finish. Children’s races on Sunday at 11:30. Race office and packet pickup on race day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 17:30. The event includes trail and on-road races for children and athletes of different levels, and offers medals and local cuisine to participants.

name: 5ο Godzilla Xanthi Trail
location: Xanthi, East Macedonia and Thrace, Greece

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Βασικό πακέτο : 20 ευρώ (Περιλαμβάνονται: Αριθμός συμμετοχής του αθλητή, Αναμνηστικό εγχαραγμένο Μετάλλιο, Ηλεκτρονικό δίπλωμα συμμετοχής, παροχή νερού, ισοτονικών ποτών και μικρογεύματα.)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Πλήρες πακέτο : 30 ευρώ (Περιλαμβάνονται: Αριθμός συμμετοχής του αθλητή, Αναμνηστικό εγχαραγμένο Μετάλλιο, Ηλεκτρονικό δίπλωμα συμμετοχής, παροχή νερού, ισοτονικών ποτών και μικρογεύματα, Τεχνικό unisex φούτερ.)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Βασικό πακέτο : 15 ευρώ (Περιλαμβάνονται: Αριθμός συμμετοχής του αθλητή, Αναμνηστικό εγχαραγμένο Μετάλλιο, Ηλεκτρονικό δίπλωμα συμμετοχής, παροχή νερού, ισοτονικών ποτών και μικρογεύματα.)

tiers.description: Πλήρες πακέτο : 20 ευρώ (Περιλαμβάνονται: Αριθμός συμμετοχής του αθλητή, Αναμνηστικό εγχαραγμένο Μετάλλιο, Ηλεκτρονικό δίπλωμα συμμετοχής, παροχή νερού, ισοτονικών ποτών και μικρογεύματα, Αναμνηστικό τεχνικό, ελαφρύ, διαπνεόμενο αντιανεμικό γιλέκο.)

description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes of 30 km, 14 km, and 7 km. The 30 km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes suit runners with different experience levels, with the 7 km route serving as an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Xanthi Runners Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, offering a unique sporting experience amid the area's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 28 km of trails and 1,850 m of elevation gain
14 km route with 12 km of trails and 600 m of elevation gain
Easy, circular 7 km route, ideal as an introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are at Thilia. Awards ceremonies take place at 11:30 for the 7 km race and at 14:30 for the 30 km and 14 km races. A volunteer follows the last runners to provide support. Bib pickup is at Xanthi's central square on the Saturday before the race and from early morning on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. There are three routes of varying difficulty, with the start and finish in the Ilia area, full refreshments, and awards. The 30 km route is particularly challenging and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannai Road Race is a sporting event held in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to take part in a road race that promotes mass participation in sports and a healthy lifestyle. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association, an organization with a long tradition of supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and a love of nature, fostering sportsmanship and a community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities
In collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations
Focus on social cohesion and volunteerism
additional: An event featuring 21.1 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for children and people with disabilities, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Grigoris Lambrakis Peace Run is a 23-kilometer road race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of Grigoris Lambrakis, a peace activist and martyr. The race takes place in Tripoli and follows routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the Arcadia Peace Committee’s annual sporting events. It is an event with historical and social significance that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: A 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
A race centered on the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. It is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the committee’s annual sporting events. The 2026 race was scheduled for Sunday, May 17, at 18:00 in Tripoli. Routes through various parts of Tripoli, participation by the Arcadia Peace Committee, a historical and social context, and references to previous editions.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Road Race “Georgios Apostolakis” is held in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race attracts many participants and is a celebration of sport and local tradition. The event honors his contribution and love of sport, while promoting social cohesion and health through physical activity.
course_highlights: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes in an urban setting
Organized by GEORGIOS APOSTOLAKIS PARK
Includes road races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes, age categories, road races and gymnastics, date: 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Road Race in Naousa is a running event honoring the historic heroic city and its unique traditions. The course gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural surroundings of Mount Vermio and the area’s rich cultural heritage. With its beautiful trails and welcoming atmosphere, Naousa is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and abilities. The race combines athletic challenge with historical remembrance and local hospitality.
course_highlights: A course at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing by Naousa’s historic and cultural landmarks
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naousa offers welcoming accommodation and local cuisine featuring Xinomavro wine and traditional dishes. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family excursions and adventures in nature. The event emphasizes historical remembrance, with online and in-person registration, and medals and commemorative gifts for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: Dental Run 2026 is an inclusive road race taking place at Goudi Park on May 17. Runners of all levels are invited to take part in a 5-kilometer race, a relaxed walk, or a children’s race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, and also offers non-athletes the opportunity to participate as volunteers. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, with support from well-known dental care product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option of a relaxed walk or a children’s race
Inclusive event open to runners and volunteers
additional: Those who do not wish to run can participate as volunteers. The event is supported by companies including Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. It is organized to raise awareness about health, with participation options including a 5-kilometer race, a walk, and a children’s race, as well as opportunities to volunteer.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th “All Together—All Equal” road race is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the assistance of the “Gefyra” (Bridge) support structure and the support of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association “Trachina.” The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness about people with disabilities. It features three routes of 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km. These are non-competitive routes, and there is no timing. Participation is free for people with disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km routes at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same location at the Castle
Routes suitable for people with disabilities and their companions; non-competitive
additional: The 2.5 km and 5 km routes are open to people with disabilities and companions aged over 12. The 800 m route is for people with disabilities of any age and primary school children (ages 6–12). There is no timing, and the race is symbolic in nature. The schedule includes registration opening at 10:00, the 800 m start at 11:00, and the 2.5 km and 5 km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. The event has a social purpose and includes children and adults, awareness-raising and cultural activities, and support from the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its founding in 2026. Held in the village of Sinemorets, it offers trail running distances of 42, 21, and 13 km, plus a 3 km children’s race, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The routes follow the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start on May 23, with time limits for each distance. Mountain biking takes place on May 24, with two distances. Starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). Food and drink stations are provided along the routes. MTB bikes without electric assistance are permitted. After the race, there is a party at the “Koraba” bar. Early accommodation booking is recommended, for example at Casa Domingo in Sinemorets. Running and cycling routes, on-site registration, anniversary edition, nature trails in Strandzha

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania
price_range: 50 lei donație pentru acces la zonele Food & Drinks (pentru ediția Harvest) sau 120-150 RON pentru cursele de alergare
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The event combines running and cycling on scenic routes through the Jidvei vineyards, offering participants spectacular views and an authentic experience surrounded by nature. It includes races for all fitness levels, from children to adults, as well as recreational and food-and-wine activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular scenery in the Jidvei vineyards, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Race kits for the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, as well as the 1 km and 2 km children’s races. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and food-and-wine experiences are included in the event. The organizers are preparing a fun-filled world and creative workshops for children in a safe, friendly setting. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races. The event also includes a grape-picking competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, taking place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half-marathon race and other sporting events. The route starts in Central Square and passes through the city’s main thoroughfares. The event is held under the patronage of Prince Radu, with support from several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the regulations, register, and donate in support of the cause.
course_highlights: Urban route starting and finishing in Central Square, Bistrița
Passes through the city’s main streets: Dornei Street, Șincai Street, Mihai Eminescu Street, Republicii Boulevard, and Barbu Șt. Delavrancea Street
Event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports
additional: Online registrations are validated until May 1, 2026; the event is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association – Bistrița Branch, under the High Patronage of Prince Radu; participants can receive the official Invictus T-shirt and related merchandise; the event includes other sporting events in addition to the half marathon; participants are advised to read the regulations for details about equipment, timing, and prizes. Four different routes, simplified registration, a donation required for the T-shirt, an event for all ages, and activities promoting solidarity and gratitude.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere beneath the stars. The event promotes outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, engages the local community, and supports the education of disadvantaged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from a half marathon to children’s races, and enjoy an authentic experience in nature, with hydration points, a hot meal, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly atmosphere and environmental responsibility.
course_highlights: Spectacular night routes through the forests and ridges of Bucovina
Hydration and food points along the route
Festival atmosphere with general admission and a hot meal at the finish
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib with a timing chip, access to hydration and food points, a general admission wristband for the festival area, a hot meal at the finish, and cash prizes in the age-group and OPEN categories. The festival offers accommodation options at a campsite or partner hotels and recommends traveling by train or bus to reduce environmental impact. Multiple race distances, festival atmosphere, prizes, real-time results, participant amenities, charitable purpose
