description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area around Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, and is dedicated to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked courses and significant elevation gain, set in picturesque natural surroundings. The organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the event’s competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon course: 44 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
MTB Race course: 34 km with 930 m of elevation gain
Trail Running Half Marathon course: 25 km with 990 m of elevation gain
additional: The courses have significant elevation gain, ranging from 184 m for the Fun Run (6 km) to 1,180 m for the MTB Marathon (44 km). Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian to register. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. Telephone contact: +40-743-419443. Registration is exclusively online, and the event includes courses ranging from 6 km to marathon distance, suited to different fitness levels.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultramarathon held in Ion Creangă Children’s Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a 1,222.75-meter paved course, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and enthusiasts of endurance running, offering a transformative experience and an exceptional mental and physical challenge. There are also 50 km and 100 km races, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-meter paved course in Ion Creangă Children’s Park
The course is illuminated at night for runners’ safety
Two hydration and nutrition stations along the course, offering water, glucose, electrolytes, fruit, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal gear, food, and sleeping bags. Race kits must be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except relays. The event includes a runners’ briefing and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved, illuminated course, with the option to participate in several distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race held in Timișoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting wounded military personnel. The event promotes a winning spirit and national values through sport as part of the Invictus Romania project. The fourth edition continues the tradition of bringing runners and supporters together in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support wounded military personnel.
course_highlights: Symbolic courses in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
An event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition spanning more than a decade
additional: The event is part of a broader Invictus Romania project, which also includes other sporting competitions and activities supporting wounded military personnel. Official Invictus Heroes Half Marathon T-shirts are available for supporters. No details were found about start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timișoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This 21st anniversary race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in the men’s and women’s events and across age groups. Participants receive chipped bib numbers and “Joma” Dry Fit T-shirts, while the organizers provide transportation and a celebratory dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Bistrica, Petrovac na Mlavi
Chipped personalized bib number and “Joma” Dry Fit sports T-shirt
Transportation from the registration center to the race start and a celebratory dinner at the Olimpik swimming pools
additional: The participant package includes transportation from Belgrade (Arena) to Petrovac na Mlavi and back, with a tour leader. It is limited to 50 competitors who pay first. Participants receive a 50% discount on a day ticket to Ždrelo Spa. Special accommodation benefits are available for race participants at the Olimpic swimming pool. The race is part of the annual events honoring Dragutin Tomašević, with organization that includes timing, promotion, T-shirts, and medals for participants.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying distances and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural landscapes of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. The Golija PREMIUM race, starting at the summit of Golija, and the two-day ULTRA 66K stage race, which connects three mountains and offers a challenge for experienced runners, are particular highlights. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport and accommodation for participants, creating a welcoming and supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through spectacular landscapes featuring viewpoints, clearings and meadows
Race starts at elevations of 800 to 1833 meters above sea level
Electronic timing and staffed aid stations
additional: Free transport is provided for the Golija PREMIUM 29K race from Ivanjica to the start and from Kovilj back. ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race with overnight accommodation at a school in Kovilj, four meals, six aid stations and a gathering around a campfire. The first ULTRA 66K stage starts at 11h, and the second at 09h the following day. The race pack includes a race number, finisher’s medal, refreshments and lunch. Multiple distances, a two-day event, an available list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, and race packs with medals and meals.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for having been entered in the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we are running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, with the goal of taking part in a new Guinness World Record attempt in Serbia for the first time.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start across multiple countries and continents
Event with two Guinness World Records for the largest half marathon with a synchronized start
additional: Registration is at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište from 08:00 to 11:30 in the tent. The race pack includes a race bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, live results, and a diploma in PDF format. The race program includes a warm-up at 12:45, the start of the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races at 13:30, and the awards ceremony at 15:30. The event features races of different distances, is open to all ages, and race packs and medals are available to participants. It takes place in the center of Veliko Gradište, with morning registration and afternoon races.

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Lefkada Half Marathon is a night race organized by the Lefkada «Filandros» Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Region of the Ionian Islands. The event includes 21.1 km and 8 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, and the course runs around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with sunset views. The race is held under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and EOSLMA-Y.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 19:45
Course around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Schedule of events includes bib and chip collection, a pasta party, and awards. Children’s races have separate start times. The 8 km race starts at 17:45 and the 1 km children’s race at 16:30. Distances: 21.097 m and 8 km; races for children ages 6–12; parallel activities; courses in a protected NATURA area.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The “Angelis Govios” Road of Sacrifice is a historic road race being held for the 22nd year in Psachna, Evia, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Association under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Evian revolutionary military leader Angelis Govios and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The race starts in Psachna’s central square, and entry is free, with ample refreshments provided. The 15 km route is 50% unpaved, with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: 15 km route with 50% unpaved terrain and +131 m elevation gain.
5 km and 1 km routes on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
Start in Psachna’s central square.
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the start area and is free. Registration opens at 15:00. Ample refreshments are provided for runners. The event takes place on 29 May 2027, with the race starting at 17:00. It includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sport and historical remembrance.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke road race is organized by Stroke Hope Urban Non-Profit Company in cooperation with NeuroLife IKE, with the aim of raising awareness about prevention and supporting people affected by stroke. The event takes place at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes a 5 km race for runners and a 1 km race for children and people with disabilities. The race began in 2024 and aims to connect physical activity with health and social awareness. Technical direction is provided by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt route consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Eligibility: 5 km for people over 12 years of age with a medical certificate of fitness. 1 km for children aged 6–12, people with disabilities, and patients. The race includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY. The event will take place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, starting at 18:30, at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail in Metsovo is a challenging mountain race offering distances for all runners, from the 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain to shorter distances of 40 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as the 4.6 km Katara Vertical race. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains in the area, offering unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is ITRA-certified and is an important event for mountain-running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers provide for athletes’ safety and support, with aid stations and technical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain
40 km, 21 km, and 11 km races, plus a 4.6 km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: Races start at different times depending on the distance. Aid stations and technical support are available along the courses. The race is ITRA-certified and awards UTMB points for the 100 km ultramarathon. Information about accommodation and transport in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail also includes children’s races and special challenges, such as the 65.6 km URSA CHALLENGE with 4,810 m of elevation gain. The event combines racing and hiking, with an overnight stay in Metsovo and the involvement of volunteers and local organizations.

description: Casa Bună Sânpetru Half Marathon is a charity sporting event that offers participants the opportunity to run on varied, scenic routes in the Sânpetru area of Brașov. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, impeccable organization, and support for disadvantaged families through Casa Bună Sânpetru. The routes offer different levels of difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful scenery and sporting challenges. Taking part in this half marathon means not only enjoying a sporting experience, but also contributing to a worthy cause.
course_highlights: The “I’m serious, I’m not joking” route: 19 km with over 750 m of positive elevation gain
The “Come on, you can do it!” route: approximately 10 km with around 350 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular scenery and varied terrain around Lempes Hill, linking the villages of Hărman, Sânpetru, and Bod
additional: The race kit includes guaranteed items only for registrations made by May 10, 2026. The routes are well marked, with enough hydration and refreshment points. The event promotes social inclusion and supports the education of disadvantaged children through Casa Bună Sânpetru. Challenging routes with varied terrain, support for social causes, online registration, race kits, and volunteering activities.

name: Semimaraton Galați
distance_verbose: Maraton, Semimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 3000 metri, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.4 km
description: Semimaraton Galați is a philanthropic sporting event that combines athletic performance with social responsibility, bringing together professional and amateur runners, families, and volunteers. For more than 12 editions, the event has supported local community causes through registration fees and donations, funding projects focused on education, health, and social inclusion. The varied courses and community atmosphere make Semimaraton Galați a unique experience that brings sport closer to the community and promotes solidarity. The 2026 edition continues this tradition, offering races for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Varied courses: half marathon 21.1 km, cross-country race 10.5 km, and popular race 3 km
Races for children and pets, with distances from 400 m to 1000 m
Event held on Faleza Elice, Galați, with a community-focused and philanthropic atmosphere
additional: The event is philanthropic, supporting community causes through registration fees and donations. Races are available for all ages, including children and pets. The organizer is Fundația Comunitară Galați. Registration fees are treated as donations for local projects. The registration deadline is 8 May 2026. Participation in races, donations, sponsorships, volunteering, 500 m pet race

description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age categories, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed, competitive races for the older age groups. It is a race full of energy and joy, with support from parents, where every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Course in Central Park in Baia Mare
Races tailored to age categories from 0 to 14
Non-competitive Baby Run with medals and prizes for all participants
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 250, with 20 places for the Baby Run. Children may participate only with parental consent. Prizes are awarded for first, second, and third place in the timed races by age category, while the Baby Run is non-competitive, with medals and prizes for all participants. The event includes medical support, medals, prizes, and surprises for children. Registration is open until 16 May 2026.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, ranging from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a unique experience for mountain-running enthusiasts, combining narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridgelines. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special keepsakes for those who finish within the time limits.
course_highlights: Mountain trails featuring narrow paths and ancient forests
Routes across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines in the Bucegi Mountains
Start and finish near Bran Castle, an iconic landmark
additional: Previous experience on mountain trails is required for registration, with different requirements depending on the distance. After 1 May 2026, SportHG technical T-shirts will be replaced with neck gaiters. Places are limited, and registrations are confirmed after online payment and verification of previous experience. The event also includes other mountain races, such as a skyrace and a half marathon, and offers prizes and finisher mementos.

name: SH4H Concursul internaţional de alergare de anduranţă
location: Parcul Copiilor “Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: The S24H International Endurance Running Competition is an ultramarathon held in “Ion Creangă” Children’s Park in Timișoara, on a lit, paved loop measuring 1,222.75 metres. Participants can choose 6-, 12- or 24-hour events, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time. The event is open to professional and amateur runners, offering a transformative experience and the opportunity to test their physical and mental limits. It is organised to high standards, with international recognition and dedicated participant facilities.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-metre paved loop, illuminated at night
6-, 12- and 24-hour events, plus 50 km and 100 km races
Located in “Ion Creangă” Children’s Park in Timișoara
additional: The course is measured and IAAF-certified, with individual distance tracking and chip timing. Participants receive a race kit and finisher’s medal, and have access to a pasta party, hydration and fueling stations, equipment storage, free photos, recovery massage and emergency medical services. The event also includes a technical briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race. A paved, night-lit course and multiple duration and distance events for amateur and professional athletes.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Tibužde
Two distances: 27 km and 7 km
Views and challenging terrain
additional: The race runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous. Registration: online. Categories: multiple, including a children's race. After the race, there is a get-together with lunch and music.

name: Epidavrios Dromos Theater 2 Theater
location: Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, Epidavros, Greece

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with breathtaking views and challenges. This event combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature to create an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance featuring challenging and scenic mountain trails
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: The race offers distances from 6K to 95K, suitable for runners of different levels. There is a special race for children: DECATHLON Kids Run. A prize draw is held every month for registered participants. Multiple distances, mountain running, prize draw registration, children's race

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The Yordanka Arizanova Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes, who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Events at Plovdiv Stadium
Events: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditionally attracts accomplished sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes starts for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. The winners are presented with awards by Yordanka Arizanova’s daughter, Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is annual and takes place at Plovdiv Stadium; it includes the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards presented to the winners.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with impressive views and challenges. The unique Night Trail 6K and the DECATHLON Kids Run complete the program, turning the event into a true celebration of sporting spirit and love of nature. Organized by DECATHLON Plovdiv, the race promises excellent organization and unforgettable experiences in the beautiful area of Shiroka Laka, Smolyan.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance with challenging and scenic courses
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: Every month, DECATHLON gives prizes to registered participants through a raffle. The event includes distances for all ages, from the 6K night run to the 95K ultra. The organizer is DECATHLON Plovdiv, with an excellent rating for organization. Courses for various distances, mountain running, raffle registration, children's race

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea on June 6, 2026, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized personnel. Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course from ambulances and specialized personnel
additional: Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00. The race pack includes an official personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport. The entry fee is non-refundable if a participant withdraws, but the entry can be transferred until 16.05.2026. The event will take place on June 6, 2026, with participant facilities including race packs, hydration stations, and medical support.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: Race kit pickup is on Friday 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00, for BBB Ultra 60; mandatory gear checks apply, and pickup is for participants only. For the other distances, kits can be picked up on Saturday 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a single-use chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului is a sporting event dedicated to promoting outdoor activity, mountain running, and a healthy lifestyle. It welcomes participants of all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a variety of routes, from children’s races to a half marathon, in the authentic natural surroundings of Teiuș, Alba. It promotes inclusion, fair play, and active community participation, with free entry for all participants. A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.
course_highlights: The 21.1 km Half Marathon route through picturesque landscapes and unspoiled nature
The 11 km Cros X race for experienced runners
Short, accessible routes for families and children within the fairground
additional: Race kits can be collected on May 28–29, 2026, between 17:00 and 19:00, and on race day, May 30, 2026, between 07:00 and 08:00. Starts are scheduled from 08:15 for the Half Marathon and Cros X, while the children’s races and Family Run take place in the afternoon. The event offers age-category prizes and encourages families to take part together in the Family Run. Routes for all ages and levels include a half marathon, 11 km and 6 km races, Family Run, children’s races, and Kinder.

name: Thermal Trail Race
description: Thermal Trail Race is an outdoor running event that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event takes place in Băile 1 Mai, with the start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience in the natural landscape of the capital of thermal waters. This is the event’s 13th edition, bringing together running and nature enthusiasts in a friendly, active setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater)
14 km Cross course
7 km Mini course
additional: The event promotes outdoor exercise, a healthy lifestyle, and respect for nature. Start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Free entry. Outdoor trail-running terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

description: Baneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race in Băneasa Forest, Cluj-Napoca, offering an authentic nature experience. The event includes four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run for families. The race is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced, and focuses on the joy of running in the forest. Organized by a passionate team, the event also offers training plans and group training sessions to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest
Four races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Group training sessions with different paces and coordinators
additional: Group training sessions with different paces and coordinators. Training plans for all levels. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through Asociația Magic and Zi de Bine. A trail course with uneven terrain, roots, dirt roads, and forest paths; options for family and children's races; training sessions available.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful setting of Fruška Gora in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It draws cycling and active-holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and Vojvodina’s tourism potential.
course_highlights: Ride through Fruška Gora National Park
Beautiful landscapes and unspoiled nature
A variety of cycling trails and terrain
additional: The organizer is the Tourism Organization of Vojvodina. The event is held in Vrdnik, within Fruška Gora National Park. It promotes the combination of sport, nature and tourism in the region. Participants and visitors can enjoy a local-products market, activities for children and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. Admission for visitors is free, while prices vary for the different competitive disciplines.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The trail passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations with numerous caves, including an ascent to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership book stamped for 2026 and appropriate hiking equipment.
course_highlights: Ascent of Mount Devica, with lush vegetation and limestone formations
Visit to Marko Polo Cave and ascent to Soko Grad
Golem Kamen viewpoint and forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall
additional: Departure from Nebojšina Street at 06:00. The planned return to Belgrade is around 22:00–22:30. Participants must bring a jacket, a light hat, lightweight gloves, a raincoat, high-top hiking boots, gaiters, trekking poles, a change of clothes, a flashlight, their own first-aid kit, energy bars or nuts, magnesium for muscle cramps, and at least 1.5–2 L of water. There is no water along part of the trail. Lunch will be organized after the ascent, or participants may bring food in their backpacks. Participants must have a hiking membership book stamped for 2026. Equipment should include a jacket, hat, gloves, high-top hiking boots, trekking poles, a flashlight, first aid, food, and water.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: 1ο Backyard Ultra Δράμας
description: The 1st Drama Backyard Ultra starts and finishes at Kart Track 69 Speedway in Drama. Runners start at 08:00 in the morning in May and follow the Backyard Ultra format, completing a 6.7 km lap within each hour and continuing until only one runner remains. The course crosses the lush area of the Kallifytos stream, with 67 metres of elevation gain per lap, which accumulates over the hours. There is also a team endurance competition, in which the best team is determined by its total number of laps.
course_highlights: 6.7 km lap with 67 metres of elevation gain
Course through the lush area of the Kallifytos stream
Direction alternates every hour to avoid monotony
additional: Start and finish at Kart Track 69 Speedway. Aid-station provisions change as the race progresses: snacks and drinks at first, pasta, cold beer from lap 7, pizza from lap 10, and homemade soup from lap 15. Reflective markers for running at night. Team endurance cup, with results recorded at bigsbackyardultra.com. The course includes a crossing of the green Kallifytos stream, with 67 metres of elevation gain per lap. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, in which the winner is the last runner to complete a lap alone. Entry costs 40 euros.

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: The 6th Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 will take place on 30–31 May in Vasiliki, Lefkada. This two-day event features road races and mountain running and is organized by the Lefkada Tourism Company and the Tourism and Culture Association of the wider area. Events include children’s scooter races, an exhilarating 3,500-meter aquathlon combining swimming and running, and the classic 13,000-meter road race, which starts from Porto Katsiki Beach. The main road race starts at 18:00, offering a unique sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: 13,000-meter road race starting from Porto Katsiki Beach
3,500-meter aquathlon: 500 meters of swimming and 3,000 meters of running on trails and paved roads
Children’s scooter races of 1,000 and 1,500 meters on Vasiliki Beach
additional: The children’s scooter races start at midday on Saturday, 30 May, from Vasiliki Beach. The 3,500-meter aquathlon includes approximately 500 meters of swimming from Agiofylli Beach to the neighboring Valta Beach, followed by 3,000 meters of running on trails and paved roads, with two aid stations. The 13,000-meter main road race starts from Porto Katsiki Beach at 18:00. The event includes various categories and distances, and participation requires registration for a fee.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with varied climbs and descents
Beautiful natural views around the village of Zhelyava
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria and is aimed at amateurs and professionals who want to test themselves in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking competition in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying distances and elevation gain, suited to different categories of competitors, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes cross scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic – 62 km with 2,505 m of elevation gain
Murgash Classic – 40 km with 1,348 m of elevation gain
Zhelyava Trail – an iconic section with a 9.9 km climb
additional: The race includes junior boys’ and girls’ categories in different age groups, as well as an e-bike category with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes of varying distances and elevation gain are suitable for different fitness levels, including an e-bike category.

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km circular race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s Memorial House and winds through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past forest streams and waterfalls, to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then passes through Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish line is located. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: A 25 km circular course with 1,000 m of total elevation gain
Runs through the centuries-old Monastery Forests and past forest streams and waterfalls
Visits the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex
additional: A trail race focused on nature and cultural heritage. Participation is part of an international competition, and the race is intended for a wide range of runners.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: A 6.4 km main race in the outdoors
Children’s races with around 40 participants
A race in the natural surroundings of Mali Stapar
additional: Participants ranged in age from elementary school children to competitors over 70. The race is part of a sporting tradition and a prelude to larger sporting events in the region, such as the Friendship Race in Kula. It takes place in natural surroundings, with a focus on promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting camaraderie among participants of different age groups.

name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, Μαραθώνιος, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 12 km, 5 km
description: The organizers of the 5th Evrytania Trail Races invite you to run along the fir-covered trails of mountainous Evrytania, in one of Europe’s cleanest ecosystems. The races offer a unique opportunity to experience the magic of nature, cool off in the crystal-clear waters of the Krikellopotamos River, and enjoy the hospitality of traditional villages that serve as aid stations. The event includes races of different distances, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners, with beautiful and challenging courses combining trails, dirt roads, and paved roads.
course_highlights: Fir-covered trails, with trails making up 60% of all courses
Aid stations in traditional villages along the course
Elevation gains ranging from 350m to 1000m, depending on the distance
additional: The races include 6K, 12K, and 20K courses, with different time limits (2 hours for the 6K, 3 hours for the 12K, and 5 hours for the 20K). The 6K and 12K start on Saturday, May 30, at 17:00 from Krikello’s central square, while the 20K starts on Sunday, May 31, at 10:00 from the Prophet Elias grove in Domnista. Mandatory equipment is not required, but basic emergency gear and water are recommended. There is a generous time limit for walking or completing the course. The event is open to participants aged 16 and over (6K, 12K) and 18 and over (20K). The races combine trail running with cultural activities, with an emphasis on nature and local tradition. Participants should be prepared for challenging mountain routes and be self-sufficient with their equipment.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The 2nd Mountain Trail Running Races on the trails of the Valtinos Fighters – Chalkiopoulo Trail Run 2026 will take place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Neo Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania, with the start at 9 a.m. The event is organized by the Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the Chalkiopoulo Local Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races include two distances, 27 and 10 kilometers, crossing the beautiful mountain landscapes of Chalkiopoulo and Valtos and offering a unique mountain-running experience.
course_highlights: 27- and 10-kilometer routes on the trails of the Valtinos Fighters
Passages through local villages and natural landscapes, including Velaora, Paliagrapidia, Prophet Elias, and Saint Nicholas
Start and finish in Neo Chalkiopoulo, with varied terrain and a mountainous character
additional: The races are organized by the Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the Chalkiopoulo Local Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races start at 9 a.m. in Neo Chalkiopoulo. The 27 km route passes several local points of interest and villages, offering a complete mountain-running experience. Mountain-trail routes, a camping area, a meal for finishers, limited accommodation in the village—early booking is recommended.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: The 5th Posidonia Running Event will take place on May 31, 2026, in Piraeus, offering a 5-kilometer route through the city streets. The event welcomes runners from around the world and combines sport with support for charitable causes, as proceeds will go to the Municipality of Piraeus and its partner charities. The start and finish will be at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, with the race starting at 9:00 a.m. The event is part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition and promises a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometer route through the streets of Piraeus
Start and finish at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus
Held as part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition
additional: Registration for the race has already closed. The event supports charitable causes, with proceeds going to the Municipality of Piraeus and partner organizations. The race is open to people over 14 with medical clearance, with a limited number of participants and online registration. Proceeds go to charitable causes, and the event is an important meeting point for the shipping community.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Karya Olympus Trail is a mountain running race held in Karya, offering a unique experience for runners who love nature and the challenge of the mountains. The race showcases the beauty of Mount Olympus and the surrounding area, combining demanding trails with stunning views. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels, with the aim of promoting sport and local tradition. The organizers are welcoming and support participants every step of the way.
course_highlights: Mountain course on Mount Olympus
Trails with natural beauty and scenic views
Challenging terrain for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes different courses, with the longest race at 25 km, and takes place on the slopes of Mount Olympus, attracting runners of all levels. Taking part combines nature, endurance, and an authentic mountain atmosphere.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: The 42nd Distomo Sacrifice Road Race is a memorial race held on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Distomo, honoring the victims of the 1944 massacre. The 11.2-kilometer course starts at the historic site of Karakolithos and finishes at National Resistance Square. Entry is free, and a 1.1-kilometer children’s race starts at the same time. The organizers provide runner transport, timing, medical coverage, and refreshments along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 11.2-kilometer course with minor elevation changes
Starts at the historic site of Karakolithos
Finishes at National Resistance Square in Distomo
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:30 to 09:30 at the starting area. Organized bus transport for runners from National Resistance Square to the start is available between 07:30 and 08:30. Water stations are located at the 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th kilometers. Water, juice, and bananas are offered at the finish. Full medical coverage is provided, with a doctor and ambulance. The first three men and women are awarded prizes, and all finishers receive commemorative medals and participation certificates. The race is held in memory of the victims of the 1944 Distomo massacre, alongside commemorative events and activities in the area.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: The Karya Olympus Trail 2026 offers a unique mountain-running experience in the idyllic valley of Karya, under the protection of Mount Olympus. The routes follow marked trails with varying distances and elevation gains, suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes races of 25, 13, and 5 kilometers, as well as children’s races, with services such as electronic timing, commemorative medals, and technical T-shirts. The race starts early in the morning, while the awards ceremony takes place at the start-finish area. The region’s natural beauty and historical interest make the race a complete sporting and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Routes on marked trails with elevation gains from +285 m to +1500 m
Natural beauty of the Ziliana Valley and views of Mount Olympus
A range of distances from 0.6 Km to 25 Km, suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Services: race bib, commemorative medal, electronic timing chip, technical T-shirt for 25Km & 13Km, buff for 5Km, water and light snacks at the aid stations and finish, and a sweeper following the last runner. Awards ceremony at 13:00 at the start-finish area. Includes 25 km, 13 km, and 5 km routes, with organized services and commemorative items. Registration is open until 10 May 2026.

name: Titnata Trail
description: The Titnata Trail 13km is a short mountain-running race held in Karya, Greece. The 13-kilometer route includes +760 meters of elevation gain, offering a challenging uphill course on a marked trail. The race starts at 08:50 and is limited to 200 runners. Finishers receive a commemorative technical T-shirt.
course_highlights: 13 km marked mountain trail
+760 meters of elevation gain
Uphill and challenging course
additional: Limited to 200 runners. A course map is available to help participants prepare before the race. Trail race, registration fee 15 euros, technical T-shirt for finishers, trail map available

name: Αγώνας δρόμου ιστορικής μνήμης «Βασιλί – Δασόλοφος»
organizer: Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Βασιλί και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δασολόφου
description: The “Vasili–Dasolofos” historical remembrance road race is organized by the Vasili Cultural Association and the Dasolofos Cultural and Beautification Association in memory of the 40 Greeks executed in 1944. The race starts from the square in Vasili and passes through historic and picturesque locations in the area, honoring the memory of the heroes and promoting unity and historical awareness. After the finish, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen. The event combines sport with culture and history, inviting participants to send a message of remembrance and respect.
course_highlights: Start at the square in Vasili
Route via the Folklore Museum, the Enipeas Bridge, the Vamvakou square, and the villages of Revmata and Sitochoro
Finish at the square in Dasolofos
additional: After the race, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen in Kato Dasolofos by the Municipality of Farsala. Those interested in registering can contact the presidents of the associations. A road race with a historical and cultural character, a route through villages, a remembrance ceremony, and a memorial service.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: The Karya Mini Trail is part of the Karya Olympus Trail, held in Karya, an idyllic valley on Mount Olympus. The 5-kilometre route follows a marked trail with 285 metres of elevation gain, offering a beautiful mountain-running experience. The event also includes longer routes and children’s races, with provisions such as electronic timing, souvenirs and refreshments. With its rich history and natural beauty, Karya offers a unique setting for runners and visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km route on a marked trail
+285 metres of elevation gain
Natural scenery in the Ziliana Valley near Karya
additional: Amenities: race bib, commemorative buff for the 5 km race, electronic timing chip, water and light refreshments at aid stations and at the finish, and a sweeper following the last runner. Awards ceremony at 13:00 at the start/finish area. Mountain terrain; includes a medal, T-shirt, water stations, and online registration with bank transfer.

name: Tihiorace Ultra Edition
description: Tihiorace Ultra Edition is a challenging mountain running event held amid the stunning scenery of Tihio, Dorida, Greece. It features three long ultradistance routes with substantial elevation gain, offering unique trails through nature. The event is for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the natural environment, with distances ranging from 75 to 250 kilometers. The organizers are welcoming and support participants with useful information and facilities.
course_highlights: Unique trails through stunning natural scenery
Substantial elevation gain (up to 14,000 m)
Ultradistance routes of 75 km, 170 km, and 250 km
additional: The event features three routes: UltraSummits TihioRace 250Km, X-Ultra TihioRace 170Km, and 75-Ultra Tihiorace 75km, with elevation gains of 14,000 m, 9,100 m, and 3,500 m, respectively. The organizers also provide information about accommodation, access, restaurants, and attractions in the Tihio, Dorida area. Support is also available for athletes with disabilities in other events organized by the same team. The event features rugged mountain terrain and multiple ultra routes, and entries are open until 17/05/2026. There are options across various ultra distances, with significant elevation gain and beautiful scenery.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling and running competition set in the spectacular landscape of the Măcin Mountains. The courses offer a range of difficulty levels, from technical and demanding routes for experienced cyclists to more accessible routes for amateurs. The event emphasizes safety, fair play, and fun, making it suitable for outdoor sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sporting challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers provide a well-organized and friendly experience.
course_highlights: The 54 km long course with 1,700 m of elevation gain is technical and difficult, with spectacular climbs and descents
The 32 km short course with 600 m of elevation gain is easy to moderately technical, with an approximately 6 km climb and a long 9 km descent
The 23 km half-marathon course is technical and difficult, while the 12 km cross-country course is easy to moderately technical and suitable for trail runners
additional: Registration is exclusively online from 1 March to 4 June 2026. Participants under 18 must present a statement signed by a parent or guardian. The courses are not artificially prepared and offer a variety of technical and physical challenges. Registration is confirmed after payment of the fee, which can be made by card or bank transfer. The organizers recommend following safety and fair-play rules on the course. Participants must have the required equipment, including a bicycle in good working order and a helmet. Registration is online, with the registration period running from 1 March to 4 June 2026. The event includes categories for different age groups and teams, as well as a corporate race.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
price_range: 8.000 dinara po timu (1.600 dinara po članu)
description: The charity IT race “Relay with Heart” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. The event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, lead an active lifestyle, and give back to the community in the fortress’s beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at historic Niš Fortress
A charitable atmosphere and spirit of community
Bringing the IT community together through sport
additional: Registration is open, and all proceeds will be donated to Nurdor to improve accommodation facilities for parents of children with cancer. The event also includes a post-race music gathering in the garden of the Mountaineers’ Lodge.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: The Nea Smyrni Night Run 2026 is a 5-kilometer race organized by the Municipality of Nea Smyrni in collaboration with the Attica Region and the Nea Smyrni Commercial Association, as part of World Environment Day. The event has a sporting, ecological, and recreational character, aiming to promote environmental protection and sustainable development. The course follows El. Venizelou Street, with the start and finish at 54 Omirou Street. A concert and party follow the race, while local shops take part with special offers and discounts.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer course along El. Venizelou Street
Night race with music at points along the course
Start and finish at 54 Omirou Street
additional: Registration opens on 13/05 at 12:00, with an extension until 19/05 at 12:00 for a limited number of places with professional timing and a bib number. At the finish, athletes receive medals, bananas, and water. All participants receive free access to a full set of photos and a certificate of participation by email. A concert and party follow the race, while shops in Nea Smyrni stay open with special offers until 22:30. 5 km course, public roads, events, concert, happenings, participation through online registration, events and happenings, updates in the coming days.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wilderness of Vitosha. The race features three distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Courses of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2,000, 1,300, and 600 meters
Passage over Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha (2,290 m)
Varied terrain: forest trails, wet peat, rocky paths, streams, and moraines
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip. The awards ceremony takes place in front of Aleko Hut after the third finisher in each distance and group crosses the finish line. Every participant receives a medal and a one-week gym training pass at Next Level. Participants who have paid the entry fee receive a 30% discount on Salomon products and 10% on Suunto products at Sport Box. GPS devices are recommended for navigating the courses. The courses range from 12 km to 40 km and include an ascent of Cherni Vrah; conditions include mud, rocks, forests, and open meadows; registration is online or on site.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The Under-18 National Championship in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides young athletics talents with an opportunity to compete and develop.
course_highlights: Track competitions in Stara Zagora
Participation by young athletes under 18
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The competition will bring together young athletes from across the country and will be an important part of the national sports program for young people.

name: Maratonul Nordului

tiers.description: Înscrieri validate până la 10 aprilie beneficiază de tricoul oficial

description: The Northern Marathon is a sporting event that brings together nature and spirit in northern Romania, offering spectacular routes for runners of all levels. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, taking place amid the impressive natural landscapes of Botoșani and its surroundings. Participants can choose from several races, including marathon, trail, and MTB, enjoying a complete experience that combines sport with tourism and local culture.
course_highlights: Spectacular routes through northern Romania
A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities
additional: Registrations validated by April 10 guarantee the official race T-shirt. After June 20, the technical T-shirt or personalized items in the race kit are not guaranteed. The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: msg Maraton Apuseni
organizer: Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și msg Maraton Apuseni
description: Maraton Apuseni is a landmark mountain-running event held amid the picturesque landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains, in the Buscat Resort area of Cluj County. The event offers five varied routes, ranging from ultramarathon and marathon to half marathon, cross-country and a family race for children and parents. Participants enjoy an authentic experience in nature, crossing dense forests, spectacular ridgelines and traditional villages in a friendly, festive atmosphere. The event is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, and celebrates its 15th edition in 2026, promising sporting challenges and opportunities to socialize at the mountain’s pace.
course_highlights: Technical courses with significant elevation gain: ultramarathon +3100 m, marathon +2531 m, half marathon +1110 m
Varied scenery: dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, alpine meadows and traditional villages
A festival atmosphere with activities for all ages, including family races and related events
additional: The ultramarathon starts at 05:00. Technical briefings for each race take place on race day. The Family Race has staggered starts by age group at 12:30 and 13:00. The event includes activities for children, family yoga, a party and an awards ceremony. The organizer recommends booking accommodation and transport in advance. Routes to suit every taste, a mountain adventure event, promotion of nature and local traditions, volunteering activities, and a social cause supporting reforestation.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain biking competition held in the Greci area of Tulcea County, with an emphasis on fun and fair play. The courses are mountainous and challenging, yet accessible, offering participants an authentic experience in nature. The event is intended both for experienced cyclists and for those who want to enjoy an active day outdoors in a friendly, well-organized setting.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with steep slopes and rugged terrain
Sections with reduced visibility and varying weather conditions
A course that requires navigation skills and adherence to safety rules
additional: Registration is exclusively online from 1 March to 4 June 2026. Registration is confirmed after the fee is paid, which must be done within a maximum of 5 calendar days. Underage participants must present a declaration signed by a parent or guardian. Participants are advised to follow safety and fair-play rules on the course. An event with activities for the whole family, promoting cycling and outdoor sports.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
location: Hotel La Castel and Palatul Culturii, Iași, Romania

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Iași Sports Festival is a sporting event for everyone, from beginners to advanced competitors, held in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas. It includes a range of events, such as trail running, mountain biking, orienteering, road running, a children's race, and a race for people with special abilities. Participants can enjoy an active weekend with challenging courses, electronic timing, and prizes in the Open categories. The festival promotes physical activity for everyone and also offers a multisport trophy to those who take part in all events. The starts and finishes are at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture.
course_highlights: Courses in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas
Start/finish at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture
A variety of courses for all levels, including events for families and people with special abilities
additional: Taking part in multiple events brings discounts of up to 40%. Start/finish at Hotel La Castel (Saturday) and the Palace of Culture (Sunday). The competition takes place in all weather conditions, except in extreme weather. Participants must wear suitable equipment. Parking is limited; carpooling is recommended. Transport details are in the Participant Guide. Courses are in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas. Discounts may be available for taking part in multiple events. The event takes place from 5–7 June 2026.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Apuseni Marathon is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of courses to suit all tastes and experience levels. Participants can choose between the ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and a family race, enjoying picturesque landscapes, shaded trails, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized with passion by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch. The festival atmosphere and sporting challenge come together to create a memorable experience in nature.
course_highlights: Routes through dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, and alpine meadows
Passage through traditional villages and alpine pastures
Significant elevation gains for each race, with varied scenery
additional: Ultramarathon start at 05:00. Technical briefings are held for each race. Race kits can be collected in the days leading up to the event and on race day. The event also includes activities for children and families, a party, and an awards ceremony. The courses are ITRA-scored, and some are UTMB Series pre-qualifiers. Varied routes, volunteer activities, partnerships with sports clubs and local sponsors, and a social-impact event supporting reforestation.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites participants from Romania and abroad, amateurs and professionals alike, to test their limits over the Long, Middle and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a lively Art Nouveau city with a rich cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting, with numerous tourist attractions and modern facilities. The organizers offer attractive prizes to reward each participant’s determination and passion.
course_highlights: Various distances: Long, Middle and Olympic
Location in Oradea, a city with 89 Art Nouveau landmarks
Event for both amateurs and professionals
additional: Payment can be made online by bank card through EuPlatesc (Visa/Maestro/Mastercard) with no commission. The event is organized by Asociația Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor, based in Oradea. Oradea has many tourist attractions, including Oradea Fortress and Aquapark Nymphaea, providing a pleasant setting for participants and their companions. The event also includes X-Run races of 10 km and 21 km, with online registration and prizes for the winners.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
location: Muntele Băișorii, Munții Apuseni, Alba, Romania
description: Maraton Apuseni is a landmark mountain running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of courses for all tastes and experience levels. Participants can choose between the ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and a family race, enjoying picturesque landscapes, shaded trails, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, with a friendly, festive atmosphere. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, and alpine meadows
Significant elevation gains: ultramarathon +3100 m, marathon +2531 m, half marathon +1110 m
Technical and varied routes, including races for families and beginners
additional: Ultramarathon starts at 05:00. Technical briefings for the ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race take place on race morning. Race kits can be collected in the days before the event and on race day. Related events for families and children take place throughout the day. The Family Race has staggered starts by age category. The event also includes a DJ party after the award ceremony. Participants can choose from several trail running distances, and the event promotes environmental and reforestation initiatives in the Apuseni Mountains.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
