description: Romanați Trail Run is a vibrant mountain-running race held in Caracal, turning the city into the trail-running capital for a day. The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about staying active. The race has a sporting and charitable focus, promoting the values of sport and team spirit. The competition is scheduled to start at 10:00, and participants can choose between a half marathon and two cross-country races.
course_highlights: Three challenging courses for all levels
The half marathon 23K and cross-country 12K start together in Constantin Poroineanu Park
The 22.9 km half-marathon course is the same for women and men
additional: Registration is completed by filling out the form on the 42km.ro platform, and the participation fee must be paid by bank transfer within 3 business days of registration. Children can register on-site on race day between 07:00 and 09:30. The event also includes a prize raffle. Trail courses of approximately 23 km, 12 km, and 5 km; online registration; charitable component; event in Caracal; scheduled for June 6, 2026.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Dušan Milošević, the first Serbian Olympian, and follows the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, with the aim of honoring his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. There are three courses: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more demanding Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and togetherness.
course_highlights: The Vihor course runs above Stragari, with views of Bukulja, Kosmaj, Avala, and the Ramać heights
The Rudnik course follows genuine trail paths and forest roads, with steep climbs and descents
There are 2 aid stations with food and drinks on the Vihor course, and 4 on the Rudnik course
additional: The Domaćinska course is a non-competitive event for those who do not want to race, and the race takes place on June 6. It is organized by the “Dušan Milošević - First Serbian Olympian” Association as a tribute to his courage and place in history. Three courses: 5 km Domaćinska (non-competitive), start and finish in Stragari, support organization, safe conditions, and a sporting and recreational character.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: Kup Fruške Gore 2026 is a traditional sporting, competitive and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of routes, including an ultra extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, a medium eastern marathon and novice routes, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and an opportunity to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide organized transport to the start, as well as extensive support throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Medium eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Novice routes with 1–2 ITRA points
additional: Organized transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is available from 6 a.m. on Saturday. On-site registration for the FUN routes is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packs are collected before the race. The event is supported by numerous patrons and sponsors. It includes various sporting challenges and outdoor activities, with opportunities for both recreational runners and competitors. Details about registration and programs will be available soon.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition bringing together elite and junior riders in men’s and women’s categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel in the beautiful setting of Andrevlje, it lasts four days, offering a fantastic atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked courses, and a generous race package with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines sporting passion with Serbia’s natural beauty.
course_highlights: Fully marked course with GPS navigation
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish
Electronic timing and a chip-equipped race number
additional: The race package includes a chip-equipped race number, electronic timing, an official race T-shirt for registrations received by 15.03.2026., a finisher medal, on-site support from the OTIS team, 3 professional photographers with free photos, a downloadable GPS track, and online results. The race time limit is 3 hours. Race-pack collection is from 09:00 to 11:30, and the awards ceremony is at 15:00. Participation includes electronic timing, bike washing, medical support, and parking; registration is open; the event lasts four days and features different races.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: The 10th Anniversary Road Race “The Passage of the Apostle Paul” is organized by the Holy Metropolis of Kitros, Katerini and Platamon, the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros, and the “ZEUS” Athletic and Cultural Association of Runners of Pieria. The race is 10,000 meters long and follows a paved route through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos. It starts at the Church of the Apostle Paul in Methoni’s central square and finishes at Ancient Pydna. The scenic route features gentle climbs and descents and is marked throughout.
course_highlights: 10 km paved route
Passes through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos
Starts at the Church of the Apostle Paul and finishes at Ancient Pydna
additional: The race is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultramarathons. Cultural associations and organizations from the area take part. Runners of all distances and sports enthusiasts are invited to run or walk the route. It takes place on June 20, 2026, with the start and finish at Ancient Pydna, and includes cultural and sporting activities.

name: Global Day Run
description: Global Day Run Patras 2026 is a friendly running event held in Agia, Patras, aiming to promote running as a way to improve physical and mental health. The event includes 8 km and 4 km races and a 1 km children’s race, aimed mainly at beginner runners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. As part of the global celebration of running, the event encourages families and friends to take part without a competitive focus. The race starts on the afternoon of Saturday, June 6, 2026, on Agia Beach.
course_highlights: 8 km and 4 km courses along Agia Beach, starting and finishing at the park benches opposite the snack kiosk
1 km children’s race on a dirt course with minimal elevation changes inside the park
A beginner- and recreational-runner-friendly course in a natural setting
additional: The children’s race starts 300 meters before the finish and follows a dirt course with minimal elevation changes. The event is part of the global celebrations for World Running Day and is aimed mainly at beginners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. Organized in cooperation with the Municipality of Patras, it includes 8 km and 4 km races and a 1 km children’s race on dirt courses, with medals and cups awarded afterward.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain routes and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of courses featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with peaks and valleys
River crossings and forest trails
The scenic natural beauty of the Rhodope Mountains
additional: All participants who finish within the cutoff time receive a finisher’s medal for the 60 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 9 km distances. Included are a T-shirt with an original design, gifts in the race pack, timing, a medical examination when collecting the race number, medical teams during the event, race photography, and securing all necessary permits. Multiple routes, mountain terrain, natural beauty, and a race for amateurs and professionals.

description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. The race features teams of 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run events, and every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active time with colleagues.
course_highlights: Relay: 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km (4.8 km total)
Power Walk: a team of 4 completes one 4 km lap together
CEO Dash: one 1.2 km lap
additional: Every participant receives accident insurance from MetLife for the day of the event. Each team receives a set of beach towels, an assembled medal, a plaque showing the company's placing, and gifts from partners. Laser engraving on the medals is available (€40 excluding VAT per team), as is a branded tent (€1,000 excluding VAT). Arriving at least an hour early is recommended; a cloakroom is available. The car park at Vasil Levski Stadium is closed, so taking the metro is recommended. A team-building event with various activities, company participation, an urban course, and different prices depending on the registration date.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council, taking place on 7 June 2026. The event features cross-country races over 5 km and 10 km, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at the Tinca communal stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest beside the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop through the forest beside the communal stadium
5 km race: 2 laps; 10 km race: 4 laps
Marked with red-and-white tape; start and finish at Tinca communal stadium
additional: Participants can confirm their attendance on Saturday from 17:00 to 19:30 at Tinca communal stadium, or on race day from 8:00 to 9:30. Technical briefings will be held on Saturday, 06.06.2026, at 19:00 and on race day at 9:00. A refreshment point at the start will offer water, isotonic drinks, soft drinks, and fruit. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian and copies of their ID cards. Athletes suspended for doping may not participate. Cross-country courses; online registration is open until 31 May 2026, with on-site registration available if needed.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 is the third edition of the race, held in Višnjica, on the outskirts of Belgrade, on June 7, 2026. The race combines sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful landscapes, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at Dunavska Terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. An entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.
course_highlights: The course passes by the Church of St. Nicholas, built in 1842
Views of the Danube and Belgrade from a viewpoint
The course passes by the protected habitat of the European bee-eater
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip, an official Village Trail T-shirt, and a finisher's medal for everyone who completes the race within the time limit. Professional race photos and a detailed plan will be sent by email before the race. A special entertainment program is provided for children and families, and runners can enjoy the after-run party. Participation includes medals, T-shirts, and organizational support, and the race is intended for fans of trail running and nature.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: The Vlasti Wind Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event held in the natural surroundings of Vlasti, Kozani. It combines the sporting experience with promoting the harmonious coexistence of people and nature, with an emphasis on Renewable Energy Sources and sustainable development. The event is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation, supporting the local community and highlighting the value of clean energy. The routes offer a unique experience amid beautiful natural scenery, with respect for the environment and local tradition.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with positive elevation gain of +500 m (21 km) and +250 m (9 km)
Natural surroundings of the wider Vlasti area in Kozani
Emphasis on harmonious coexistence with nature and Renewable Energy Sources
additional: Race office hours: 08:30–09:30. Passing through all checkpoints is mandatory. A commemorative medal, refreshments at aid stations, a meal the evening before and after the race, medical coverage, and photography coverage throughout the event are provided. Littering outside designated areas, damaging flora, or disturbing fauna is prohibited. An organized camping area is available near the start, with respect for nature. The race includes routes through mountainous terrain, with provisions and safety rules, and is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: The 2nd Kourouta Road Race 2026 invites runners to take on a course where the road meets the waves, offering unique views of the Aegean Sea. The event features 10 km, 4,300 m, and a 1,000 m children’s race, with electronic timing and a commemorative medal for all finishers. The organizers provide medical coverage from the Hellenic Red Cross and traffic safety support from the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. The start and awards ceremony take place in Kourouta Central Square, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course with views of the Aegean Sea
1,000 m children’s race for primary and middle school students
Electronic chip timing and commemorative finisher’s medal
additional: The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 11:00 in Kourouta Central Square. Medical support is provided by the Hellenic Red Cross. Traffic support is provided by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. Children may participate with a signed declaration from a parent or guardian. Race packs will be distributed on Saturday in Amaliada and on Sunday in Kourouta, from early morning. There are three different races: 10 km, 4.3 km, and a 1 km children’s race. The awards ceremony will take place after the race, with trophies for the top three men and women in the 10 km race. The course is paved, with a short unpaved section, and both the start and finish are in Kourouta Central Square.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: The 2nd Sykourio Trail is a mountain running race held in the Sykourio area of the Municipality of Tempi, on Mount Kissavos, on June 7, 2026. It features three routes of varying difficulty and distance, crossing trails, dirt roads, and paved roads for a full mountain running experience. The race is open to runners of all ages, with a special route for children within the settlement. The event provides electronic timing, food and water along the route, and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes on trails, dirt roads, and paved roads
1,200 m of positive elevation gain on the main 21 km route
1 km children’s race within the settlement of Sykourio
additional: Registration opens on March 28, 2026, and closes on June 1, 2026. Entry includes a race bib or electronic timing chip, food and water along the route, and refreshments at the finish. Registration is individual only, and payment is accepted exclusively online by credit or debit card. Online public registration runs from March 28 to June 1, 2026, and includes a bib/chip, aid stations, and a technical briefing. The routes vary in difficulty and require preparation suited to their distances.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: The 4th Sykareios Road Race takes place in Kryoneri, Attica, on Sunday, June 7, 2026. It offers two distances, 15 km and 5.5 km, starting and finishing at the Kryoneri Municipal Unit Gate. The race is open to runners of various ages and offers commemorative medals to all finishers, as well as awards to the top men and women. The organizers emphasize runner safety and support, with aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: 15 km course with a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes
5.5 km course with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes
Aid stations with water and isotonic drinks approximately every 3 km on the long course
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:00 at the start/finish area. Participation is limited to 250 runners in the 15 km and 200 in the 5.5 km. Awards are given to the top three men and women overall in each distance. The race takes place in the morning, starting at 07:20, and includes scenic routes through the area's natural landscapes.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: The 4th Argithea Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held in the area of Petrito, Karditsa, on June 7, 2026. It includes several courses, such as the Argithea Skyrace 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain, the Vlachogiannis Race 15 km with 700 m of ascent, a 5 km family race, and a 1 km children’s race. There is also the Lakos Vertical course, 3.6 km with 700 m of ascent, offering a unique experience on trails through a fir forest with views of the Agrafa peaks. The race attracts runners who love the mountains and a challenge, while also offering activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Argithea Skyrace: 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain
Vlachogiannis Race: 15 km with 700 m of ascent
Lakos Vertical: 3.6 km with 700 m of continuous ascent through a fir forest
additional: The Lakos Vertical course starts from the Vasilades settlement and climbs continuously along an old stone-paved path and trails with potable water. The finish is at Tsoutes, at an elevation of 1,750 m, with views of the Aforismeni, Karagounis, and Delidim peaks. There are also races for families and children, as well as hiking and mountain bike races. The event includes mountain running races, a vertical race, family and children’s courses, and activities on the natural trails and in the landscapes of the Thessalian Agrafa mountains.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: The 5th Aqua Mare Road Race takes place in Megara, with the start and finish at Varea Beach, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar. Participants can choose between two courses, 10 km and 5.3 km, running alongside the waves on a beautiful coastal route. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with free transport and a commemorative T-shirt for runners. The race starts early in the morning, making for a day filled with adrenaline and relaxation.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5.3 km courses by the sea
Start and finish at Varea Beach in Megara, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar
Coastal scenery with views of the waves
additional: Free athlete transport by bus from Aigaleo to Megara and back. Departure at 07:15 a.m. from Davaki Square (Aigaleo) and return at 14:00 from Megara. A commemorative T-shirt is also available for purchase at a cost of 8 euros. Registration is open until June 2, 2026. Free bus transport from Aigaleo. Participation is limited to adults with a medical certificate. The entry includes a timing chip, medal, water, and a T-shirt (optional).

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: The 6th Raches Run - Agroinvest is a sporting event organized by the Raches Interactive Association ALOPI on Raches Beach in Phthiotis. It includes 10,000-meter and 5,000-meter races, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children, promoting sports and social solidarity. The race showcases the beauty and history of the area while strengthening participants’ connection with the village and the local community.
course_highlights: 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, plus a 1,000 m race for children
Held on Raches Beach in Phthiotis
Promotes cultural heritage and local development
additional: The routes are safe and marked with signs and ribbons, and the event takes place in warm summer weather. No specific information about entry fees is available.

name: Artemida Sunset Run
location: Δημοτικό Γήπεδο Αρτέμιδος, Σπάτα, East Attica, Greece
description: The Artemida Sunset Run is the first road race to be held in Artemida, offering 5- and 10-kilometer routes at sunset. The routes are predetermined and marked on public roads, with the start and finish at the Artemida Municipal Stadium. The event includes electronic timing, participation medals, an event T-shirt, and awards by age category. The race is open to runners aged 15 and over, with a total participation limit of 300 runners across both distances.
course_highlights: Route along the seafront, with a turnaround point at the small church where it meets Androu Street
Marked route on public roads, with two laps for the 10,000 meters
Water stations and electronic timing at two points
additional: Collect the timing chip and event T-shirt from the Spata Municipal Stadium before race day. Participation is limited to 300 runners across the 5,000- and 10,000-meter distances. Time limits are 40 minutes for the 5,000 meters and 70 minutes for the 10,000 meters. There is a baggage-storage area and an ambulance providing medical coverage throughout the race. The event includes activities and participant check-in at the Municipal Stadium, with participants aged 15 and over. Participation is limited, with starts at 19:00 and 19:05, and includes a medal, T-shirt, and refreshment stations.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: Kilkis Trail is organized by the Kilkis Runners’ Health Association and offers a variety of races, including the main 20-kilometer trail race, a 4.8 km health run, a 4x4.8 km relay, and a 1 km children’s race. The Kilkis Trail course follows trails and dirt roads around the city of Kilkis, with gentle slopes and technical sections, covering approximately 850 meters of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the Kilkis summer cinema, offering runners a beautiful and challenging experience. The race takes place on Sunday, June 7, 2026, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 20 km course on trails and dirt roads, with 850 meters of elevation gain
Technical trails that require care and experience
Start and finish at the Kilkis summer cinema
additional: The Kilkis Trail course is marked with signs, course tape, and markers. The cutoff time for the Kilkis Trail is 13:00, 3.5 hours after the start. Bib pickup is on Saturday 17/6 at Town Hall Square and on Sunday 18/6 at the start area, from 7:30 a.m. until 15 minutes before the start. There are cafés and food shops near the start-finish area. The event includes registration, detailed information about the courses and schedule, and an emphasis on community and health.

name: 5ο CHOLOMON TRAIL
description: The 5th Cholomon Trail mountain race is organized by the Chalkidiki Runners and Walkers Association “Ypsizonos” and offers three distances—10, 21, and 50 kilometers—through the dense forest of Cholomon. The routes cross trails lined with imposing trees and pass through natural landscapes of unparalleled beauty, offering a unique mountain-running experience. Free entry is also available to those who donate blood to the association’s blood bank. The race is supported by the Chalkidiki Regional Unit, the Municipality of Polygyros, and the Polygyros Forestry Department.
course_highlights: 50 km with 2,800+ meters of elevation gain: 1 km paved road, 10 km dirt road, and 39 km trail
12-hour time limit, with a cutoff at 6 hours at the 30.5 km aid station
Water, isotonic drinks, and snacks during the race
additional: Free entry for those who donate blood to the association’s blood bank (applies to the 10 km and 21 km races). Group registrations of 10 people receive a €5 discount for the 50 km and 21 km races, and a €2 discount for the 10 km race. All 50 km runners receive a hiking backpack, technical T-shirt, and commemorative medal. Payment must be made within 3 days of registration, and no later than 28/05/2026. Three different race distances, mountain-running races, start and finish in Polygyros, Chalkidiki, with a 12-hour time limit to complete the race.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings, with the aim of becoming the area’s largest running event and attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.
course_highlights: Urban and trail routes in Sfântu Gheorghe and the surrounding forests
A range of distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), 23 km trail, and children’s races
Routes suited to all experience levels, with urban and natural scenery
additional: The event also includes special races such as Vertical Night Run, Nordic Walking, Gen Z Run, and Kids Run. There is a separate edition called Sepsi Inst. Run 2, with 5 km and 8 km routes, featuring a quiz along the course and special prizes. After the race, participants can enjoy healthy snacks and film screenings in Piața Libertății. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and trail races, with registration periods in March, April, and May. The event has a festival atmosphere, with an emphasis on promoting the city and its surroundings.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: Maraton, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1500 metri, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a traditional sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a range of races for all ages and skill levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Themed routes inspired by dinosaurs and prehistoric tribes
The 43 km T-Rex MTB & E-Bike race, the ultimate test of strength and endurance
A variety of trail running and mountain biking routes in the Palilula area of Craiova
additional: The cycling events take place on June 13, and the running events on June 14. Cycling helmets are mandatory for all competitors. Mountain bikes with 26-, 27.5-, or 29-inch wheels are permitted, and electric bikes are accepted only in the MTB & E-Bike categories. Special volunteering and cleanup activities are also organized before and after the event. mountain biking, running, family-friendly, multiple categories, community impact

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championships for under-14 athletes in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents the opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Events at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo
Classic track and field events for under-14 athletes
Two-day format with more than 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Otvad Mosta is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants pass over four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Crossing four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as the Kakrina Inn and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is available online or in person on certain days. During the last two weeks before the event, registration is available with restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise is available in on-site sizes. The fee is determined by the time of payment. A medical examination is not required for the 5 km run. Included are aid stations with food and drinks, a finisher’s medal, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. Duathlon: 40 km cross-country cycling + 12 km running; charity campaign; historical routes; nature views.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 метра, 3000 метра, 1500 метра, 0.8 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: The “Nikola Valchanov” athletics tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprints and shot put, for age groups ranging from under-14s to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and begins with an official opening at 11:00.
course_highlights: Events at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 events, including sprints and shot put
Participation across age groups, from under-14s to men and women
additional: The tournament’s official opening is at 11:00 at Aprilov Stadium. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event features events for different age groups. The tournament includes 17 events, with participants from 23 clubs, and has a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race in the Bucegi Mountains, along the Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera route. The event takes place in the first ten days of June, when the landscape is dominated by ridges tinged red with rhododendron. The race offers runners a combination of intensity and natural beauty, and at the finish participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță. It is an authentic mountain experience, starting at the Peștera cable car, with a friendly, traditional atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route: Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera
Scenery with rhododendron flowers and red-tinged ridges
Participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță at the finish
additional: The start area is at the Peștera cable car. The event has been held since 2015. The organizers welcome participants with a warm, traditional atmosphere. Breathtaking mountain routes, start and finish at Peștera, mandatory equipment, cutoff times for the 41 km and 24 km races

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Harghita, Romania
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Bistra Mureșului. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon with more than 2,100 m of elevation gain, a half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, as well as races for families and children. The marathon route passes through spectacular scenery, with aid and checkpoint stations, and includes sections of forest road, unmarked trails, and lookout areas. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each race. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and a bonfire after the race.
course_highlights: A 42 km mountain route with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular views toward the Călimani Ridge and areas with exposed viewpoints
Multiple aid, hydration, and checkpoint stations along the route
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00, and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. Mandatory equipment is checked at the start. Each race has time limits and intermediate checkpoints. Competitor parking is arranged on a forest road 1.3 km from the start/finish area. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00, and the Mini MSD ceremony at 17:00, followed by a bonfire. The event also includes family races and mini races, with registration details available on the official website.

name: The Color Run Iași

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inscriere gratuita pentru copii 0-6 ani (numar de concurs, medalie, pudra colorata, fara tricou)

description: The Color Run Iași 2026 is an untimed 5-kilometer race full of color and positive energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are showered with powder at every kilometer, finishing the race in a vibrant cloud of colors. The event takes place in front of the Palace of Culture in Iași and offers a festival atmosphere with music and fun for all ages, making it perfect for a memorable day with friends and family. It is an experience accessible to everyone, including children and people with disabilities, with free or full-kit registration options.
course_highlights: 5 km route in central Iași, starting and finishing at the Palace of Culture
Color-powder stations at every kilometer
Festival atmosphere with music and a cloud of colored powder at the finish
additional: The event has staggered starts at 5-minute intervals, and participants must wear their race number visibly on their shirt. There is no baggage storage. Bicycles, rollerblades, scooters, and pets are not allowed. The standard kit includes a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder. Children aged 0–6 can participate free of charge without a T-shirt, receiving only a number, medal, and powder. People with disabilities and their companions receive free admission. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, race number, bandana, temporary tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and fun for all ages.

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held amid the spectacular scenery of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is aimed at mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to socialize and push personal limits. On June 13, 2026, participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of Retezat.
course_highlights: Technical trails along steep ridges and mountain paths
Spectacular scenery of valleys and alpine lakes
Aid stations with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup are available from 16:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:30 on race day. The kit includes a personalized race bib and a technical item for the first 800 participants. Aid stations with water and food are available along the routes. The awards ceremony takes place at 17:30. DJ Cătălin Sănătescu provides the atmosphere throughout the event. There is also a children’s race, Retezat SkyRace Kids Race. Spectacular mountain trails, online registration, categories and prizes, annual event.

name: Maratonul Sării

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Contributia de participare este 200 de lei pentru oricare traseu

description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event combining running and mountain biking, held amid the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in Piața Primăriei. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km stretch through the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and respect for nature, and also includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.
course_highlights: Routes through forests, hills, and the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine
A 7 km underground stretch at a depth of 240 m, with ionized air
Elevation gains: 250 m for 10 km, 740 m for the 21 km trail race, and 800 m for the 30 km mountain-bike race
additional: Start and finish in Piața Primăriei, Târgu Ocna. The mountain-bike race takes place on Sunday, 14 June 2026, and the trail-running races on Saturday, 13 June 2026. Payment is by card only at registration. The event includes plogging activities to clean up the routes. The routes include trail-running and mountain-bike sections; registration is available online, with payment by card.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race set in the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of the Firiza Dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.
course_highlights: A sustained 7–8 km climb with 560 meters of elevation gain
Views of Firiza Dam and Igniș Peak
A spectacular trail along the dam shore with memorable views
additional: GPX files for the routes are available to download. The marathon route includes a 21 km loop through scenic areas such as Limpedea, Groapele Chiuzbăii, and Fântâna cu borcut. There are refreshment and control points along the route, and the routes are marked with distinctive signs. Volunteers guide competitors along shared and branching sections of the routes. The trail routes include mountain terrain, technical trails, and climbs, highlighting the area's natural beauty. Participation includes official materials and access to event facilities.

name: Maraton Tarcău
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area, Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and appropriate equipment, providing a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kits the day before the competition and must comply with the official race regulations. Time limits are set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes in the Tarcău area, Neamț
Course time limits: 7 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half-marathon, and 2 hours for the cross-country race
Race kit provided the day before the competition
additional: Race kits are provided on Friday, June 12, 2026, and participants must sign a liability waiver. A technical briefing is held before the start. Course time limits are: 7 hours for the marathon (start at 9:00), 4 hours for the half-marathon (start at 10:00), and 2 hours for the cross-country race (start at 11:00). Registration takes place on June 12, with a race kit and liability waiver; races have time limits; spectacular mountain routes.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș, Romania
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The courses combine sustained climbs, forest roads, and sections with spectacular views, making them suitable for mountain runners seeking adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory gear checks and checkpoints along the course.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Sections with spectacular views of the Călimani Ridge
Multiple aid stations and checkpoints, including on the Scaunul Domnului Plateau
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00 and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. The main races start at 09:00, while the Family and Mini races start at 09:15. Gear checks are mandatory for safety. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, followed by a campfire. Competitor parking is provided in a specially designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the locality of Bistra Mureșului. Mountain trails, registration details, and the event schedule; registration closes on June 6, 2026.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is an outdoor running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is a call to live life fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message of direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that is relevant to today’s generation.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Bistrița area, set in nature
Half marathon for experienced runners
Accessible 5 km and 10 km races for all levels
additional: The event includes races for children (Cross Kids). Technical details and course maps will be updated on the website at a later date. Event T-shirts are provided, with a size guide. Trail running in nature, promoting health, community, and faith, with multiple race categories for all ages.

name: Stara Planina 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: CENA PO OSOBI: 14 900 RSD U cenu uračunato: tri noćenja u konaku Ždrma, hrana (subota)

description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with more than 13 kilometers of groomed trails of varying difficulty, including a freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter-sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active getaway.
course_highlights: Babin Zub ski resort, with 13+ km of groomed trails of varying difficulty
The Konjarnik four-seater chairlift and Serbia’s first gondola at Jabučko Ravnište
A freeride trail and an artificial snowmaking system
additional: Departure from Belgrade at 17:00, with a possible pickup in Niš. Transfers to the ski resort take place in the morning at 8:30 or 9:30, depending on the accommodation. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized. Accommodation at Ždrma Inn in rooms with 3–5 beds. Activities on the slopes until 16:00 each day. A 4-day/3-night ski trip with transport from Belgrade and Niš, accommodation options, ski activities and lessons, as well as the option of hiking tours if snowfall is insufficient.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: The 5th Livadia Night Run is a night race held in Livadia, near the Erkinas springs in the Krya area. The race includes three distances: a 10 km main race, 5 km, and 1 km for students, catering to runners of all ages and abilities. The race starts at 20:00, with electronic chip timing provided by CHRONOLOG. It is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia in cooperation with the Municipality of Livadeia, offering a local sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 20:00
1 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes near the Erkinas springs
Electronic chip timing by CHRONOLOG
additional: Race packs can be collected from the Tholoto hall next to the start. The 10 km race is open to registered SEGAS club athletes and independent runners aged 17 and over. June weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C, making the night start ideal. The event attracts runners from across the region and offers a distinctive running experience at night, with participation from both registered athletes and recreational runners.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: The 5th Olympic Day Run in Ancient Olympia is a unique and official Olympic running event that honors Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games. The race brings together Olympians, Paralympians, and distinguished athletes, creating a large Olympic running team. The event includes 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m races, with routes passing through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia, offering a unique sporting and cultural experience. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Olympic Committee and other important organizations, with the aim of showcasing Olympic heritage.
course_highlights: Routes through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia
Start and finish at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall
Route along the Alfeios River and the provincial road
additional: The races include distances of 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m. The event combines sporting, educational, and cultural activities with high standards of presentation and safety. It is organized by the Hellenic Olympic Committee, the International Olympic Academy, the Olympic Museum of Thessaloniki, and the Municipality of Ancient Olympia. It includes information about routes, registration, sponsors, and volunteers. The event promotes sport and culture in Greece, specifically in Ancient Olympia.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes an ascent of Golyam Kadamliya (2,275.4 m), the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event for lovers of mountain running and nature combines a challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Ascent of Golyam Kadamliya Peak — 2,275.4 m
Passage through three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The race starts in the village of Tazha. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packs can be collected both on the evening before the race and on race day, from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. The awards ceremony begins at 14:00. All winners receive a singlet bearing the race logo. A designer singlet can be ordered during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the 12K and 20K, with a parental consent form. Refunds are available until 30.04.2026, subject to a 20% fee; no refunds are available after that date. The organizers are looking for volunteers to help with the event. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 places is reached; designer singlets can be ordered during registration; the event includes social events and a camping option.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment in nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrain
Scenic views of the Belogradchik Rocks
A unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race “In the Kingdom of the TribAlletes” is a unique event in the heart of the Vratsa Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with almost 1,000 metres of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak Waterfall and the peaks of Dudil and Buk, combining tough climbs with technical descents. The race is for those who appreciate natural beauty and mountain running, and prizes are placed along the course, including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwest Bulgaria as a destination for sport and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with almost 1,000 m of elevation gain
Passes beneath Borov Kamak Waterfall, which is over 70 m high
Technical, steep descent from Buk Peak, with views of the Vratsa Balkan and the Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance to the Borov Kamak eco-trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the toughest, with the biggest climb. Prizes are placed along the course. Register by calling 0878 259 772. The course features waterfalls, climbs, descents, technical sections, and natural beauty.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and beginner-friendly, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a worthy cause. Participants receive superhero-themed race kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners
A dedicated route accessible to people with disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere for families, children, and pets
additional: The race kit includes an official T-shirt, superhero cape, themed accessories, a goodie bag, a race bib, and a medal. Medical assistance and hydration stations are available along the route. The event offers dedicated areas for families, children, pets, and people with disabilities, as well as secure bag storage, a security team, and volunteers to provide guidance. After the race, participants can enjoy sports and wellness activities, children's workshops, themed photo booths, and relaxation areas. Charity event, recreational activities, areas for families and children, kits with T-shirts and accessories, hydration and first-aid stations.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is Romania’s largest multi-sport event, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to 14, 2026. The festival combines sporting competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause and support the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, fans, and sports enthusiasts in a festive, friendly setting.
course_highlights: Superheroes Run: 5 km and 10 km races on dedicated courses
The Via Transilvanica route, a long-distance tourist trail with markers and sculpted mileposts
Sports events and demonstrations in Prof. Dr. Iuliu Hațieganu Sports Park
additional: Taking part in the Superheroes Run supports the Via Transilvanica social project, with part of the entry fee donated to the community. The festival includes areas for children, a food zone with healthy menus, concerts, and dance demonstrations. Participants receive a race kit, and the event promotes sport as a way of life and social engagement. The event features activities for all ages, sporting competitions, and support for social causes.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy a ride outdoors or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully planned to protect the natural environment, and markings will be limited to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a reserve date.
course_highlights: Route carefully marked to protect forests and natural areas
Route markings will be shared in the Participant Guide during event week
Start location accessible via Google Maps
additional: The event is limited to 1,000 starting places. The reserve race date is June 20, 2026. Children aged 5 to 13 must have a personal account on the Riders Club platform and be registered; they are recommended to be accompanied on the route. Families receive a 20% discount for a minimum of 3 people. E-MTB races allow electric bikes with motors that provide pedal assistance only, with a single battery for the entire race. Advance registration is required. The event is open to all experience levels, with the option to compete in electric races and prizes for participants.

name: Sunrise Marathon
location: Bačka Palanka, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka is an event that supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children facing this illness through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.
course_highlights: Enjoy a drive through the beautiful natural surroundings of Bačka Palanka
A choice of race distances (marathon, half marathon, 10K, 5K)
Support charitable causes for children with cancer
additional: Race participants can join Team Sunrise and receive a personalized fundraising page, a Team Sunrise T-shirt, and tools for collecting donations. Registration is handled directly through the race organizer, and participants arrange their own travel. Charity race bibs are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is often linked to charitable donations and fundraising for children with cancer; registration details and dates are available from the organizer.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its untouched nature and crystal-clear water. The course runs through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural splendor and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Gradac River canyon, with its crystal-clear water
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings
Abundant wildlife and the natural beauty of an untouched landscape
additional: The race is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia. It is inspired by the otter, a symbol of vitality and playfulness. No specific information was found about the race start time, registration, or prices. This trail race features varied terrain along the Gradac River and focuses on natural beauty and adventure. It takes place in June 2026.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series of events held in the beautiful natural landscapes of western Serbia. The race offers 10 km and 19 km courses that run alongside the Gradac River, one of the cleanest rivers in Europe, known for its unspoiled nature. Participants have the opportunity to experience Serbia’s unspoiled nature, running through forested and mountainous areas that are often accessible only to pedestrians. This event is ideal for running and nature enthusiasts who want to test their abilities in an authentic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km and 19 km courses
Running alongside the Gradac River with its clear waters
Unspoiled nature and mountain scenery accessible only to pedestrians
additional: The organizers provide refreshments along the course, with drinks and snacks at several points. Comfortable sportswear suitable for running in nature is recommended. The event is part of a series of races and hiking tours held throughout the year in western Serbia. Trail running and hiking in the scenic landscapes of western Serbia, with experiences of local culture and nature.

description: The 8th Grammos Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race held in the beautiful Mastorochoria region, in the village of Plikati, Municipality of Konitsa. It features two distances, 21 km and 10 km, starting and finishing in the village square. The 21 km course follows the ridge of the Grammos mountain range, with a total elevation difference of more than 1,680 meters, offering a unique experience for runners with good fitness and mountain-running experience. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. for the 21 km and 10:30 a.m. for the 10 km, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Loop course along the ridge of the Grammos mountain range
More than 1,680 meters of elevation difference for the 21 km
Start and finish in Plikati village square
additional: Electronic chip timing is provided. Participants receive a commemorative medal, water, fruit and snacks at the aid stations, as well as medical services during and after the race. The maximum time allowed for the 21 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes. A sweeper follows the last runner to provide support and ensure safety. In the event of adverse weather conditions, the organizers reserve the right to change or cancel sections of the course. The race takes place on a mountain trail, registration is via an external link, and the time limit is 5 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Ημιμαραθώνιος Δολιανών
description: The 10th Doliana Mountain Half Marathon, taking place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, in Ano Doliana, Arcadia, offers a challenging and beautiful 21,076-meter mountain half-marathon course with significant elevation change. Runners will enjoy steep uphill and downhill sections in a natural setting, reaching an altitude of up to 1,303 meters. The event emphasizes participant safety and provides a physiotherapist at the finish, as well as a photographer at points along the course. Results will be announced on the race’s official website.
course_highlights: A 21,076 m mountain half marathon with approximately 808 m of elevation gain and loss.
Maximum altitude of 1,303 m, with steep uphill and downhill sections (+28.9% and -31.1%).
A course with 50% uphill and 47.8% downhill sections in a natural mountain setting.
additional: A physiotherapist will be available at the finish for recovery. A photographer will be at the start, finish, and points along the course. Runner safety will be supported by volunteer rescuers along the route. A race bib will help judges identify runners. The course includes elevation changes and technical differences in water provision and infrastructure. Water stations are available, and the time limit is 4.5 hours. Registration opens via the official website.

name: 13ος Δρόμος Σέιχ Σου
description: The 13th Seich Sou Run is a trail-running race organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Club. The routes include 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run through Thessaloniki’s Seich Sou peri-urban forest. The race aims to introduce residents to the natural environment and promote exercise and forest protection. The event is supported by O.M.A.K. Kalamaria and offers an opportunity for gentle trail running in a natural and historic setting.
course_highlights: Location: Seich Sou peri-urban forest, Thessaloniki
Routes: 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run
Gentle trail running in a natural setting
additional: The race is held with the support of O.M.A.K. Kalamaria. The event aims to introduce participants to the peri-urban forest, familiarize them with the challenges of trail running, and protect the natural environment. The Thessaloniki Health Runners Club was founded in 1993 and promotes grassroots mass participation in sport, exercise for health, and sports education. It will take place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, with participants taking part in different routes and support from local organizations, aiming to introduce them to the forest and promote exercise in nature.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The 16th Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, singing, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folk performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances by traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunities to take part in or observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants submit applications through an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, covering different folk genres in a competitive format. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO to provide advisory services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from across Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities to exchange traditions.

description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set amid the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running experience and an intense descent. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs while the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with 1,833 m of elevation gain, tests runners’ endurance and technique across forest roads, woodland trails and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, with one partner climbing while the other descends
Varied terrain: forest roads, logging roads, trails through deciduous and coniferous forests, and alpine pasture
additional: A revolutionary awards system with individual and team rankings, cash prizes for teams, and bonuses for individual performances. The race kit includes a personalized race number (for early registrations), a finisher’s medal engraved in stone, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants, aid and hydration stations, medical support, and access to educational sessions and workshops. Parking is available for 360 cars. Payment is by bank card only, and registration is valid only after full payment. The event includes race-kit pickup, tent accommodation and accommodation suggestions, as well as the race start and awards ceremony on race day.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to improve environmental education and raise awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition offers several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail-running courses: half marathon 21 km, 10 km cross-country race, 4 km cross-country race, and Kids Trail Running
Event held in the Transylvania region, surrounded by nature
additional: Race kits can be collected on the day before and on race day, on the premises of the Ruck Ventilatoare factory. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Children’s races are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Gulaș Party, a concert, and an awards ceremony. Participants can choose from the 21 km, 10 km, and 4 km courses, as well as children’s races, with activities including kit collection, races, and awards ceremonies.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The courses include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical support. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.
course_highlights: Cross course: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, sustained climbs, and technical descents
Half Marathon course: approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, offering an additional challenge
Spectacular scenery and hydration points along the route
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the base of Lake Firiza. The routes are marked with ribbons, signs, and paint. The race kit includes a chip-equipped bib, T-shirt, medal, access to refreshment points, medical support, and a guide. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. The courses are on mountain terrain. Registration closes on June 9, 2026. Participation includes a kit with a bib, T-shirt, medal, and hydration points. The event takes place on June 20, 2026.
