description: The Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the shady trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. Organizers Runners Club promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Held in June, the race swaps urban asphalt for nature and offers an outdoor running experience.
course_highlights: Route along the shady trails of Hoia Forest
15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, plus a family race
Outdoor event in a natural setting
additional: The registration package includes a race bib and other benefits. Awards are presented by category. The event is organized by Runners Club, which supports free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The event takes place in Hoia Forest, with online registration and medals for participants. The route includes natural trails and is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both trail runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Kids’ Race, which follows age-appropriate routes in the town’s historic center. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.
course_highlights: Varied routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
Natural scenery in the Apuseni Mountains and Roșia Montană’s historic architectural heritage
The Kids’ Race follows age-appropriate routes in the historic center
additional: The Kids’ Race has different routes depending on age, from 700 m for children aged 0–10 (with a parent/guardian required for ages 0–6) to 2.3 km for children aged 13–16. The start and finish are in Piața Centrală in Roșia Montană. The event also includes other races: Marathon 42.16 km, Half Marathon 25.2 km, and 10 km Cross-Country Race. Race kits can be collected in Piața Centrală the day before, and the program also includes cultural activities and concerts. The Kids’ Race includes three different routes (700 m, 1.3 km, and 2.3 km), with prizes and medals for participants. The event takes place on June 21, 2026, in the commune’s historic center, and promotes the area’s cultural and ecological values.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The event features several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with the start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the event offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races
50 km and 100 km races
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is arranged in hotels and motels, with a shared tent also available for competitors who do not need overnight accommodation. A well-stocked aid station is available during the race, followed by a communal lunch for all participants. Prizes are awarded in the overall and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training sessions, competitions and the promotion of ultramarathoning in the region, and takes place in June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
course_highlights: Promotes sport and friendship
Large-scale regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula and brings together runners from across the region. The organizers are committed to continuously improving the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is a related activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant history and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures in place during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transport from Belgrade.

name: 1ο Chios Night Run
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The 1st Chios Night Run is a night race held at the central port of Chios. The course offers a unique running experience, with aid stations every 2.5 kilometers and an official technical race T-shirt. After the finish, participants can enjoy a hot dog party and a music festival, creating a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The race includes age categories and a special category for security forces and armed forces.
course_highlights: Location: Central Port of Chios
Aid stations every 2.5 kilometers
Official technical race T-shirt
additional: A hot dog party and music festival take place after the race. Age categories: 15–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60+, with awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place. Special category for security forces and armed forces. Entry includes chip timing, a technical T-shirt, a medal, water, and snacks. The course is urban and held at night, starting and finishing at the central port of Chios. An early start is recommended due to hot and humid weather.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: The Koufalia Hill Run “Dimitra Iordanidou” is a distinctive event that combines the natural beauty of the Koufalia hills with an athletic challenge. It features 6 km and 10 km routes, mainly on dirt trails through a pine forest, with climbs and descents offering unique views of landmarks such as the Monastery of Gregory Palamas and the Gavana Cave. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities for children and parents, and aims to promote sport and connection with nature in the local community. It honors the memory of Dimitra Iordanidou, who conceived the race and established it as an annual tradition.
course_highlights: Dirt routes with trails through a pine forest
Pass by the Monastery of Gregory Palamas
Technically challenging sections with climbs and descents, and views of Gavana Cave
additional: The event includes activities for children and parents, as well as a parent-child race and a race for people with disabilities accompanied by a guide. The start and finish are at the Koufalia Tennis Club courts. The 10 km and 6 km routes share sections and feature steep climbs and descents, natural obstacles, and technical sections. The event is supported by local organizations and volunteers. The race takes place in the peri-urban forest of Koufalia, with an emphasis on community and the natural environment. Options are available for different ability levels and ages, and the event promotes outdoor exercise and family participation.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: The Beyond Kerkini Running Experience is a unique road race held at the Lithotopos Marina, beside Lake Kerkini. It offers courses that combine different landscapes and terrain, from flat asphalt routes to challenging mountain trails. Each course offers a distinctive view of the area’s natural beauty, with the chance to run among imposing rocky outcrops and through landscapes that change from dawn to sunset. The event also includes free activities for families and children, making it a full-day sporting experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes extending from the western side to the eastern embankment of Lake Kerkini
A combination of mountain trails, dirt paths and asphalt across different routes
A running experience among imposing rocky outcrops and the lake
additional: Free activities for children and families on Saturday. Free bus transportation. Technical T-shirts and a commemorative finisher’s medal in every race. Chip timing and an athlete bib. Maurten energy gels and a light meal provided. Medical coverage and a rescue team are available. Changing rooms, showers and a baggage-storage area are available. Free photographs. Water and refreshments along the course. Includes free bus transportation, routes offering different levels of difficulty, and a celebration of sport in a captivating natural setting.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances suited to skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience amid Bulgaria’s natural scenery, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site
Stunning views and a skyrunning course
A range of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points, respectively, from a previous race are required to register. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times before the start. Transport to the start area is provided for the 25 km distance. The awards ceremony takes place at Central Square in Bansko. A multi-distance race featuring an ultramarathon and mountain routes, with exceptional natural views.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop of around 5 km with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose from three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop of around 5 km
Held in Vrana Park, on the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation gain along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is one loop of around 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The minimal elevation gain makes it suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and offers different distances. It is held in Vrana Park, Sofia.

Includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running

The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on site.

description: The 3rd Galatsi Night Run is a nighttime running event held in Galatsi, Athens, starting and finishing at the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium - PALE. The 5 km course follows the city’s main road, Veikou Avenue. There is also a 1 km children’s race for primary school students, held within the grounds of PALE. The event promotes public participation in sport and physical exercise, with an emphasis on safety and an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Nighttime 5 km race along the main road, Veikou Avenue
1 km children’s race within the grounds of the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium - PALE
Safe, looped course for children, free of vehicles
additional: Participants can collect their race packs at PALE on Saturday, June 20 (10:00–15:00) and Sunday, June 21 (10:00–13:00). Galatsi residents and municipal citizens participate free of charge. The children’s race starts at 20:40 and the 5 km race at 20:55. Awards are presented to the top three overall finishers, and all participants receive medals. The race includes online registration, a participation pack, medical coverage, and participation limits of 1,500 adults and 200 children.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: The 5th ORESTIS Road Race in Orestiada is a sporting event that attracts runners and sports enthusiasts from the area. The race offers an opportunity to take part in an organized route through the city, promoting health and physical activity. The event is friendly and open to everyone, aiming to strengthen the local community and promote sports. It has become an important sporting occasion for the Orestiada area.
course_highlights: 10 km routes and possibly other distances
Participants from Greece and Bulgaria
Organized in a scenic area of Orestiada
additional: The race is an important sporting event for the area, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
location: Φλώρινα, Δήμος Φλώρινας, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Φλώρινας, Ελλάδα
description: The Municipality of Florina and GoEvents are organizing the two-day running event GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY, a sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with the beauty of the city of Florina. The races take place on June 20 & 21, starting and finishing at Georgiou Modi Square. Runners of all ages and ability levels are invited to take part in routes through the city and along the Sakoulevas River, enjoying the area’s distinctive atmosphere. The events include 10 km and 5 km races, a 3 km night race, and a 1 km fun run for families and children.
course_highlights: A dynamic 10-kilometer urban route through Florina, starting from the village of Simos Ioannidis
A scenic 5-kilometer route along the Sakoulevas River, beside the water and greenery
A 3-kilometer night race in the city center, with music and lighting creating a festive atmosphere
additional: The races start and finish at Georgiou Modi Square. Participation is open to people aged 18 and over; participants under 18 must provide a signed parental or guardian consent form. Medals are awarded to all participants, and prizes to the top three in each age and gender category. The event emphasizes urban exploration and family participation, with multiple routes and activities in a welcoming setting.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: The 25th Road Race and Power Walking Event “In the Footsteps of the Apostle Paul” is organized by the Municipality of Corinth and symbolically retraces the route followed by the Apostle Paul in the area. The race takes place on Sunday, June 21, 2026, starting from the ancient port of Kenchreai and finishing at the main square of Ancient Corinth. The course is 11.4 kilometers long and includes three support stations along the way. It is a historic and cultural route that combines sport and tradition.
course_highlights: 11.4 km route from the ancient port of Kenchreai to Ancient Corinth
Three support stations along the route
Symbolic retracing of the Apostle Paul’s journey
additional: The course map is available via the event’s online platform (Google My Maps). The event is held as part of local celebrations, with traffic management by the traffic police and medical coverage provided by Corinth Hospital. All finishers receive a technical T-shirt and also take part in the event.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: The SNF Nostos Run 2026 is a much-loved evening road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, returning on June 23 to celebrate 30 years of the SNF’s philanthropic work. The race features 10 km, 6 km, and 1 km routes for Special Olympics athletes, starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center. The event emphasizes giving and solidarity: the SNF will contribute three times the total amount raised through participant fees to support nonprofit organizations. Along the route, participants will enjoy music from percussion bands and a DJ set at the finish. Timing is official, but the race is non-competitive.
course_highlights: 10 km and 6 km routes starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the SNFCC
1 km route for Special Olympics athletes
Music along the route from the Batala and Quilombo percussion bands, and a DJ set at the finish
additional: The race is non-competitive, but official timing will be provided. The event is organized in collaboration with the nonprofit organization Anagennisi & Proodos, under the scientific supervision of Sports Excellence, the Department of Athletic Excellence at the First Department of Orthopaedic Surgery of the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens. The SNF will contribute three times the total amount raised through participant fees to support the nonprofits Lampsi and Pnoe Agapis. The urban routes are designed to emphasize charitable action and support for organizations serving children with cancer and cancer patients. The event also includes a special 1 km route for Special Olympics athletes.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodnei Mountains, in the Borșa area of Maramureș. The event offers three distinct courses suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor course, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău course, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta course, a fast route with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and focuses on the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to enjoy an active weekend outdoors.
course_highlights: Puzdrelor course: 29.5 km with 2200 m of elevation gain, recommended for experienced runners
Gărgălău course: 21 km with 1300-1500 m of elevation gain, suitable for well-prepared but less experienced runners
Musceta course: 16 km with 500 m of ascent and 1500 m of descent, a fast and technical route
additional: The race takes place in Borșa, in the Rodnei Mountains, a mountainous area with spectacular scenery and a tradition of mountain sports. There are several accommodation options near the start, from guesthouses to campsites, between 190 m and 17.6 km from the start. The courses combine marked and unmarked trails, forest roads, and steep slopes, offering an authentic mountain-running experience. The race is part of the Carpathians Mountain Running Circuit. The mountain course requires a mandatory equipment check and starts at the base of the Borșa gondola. GPX downloads and information about accommodation and registration are available. Entry fees include hydration stations, photos, goulash, and parking access.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through picturesque areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a race number, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.
course_highlights: Mountain route with climbs up to Cota 1000 and Cota 1400
Passes through tourist areas marked with red and yellow trail markers
Start and finish in Sinaia Town Hall Square, on Bd. Carol
additional: Race kits can be collected in person only, upon presentation of an identity document. The time limit for completing the 10K route is 4.5 hours, and for the 21K it is 6 hours. Minors aged 14 to 18 may participate only when accompanied by an adult and with written consent. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 50 RON, while the special children’s T-shirt is free. Only participants with a valid race number, officials, and authorized personnel are allowed on the route. The routes feature varied mountain terrain, with details about the races and cultural and historical attractions in the area, such as Peleș Castle and Sinaia Monastery.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the energy of the city, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course in the heart of Cluj-Napoca
Races for children with distances adapted to their ages
International and Romanian elite athletes
additional: Children’s races take place on Saturday, June 27, and adult and elite races on Sunday, June 28. Children’s distances: 800 m (ages 6–9), 1,200 m (ages 10–13), 3,000 m (ages 13–15). Amateur races: 5 km (minimum age 14), 10 km (minimum age 16). The event is organized by the team behind Brașov Running Festival. All participants in the children’s races receive medals and surprises. The event includes children’s races, open categories, and an international elite competition with a World Athletics label; it takes place in Cluj-Napoca and promotes urban running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: The Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from children aged 3 to seniors aged 78, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses, as well as special races for little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances, making for a day dedicated to health, community and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania and UHU Romania.
course_highlights: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses in Mioveni’s Civic Center
Special “DINO” races for children
A vibrant atmosphere with music, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances
additional: The event includes raffles with prizes and surprises for participants, provided by sponsors such as UHU and WD-40. Participants include both adults and children; the youngest runner was 3 years old, and the oldest was 78. Courses of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, races for children, an event promoting health and sport, and support from sponsors TEMAD, WD-40 and UHU Romania.

name: CROSUL HOIA FORTECH
location: Aleea Muzeului Etnografic, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj, Romania

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Hoia Forest, Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run on cool forest trails. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, foster a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race is a great opportunity to trade urban pavement for fresh air and the beautiful scenery of the forest.
course_highlights: Routes along cool trails in Hoia Forest
A range of races: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and the family race
An event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The registration package includes a technical T-shirt and race bib. Prizes are awarded to winners in each race. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Route along the trails of Hoia Forest; online registration; the fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: The Mioveni City Cross-Country Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus România, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in support of the values of honor and respect, in a friendly and motivating setting.
course_highlights: Course through the civic center of Mioveni
Event dedicated to wounded military personnel and war veterans
An atmosphere of solidarity and community support
additional: The event includes several sporting activities, but details about the course and registration are not specified

name: Noćni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most attended races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is the 42 km marathon, which demands dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich experience on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Novi Sad
A 42.2 km marathon as the main event
A half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a technical shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, and a post-race massage. Registration is available only through the trka.rs portal; registration on race day is not allowed. Participants under 18 cannot enter the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini-marathon and half marathon. The event includes several race distances and a Nordic walk, with registration through the trka.rs platform. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with registration and program details available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the opportunity to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural surroundings of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
A challenging and varied running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty, and takes place within Ovčar Banja’s broader tourism and sporting setting.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are designed for all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to protecting the environment through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses through Tornik’s natural landscapes in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging Race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles suited to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Competitor registration is on Friday from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 09:00. The Plogging Race combines running with an environmental cleanup activity. Registration is required for the children’s races, and participation is free. All participants receive race T-shirts and medals, while the top finishers receive gift packages. Trail and environmental activities, multiple course distances, a children’s obstacle race, registration required for the children’s race, date: 27.06.2026.

name: 17. Noćni maraton
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main event is the 42 km marathon, which requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for the youngest runners and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to everyone. The organizers, ARK Fruška gora, continually improve the event, which has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad.
course_highlights: A night race along Sunčani kej in Novi Sad
A range of distances: marathon, half marathon, mini-marathon, and Nordic walking
An organized aid station and post-race massage
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. The participant pack includes a technical T-shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, a bag drop, beer, post-race massage, and sponsor gifts. Adults are eligible to participate, while minors may take part only in the mini-marathon and half marathon with the consent of a parent or guardian. The race includes participant packs, medals, aid stations with water and fruit, and rules for fair and safe competition.

name: 2. Dr Milk TORNIK RACE
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-filled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suitable for all generations and levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to environmental conservation through the Plogging race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and adventure lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and encouraging a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Trails through Tornik’s natural surroundings in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles adapted to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Participant registration is Friday 17:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–09:00. The Plogging race promotes environmental awareness and cleaning up nature while running. Race starts are in the morning at Tornik Ski Center, and registration and information are available via the official email. Trail races of 6 km, 15 km and 25 km, a Plogging activity to protect nature, a children’s race, and an environmental focus.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: The 2nd Silk City Run in Soufli is a road race inviting amateur and experienced runners, families, and young people to enjoy a unique route through the city of silk. Running through the streets of Soufli is not just a race, but a journey toward a healthier, more balanced, and more creative way of life. The Municipality of Soufli warmly welcomes all participants, offering an opportunity for renewal and energy.
course_highlights: Route through Soufli, known as the city of silk
A welcoming setting for amateur and experienced runners
An opportunity for families and young people to take part in a sporting event
additional: 5 km and 10 km routes, electronic timing, refreshment station, participation for ages 18 and over

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: The Olympus Marathon is a unique 44-kilometer mountain running race with +3350 meters of elevation gain, held on the mythical Mount Olympus. The route starts at the archaeological site of Dion and follows trails through forests, alpine meadows, and peaks, reaching Litochoro. The race honors the ancient tradition of pilgrims who climbed Mount Olympus to pay tribute to Zeus, offering runners a unique experience as they follow the traces of history on the mountain of the gods. It is a certified SKYRUNNING race and a challenge for experienced mountain runners.
course_highlights: 44 kilometers with +3350 meters of elevation gain
Route from the archaeological site of Dion to Litochoro
Passing through alpine meadows, beech forests, and the peaks of Mount Olympus
additional: The route includes three aid and water stations, an athlete's gift pack, a pasta party on the Friday before the race, a finisher's medal, and transport from Litochoro. The race has a 12-hour time limit and requires participants to have prior mountain-racing experience. Technical support, first aid, and volunteers are available along the entire route. The event includes accompanying races such as the Olympus Ultra 71 km, Olympus Vertical 4 km, Melindra Trail 5 km, and Kopsi ton Aeton 14 km. Registration opens in February 2026, with early-bird discounts. The event combines sport, nature, and tradition.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
location: Παραλία του Πόρτο Χέλι, Πόρτο Χέλι, Αργολίδας, Greece
description: The Municipality of Ermionida and the Municipal Community of Porto Heli invite you to the major sports celebration “Porto Heli Night Run,” taking place on Saturday, June 27, 2026. The race is dedicated to the memory of Minos Kyriakou and includes events for everyone, from an 11 km trail run and a 5 km night run to children’s races and a race for people with disabilities. Each participant will receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal, offering a unique sporting experience in beautiful Porto Heli.
course_highlights: 11 km Trail Run in a natural setting
5 km Night Run with atmospheric lighting
Children’s races of 500 m and 1,000 m, and a 300 m race for people with disabilities
additional: A commemorative T-shirt and medal for all participants. Multiple courses and categories, with registration open until 24/06/2026; medals and T-shirts for all participants.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings, near Koprinka Reservoir in Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: 2 km swim along the sandy shores of Koprinka Reservoir
60 km cycling through the forests of Sredna Gora over rugged terrain
15 km run through the forest and along the reservoir shore, with panoramic views
additional: Cutoff times: swimming — 1:40 hours; cycling — 5:30 hours; running — 2:30 hours. Any time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is limited to people over 18. The day before the race, there is a children’s race for different age groups. Courses: 2 km swimming, 60 km cycling, 14 km running; registration at different prices; included: medals, aid stations, professional timing, medical support, bicycle service, prizes, and photos.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a waste-free race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: A 9-stage loop around Vitosha, passing through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultramarathon with varied terrain and elevation
Start and finish in front of Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the ALPI store in Sofia and at the start, up to 60 minutes before the race. The race emphasizes environmental protection: participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. A special SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels is available. The awards ceremony takes place on race day after the finish. The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon disciplines. The course includes remote parts of the mountain, with a total elevation gain of over 2,000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of a mountain ultramarathon and cycling event.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together lovers of sport and nature, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Healthy Spirit Festival, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trails through the forested and mountainous areas of Ovčar Banja
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful views
Challenging terrain suited to trail running
additional: The event is part of the Healthy Spirit Festival, which highlights healthy living, sport, and outdoor activities.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Bajina Bašta, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The trails pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable nature experience and a challenge for body and mind. Alongside the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.
course_highlights: The TUT 62 course runs from Rača Monastery through hidden parts of Tara National Park to Bajina Bašta, with 2,600 m of elevation gain
The Crnjeskovo and Sokolarica viewpoints and the Rača Canyon offer spectacular views during the race
Varied terrain includes singletrack, gravel roads, paved sections, and technical descents
additional: Registration opens at midnight on January 1, 2026. Participants under 18 cannot take part in TUT 62, and children under 14 may run only when accompanied by a parent. An all-day outdoor festival and the Bašta Fest short film festival take place at the finish. The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and adapted for the youngest competitors. Online registration opens on January 1, 2026, and the races include various distances and categories, with activities for all ages and ITRA points.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will take place from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The varied and challenging courses offer spectacular scenery and technical climbs, providing a true challenge and an opportunity to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Mountaineering Club Tara. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Mountain Uphill: 6 km with over 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at the Sjenič viewpoint with panoramic views of Tara
Mountain Classic: 13.6 km with 550 m of elevation gain, starting at Rača Monastery, passing through the Rača Canyon, and finishing in Bajina Bašta
Mountain Trail: 36 km with about 1,900 m of elevation gain, a technically challenging course with two climbs to the Tara plateau and spectacular viewpoints
additional: The races are for runners born in 2008 or earlier for Mountain Uphill and Mountain Classic, while Mountain Trail is for runners born in 2006 or earlier. Mountain Uphill is the only race that neither starts at Rača Monastery nor finishes in Bajina Bašta. The courses include technical single-track sections, fast descents, and challenging climbs, with final sections suited to a strong finish. Several race categories, including U18, focus on mountain terrain and natural beauty; the event is organized by regional and local mountaineering and sports organizations.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Tara Mountain, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Serbia, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different levels of runners, from a vertical climb to a 62 km ultradistance with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and beautiful parts of the mountain, offering unforgettable scenery and challenges. In addition to the races, an outdoor festival and accompanying events for all ages and fitness levels take place at the finish. The event is an opportunity to experience the mountain in all its beauty and grandeur.
course_highlights: A 62 km course with 2,600 m of cumulative elevation gain through Tara National Park
Spectacular viewpoints such as Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača Canyon
Varied terrain including technical singletrack sections, gravel roads, and asphalt
additional: The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and tailored to the youngest participants, with parents and guardians welcome to join them. An all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events are held at the finish in Bajina Bašta, including the short film festival “Bašta Fest.” All races award ITRA points and count toward the ITRA National League. Multiple distances, Balkan Championship, outdoor festival, children’s race, registration via prijavise.net

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. It is organized by the Troyan in the Future Association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km and 70 km, with varying elevation gain
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan, featuring natural and historical landmarks
Open to both professionals and enthusiasts
additional: Race packs are collected on site, with priority given to participants in the longer distances. Participants must carry their race number, a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and a mobile phone with the organizers’ number. The program includes a technical briefing and an awards ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events promoting an active lifestyle

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose from an ultra-distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for an active holiday in the national resort of Varshets.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a range of distances
Start in front of Hotel Medicus in the town of Varshets
Routes through scenic natural surroundings
additional: Race packs can be collected at Varshets Municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12–13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start at Hotel Medicus; online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach between Kamchia Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and aids provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River.
The distances are 10 km and 21.1 km, with aid stations approximately every 5 km.
Runners can run barefoot, and rescue equipment is provided for the river crossing.
additional: The start is in the evening. Race numbers are distributed from 15:00, and baggage storage is available. The time limits are 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3 hours 30 minutes for 10 km. Children can take part in the 2.2 km children’s run for free. Participants must bring a water container for the aid stations. Timing uses RFID chips. In unfavorable conditions, the river crossing may be made by boats provided by the organizers. Registration is available online and on site. Fees can be paid via EasyPay or ePay. Accompaniment is available, and children under 7 may participate with an accompanying adult.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course featuring wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suited to experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
90% tourist-trail marking, with additional signage in difficult sections
Significant elevation changes, with spectacular climbs and descents
additional: The routes include a marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, with positive elevation gains ranging from 700 m to 2400 m. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The routes are 80–90% runnable, with sections of forest road, alpine trails, and rugged terrain. The organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a children’s race to encourage running in nature. The event also includes routes for children, with an emphasis on ecotourism and community involvement, and offers information about registration, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triatlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require mountain experience and skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation gain (e.g. 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain)
Routes passing through villages, alpine pastures, wooded areas, and mountain ridges
Routes including sections with fixed ropes and rough terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Race bibs are distributed in two sessions: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes start at 08:00, while the Turnu route (4 km) starts at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children’s race takes place at Turnu Monastery Camping, starting at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery after the Holy Liturgy. Mountain routes, an 8-hour time limit, participants over 18 years old, an emphasis on running and hiking, and the promotion of local natural and cultural attractions

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: The 4th “Kakolyri 1944” Memorial Run honors the victims of the 1944 massacre in the village of Taxiarches. It is organized by the Municipality of Kymi-Aliveri and the Taxiarches Cultural Association, with support from cultural associations and communities in the area. It includes a 21 km half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1.2 km children’s race, with routes passing through historic villages and natural landscapes. The event offers electronic timing, commemorative medals and T-shirts, as well as full support with aid stations and medical coverage.
course_highlights: A 20.8 km circular half-marathon route passing through the villages of Pyrgos, Andronianoi, Taxiarches, Giannides, Agios Vlasis, and Konnistres
Aid stations with water and electrolytes at several points along the route
Routes combining trails, dirt roads, and settlements of historical and natural interest
additional: Electronic timing by Fitrace. All athletes receive a commemorative medal and a dry-fit T-shirt. There are 7 water stations along the half-marathon route and 2 stations along the 5 km route. Water, fruit, soft drinks, and savory snacks are provided at the finish. Medical coverage is provided by a doctor, an EKAB ambulance, and volunteer rescuers. The event is supported by volunteer groups and associations. It includes technical descriptions, GPX route maps, historical facts and information, as well as participation and support from volunteers and associations such as the Hellenic Red Cross and the Evia Runners Association.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the scenic resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a 48 km ultra distance
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
A 1 km distance for children and beginners
additional: The start is in front of Hotel Medicus. Race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of Hotel Medicus; registration at www.runbulgaria.org

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour from Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, with beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, offering a chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours with transport to the trailhead are available to all accommodation guests.
course_highlights: A 52-meter ascent from 1,570 m to 1,622 m above sea level
Panoramic views of Pančićev Vrh, Radočelo, Golija, and the surrounding mountains
The trail is well marked and safe for hiking
additional: Transport to the trailhead is arranged in the host’s van for accommodation guests. The return trip takes about 30 minutes in total. The tour is available only to guests of Kežman Mountain Houses. Participants can expect a guided tour, a short walk with spectacular views, a steep ascent, and a well-marked trail.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: The Around Avala Athletics Race is a traditional event organized by the Athletics Veterans Association of Serbia. The race takes place in Avala’s beautiful surroundings and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It offers an opportunity for sportsmanship and to promote athletics among veterans and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both a challenge and the chance to enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Course around Mount Avala
Natural surroundings and woodland scenery
Race suited to veterans and recreational runners
additional: Participants can expect races over various distances, including a half marathon, with the possibility of scoring points toward national and international series. Registration is open to a large number of competitors, and the event is supported by local sponsors and the community.

description: The 8th Skloupo Trail Run is a trail race held in the picturesque village of Ampelochori (Skloupo), in the Municipality of North Tzoumerka. It features three races: 13.5 km, 5 km, and a 1 km Kids Race, offering a unique experience through forests of fir and conifer trees, with steep climbs and descents. The course combines dirt trails and paved sections, with beautiful natural scenery and historic sites in the village. The race is open to runners of all ages, with special care for younger participants.
course_highlights: 13.5 km course, including 8.35 km of dirt trail through a forest of fir and conifer trees
Significant total elevation gain of 395 metres
Passes historic sites and traditional trails in Ampelochori
additional: Runners receive a race pack with a bib and timing chip, safety pins, and a commemorative T-shirt. The maximum number of entries is 300 for the two adult races and 50 for the Kids Race. Time limits are 2 hours for the 13.5 km race and 1 hour for the 5 km race. Discarding items along the course is prohibited, and regulations are strictly enforced. Three courses, electronic timing, medical services, photography coverage, commemorative T-shirt and medal, entry in the 1 km Kids Race

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together nature lovers and fans of endurance and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races cater to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race packet with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, and the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.
course_highlights: Three races of different distances: Maxi (60.9 km), Midi (24.8 km), Mini (14.6 km)
The courses are entirely new and do not repeat those from the previous ultramarathon
Time limits: Maxi 12h, Midi 7h, Mini 5h
additional: The race packet includes a T-shirt (size guaranteed for entries paid by June 20, 2026), promotional materials from the Prijepolje Tourist Organization, finisher’s medals for everyone who completes the race, and medals and trophies for category winners. Free accommodation is available in the gymnasium of “Valter” Elementary School (sleeping bags are required). The organizer reserves the right to make course adjustments, with timely notice. Participants can expect details about registration, medals, T-shirts, and timing on the official platforms. The event also includes services such as timekeeping and event promotion.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. Held at a stadium in Sofia, it offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talent in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Stadium competition in Sofia
Participation by the best athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, which has a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will bring together young athletes from across the country.

description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and has aid stations, while the atmosphere is filled with camaraderie and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run
Turbo: 0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run
Legend Relay: the same distance as Legend, completed by a team of two or three
additional: Marked course, aid stations, and limited places for each distance (Legend - 120, Turbo - 60, Legend Relay - 20 teams). The race fosters community and camaraderie among participants. Distances: Legend (1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run), Turbo (0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run), Relay (the same as Legend, in teams). Registration with different prices and places. The event is part of a legendary experience in the Rhodope Mountains and is suitable for both advanced athletes and beginners.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to highlight the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers hope to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mount Jadovnik, rich in flora and fauna
The race takes place in unspoiled nature with a distinctive mountain setting
A unique opportunity to discover a lesser-known mountain in Serbia
additional: Participants must carry mandatory equipment. The race is limited to 100 runners, and the route includes forest roads and paved sections.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional track and field race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of different fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free, organized running. It gives everyone the opportunity to take part in a sporting atmosphere that embraces diversity and community.
course_highlights: Middle and long distances
Organized but non-professional race
Takes place in Sofia
additional: The event is part of an initiative to promote running and a healthy lifestyle in Bulgaria.

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, 33 km, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Zagori Mountain Running is Greece’s largest mountain running race, offering a unique experience through the region’s imposing landscapes. The routes cross stone bridges, the Vikos Gorge and the Tymfi mountain range, combining natural beauty with demanding terrain. With multiple route options, from 5 km to 93 km, the race caters to runners of all preferences and levels. The event is welcoming and well organized, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: Zagori’s stone arch bridges
The impressive Vikos Gorge
The Tymfi mountain range, with significant elevation changes
additional: Multiple routes with different dates and start times: Challenge 93 km over 2 days (18–19/07/2026, 05:00 & 06:30), TeRA 60 km (18/07/2026, 05:00), Classic Race 33 km (19/07/2026, 06:30), Half Marathon 21 km (18/07/2026, 07:30), Forest 10 km (19/07/2026, 08:45), Fun 5 km (18/07/2026, 21:00), ZAGORAKI Kids Race (18/07/2026, 19:00). Registration opens on 27 March 2026, with entries also available for children’s races and fun runs. The event also provides information about accommodation and transport in the area.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
price_range: 12 € (5 χλμ, με μπλούζα), 15 € (10 χλμ, με μπλούζα), δωρεάν (παιδικός)
description: The 4th Mytilene Night Run is a popular nighttime road race held in the city of Mytilene. The 5 km and 10 km routes cross the city, starting and finishing at Tsamakia, with much of the course following pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic. The race is organized by the Lesvos Runners Club in cooperation with the Municipality of Mytilene and other local organizations, offering a unique running experience under the night sky. High participation and a warm atmosphere characterize the event, which has become an institution on the island of Lesvos.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the city of Mytilene
Start and finish at Tsamakia
Much of the route follows pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic
additional: A 1 km children's race on the pedestrian street took place beforehand, with children participating. After the races, awards are presented at the beach at Tsamakia. Lesvos Ride provides technical support, and medical coverage is provided by Mytilene Hospital and other organizations. The Traffic Police and Port Traffic Police cooperate in managing traffic. The race is held under the auspices of the Lesvos Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS Lesvos). Registration is available online until July 9, 2026, and the event takes place as part of the Lesvian Summer events. Participants can enjoy special offers on ferry tickets and run along the city's illuminated streets.
