description: The 15th Faethon Skyrace “Apostolos Tsourekas” will take place on July 12, 2026, in Kokkinopilos on Mount Olympus. This is a challenging mountain-running event offering two courses: the Faethon SkyRace, 23 km with +1,800 m of elevation gain over alpine terrain, and the Faethon Trail, 14 km with +400 m, crossing historic trails and lush forests. The event also includes the 1 km Faethonaki Run for children, giving them the opportunity to discover mountain running. The race starts from the central square of Kokkinopilos, and the event is driven by a vision and love for Mount Olympus and mountain running.
course_highlights: Faethon SkyRace: 23 km with +1,800 m of elevation gain over alpine terrain, reaching peaks of up to 2,520 m
Faethon Trail: 14 km with +400 m, along historic trails and through lush forests
Routes along trails of exceptional natural beauty on Mount Olympus, with alpine ridgelines and pristine forest
additional: The race has a 6-hour cutoff (until 14:00). There is an intermediate refreshment station at Diaselo Kardara, at 14 km and an elevation of 2,340 m, with a 3.5-hour cutoff. Participation is open to people over 18 who have completed a mountain race of at least 15 km within the last 2 years. A medical certificate is not required, but participants must sign a declaration of responsibility. The event also includes the 1 km Faethonaki Run for children, which takes place on Saturday, July 11. Registration opens on April 15, 2026. The event features mountain running, skyrunning, and routes over technical and natural terrain.

name: Faethon Skyrace
description: Faethon Skyrace is a demanding mountain-running race held on mythical Mount Olympus, in the Kokkinopilos area. The 24-kilometer route, with +1,800 meters of elevation gain, offers a unique experience across trails, alpine terrain, and peaks above 2,000 meters. The race starts from the village’s central square and has a 6-hour time limit, with intermediate aid stations. It is intended for experienced athletes in good physical condition with experience in mountain races.
course_highlights: 24 km route with +1,800 m of elevation gain
Trails and alpine terrain on western Mount Olympus
Passage through the unspoiled forest of Kokkinopilos and peaks above 2,000 m
additional: The race is limited to 300 participants. A medical certificate is not required, but participants must sign a declaration of responsibility. There is a 6-hour finish time limit, with an intermediate aid station at Diaselo Kardara, at 14 km (2,340 m elevation). Free bus transport from Thessaloniki is provided for athletes. The event includes races of 23 km, 14 km, and 1 km for children, with registration by bank transfer, and participation in a race of high difficulty and natural beauty. The start and finish are in a historic area with a rich natural and cultural heritage.

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon offering challenging distances amid the beautiful Balkan Mountains scenery around the town of Tryavna. The event includes 100 km, 42 km and 21 km races, as well as cycling routes and a duathlon. The courses have varied terrain and include numerous aid stations to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. It is organized by the iRun association, which has many years of experience staging sporting events and building a sports community.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances from 21 km to 100 km
Varied mountain terrain with elevation profiles exceeding 1,500 m
Numerous aid stations along the courses
additional: The event includes running, cycling and duathlon with combined distances. The organizer, iRun, is an association with more than 50 sporting events held. The website has information about accommodation, the event’s history and results from previous years. Multiple distances for running, cycling and duathlon; an event with technical conferences and race packs; held in the town of Tryavna, Bulgaria.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Dochia Race, with approximately 1500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Bate Toaca Race, with approximately 2700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gains (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular scenery in the Durău area, including Vf. Toaca and Cabana Dochia
Marked courses with various symbols (red stripe, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The courses are well marked with different symbols and include climbs and descents on stairs at Vf. Toaca. The Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is Asociația SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț. Telephone contact is available for logistics and the secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registration and participation.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a range of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Buila-Vânturarița National Park
Spectacular scenery and protected nature
A range of events: children’s races, an 11 km cross-country race, and 18 km and 36 km courses
additional: The event promotes ecotourism, nature, and local culture, offering an opportunity for trail running and mountain hiking enthusiasts.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
price_range: semi-maraton 200 Lei, cros 175 Lei, cursele copiilor 50 Lei
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running race held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on 18 July 2026. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation gain, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.
course_highlights: Scenic subalpine routes with elevation gains ranging from +30 m to +1000 m
14 km cross-country race with +900 m elevation gain and 21 km half marathon with +1000 m elevation gain
Routes for children and teenagers with modest elevation gain, adapted to age
additional: Race bib pickup is from 06:30 to 07:30, the technical briefing is at 07:45, the adult race starts at 09:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:00. Hydration stations are available every 5 km along the route. Parking is available at the school in the village centre and in the Beberani area, approximately 100 m from the start. After the race, participants are invited to a brunch featuring local products, and the entry fee includes a donation of 50 lei to support the Țara Colibelor project. mountain routes, online registration, donation included, post-race brunch

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: The Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) race is the largest mountain running event in Greece, offering a unique experience amid the natural beauty and culture of the Zagori region. With routes crossing stone bridges and villages and passing through the impressive Vikos Gorge, runners can test their endurance on demanding trails with significant elevation changes. ZMR includes multiple routes, from a 5 km race for everyone to the two-day 93 km Challenge, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The event is welcoming and professional, with an emphasis on athlete safety and support.
course_highlights: Routes featuring stone-built bridges and villages of Zagori
The impressive Vikos Gorge and the Tymfi mountain range
Significant elevation changes and demanding trails
additional: Races start at different times depending on the route: the Challenge and TeRA start at 05:00, the Zagori Classic 33 km at 06:30, the Half Marathon at 07:30, the Forest 10 km at 08:45, the Fun 5 km at 21:00, and the ZAGORAKI Kids Race at 19:00. The Challenge is a two-day race (18–19 July 2026) covering a total of 93 km. Special routes are available for children and runners of all levels. The event provides support and aid stations, and enforces strict rules to ensure participants’ safety. It includes races for children and adults, with registration opening on 27 March 2026. Information is available about accommodation, regulations, and volunteering.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: The Salt Road is a running race held in Messolonghi, offering 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m courses. The event emphasizes accurate electronic timing and excellent organization, aiming to offer runners from all over Greece an unforgettable experience. It combines sporting spirit with local tradition, attracting participants of all ages and abilities. The organizers ensure prompt results announcements and provide commemorative participation certificates.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m courses
Accurate electronic chip timing
Double start and finish gates, 4 meters wide
additional: Registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Results are announced and posted promptly, 5–10 minutes after the race ends. A commemorative electronic participation certificate with individual results is provided. The race announcer keeps participants informed throughout the event. The race is a celebration of sport and the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the area's cultural heritage.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
Trail race Kopaonik 2026
description: Trail Race Kopaonik is a traditional event that brings together trail-running and nature enthusiasts in Kopaonik National Park. With three courses of different lengths—7 km, 15 km and 24 km—the race gives both beginners and experienced runners the chance to enjoy beautiful forest and meadow scenery, fresh mountain air and pleasant temperatures. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a music programme, organised walks and a children’s race. The organisers provide fully marked courses, electronic timing, T-shirts, medals, refreshments and medical assistance.
course_highlights: The Kopaonik 7K course passes through the Crvene Bare area and by the Markov Kamen picnic site
The Kopaonik 15K course goes over Gobelja peak, Meka Presedla and Likina Česma
The Kopaonik 24K course has 900 m of elevation gain and a time limit of 6 hours
additional: All courses start in Dolina sportova at 10:00. Course time limits are: 7K – 3 hours, 15K – 4 hours, 24K – 6 hours. Refreshment stations and medical assistance are available on the courses. Participants who register by 6 July 2026 receive the official race T-shirt. Chip-based electronic timing, online results and certificates are available. The race is individual; registration is online only via njuko.com. Race-day registration is not available. Entry includes electronic timing, finisher medals, refreshment stations, medical assistance and GPS navigation. Register via njuko.com; on-site race-day registration is not available.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the surroundings of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 9 to 56 km, with different difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both experienced runners and cyclists and enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race package includes a medal, a souvenir bearing the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. Additional and mandatory equipment is not included. Registration at lower fees is available until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59; payment is due by May 2 at 12:00. Registration at early-bird fees is available until April 30, 2026, with medals, race packages, and aid stations included.

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain skills. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and challenging mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including passages over peaks such as Botev and Mlechnia Chal.
course_highlights: Technical sections with significant elevation gain and a climb to Botev Peak
A route along the mountain ridge with varied terrain and steep descents
A long ridge run passing numerous mountain huts and checkpoints
additional: Participants in the Ultra distance must have valid mountain insurance and must have finished two races with at least 4,000 meters of elevation gain in the past 3 years. Entry to the Sky distance is open to all. A GPS device is mandatory for navigation using the provided GPS track. There are checkpoints with cut-off times, for example, at Petolachkata—10 hours. The courses include technical sections; accommodation options include Pleven Hut, camping, or staying in Apriltsi. The race is approximately 78 km long, with a record under 13 hours.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National Championships for boys and girls under 18 are one of the largest events in the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition features a range of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Track and field events for boys and girls under 18
Discus and hammer events at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad
Competition held at Vasil Levski National Stadium
additional: Venue: Pravets; events: long jump and triple jump; date: 25 July 2026

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: The 10th WAVE Running returns in full force on July 24–25, 2026, along the Keramoti–Avdira coastline, with its main base at Myrodato Beach in Xanthi. The anniversary event offers three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km through the unique natural environment of the Nestos Delta. Side events highlight the event’s character and philosophy, including beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical events, creating a complete celebration of sport, nature, and culture.
course_highlights: Three routes: 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km
The natural environment of the Nestos Delta
Main base at Myrodato Beach
additional: Side events such as beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical events highlight the event’s character and philosophy. Routes: 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km; natural environment, side events, exhibitions, musical events.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness regions. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval shepherd settlements, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometer offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.
course_highlights: Routes through Slătioara Forest, a UNESCO candidate
Steep climbs and technical trails in the Carpathian Mountains
Spectacular natural landscapes: Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei
additional: The Ultra Rocks race (114 km) starts just before midnight in Câmpulung Moldovenesc. The route includes an initial loop through the town, followed by stretches through wilderness and checkpoints with facilities such as Live Cooking. The event takes place in the Ultra Trail Village at the Central Plateau in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, next to City Hall. Multiple mountain race distances, technical trails, the location in Romania, and details about registration and rules are available on websites and social media.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race taking place on July 26, 2026, in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes that pass through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the start line is provided by coach. Race kits can be collected on Saturday and on Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Historic route along Avram Iancu’s road
Water stations at km 5, 12.5, 17.5, and 20
Total ascent of 178 m and total descent of 332 m on the 22 km course
additional: Coach transport from 7:00 from the center of Câmpeni to the start line; race kits can be collected on Saturday between 14:00 and 20:00 and on Sunday until 07:00; water stations along the route; meeting and registration from 05:30 to 07:30 at the Avram Iancu Statue in Câmpeni. Participation includes multiple starts, transport to the start with partner Arieșul SA, race-kit collection, and an artistic and traditional program as part of the event.

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: The 2nd Oinousses Run is a unique event combining running and cycling on the enchanting island of Oinousses. The 13 km running course passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation and offers impressive views of Chios, while the 20 km cycling route makes a full loop of the island, with gentle climbs and fast descents. Participants enjoy a wonderful experience amid picturesque landscapes and coastal routes, with amenities including electronic timing, a medal, a commemorative T-shirt, and aid stations. The event is organized by the Chios Cyclists and the Municipality of Oinousses, offering a friendly, summertime sporting event.
course_highlights: Coastal and traditional routes
Passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation
Impressive views of Chios
additional: The maximum number of participants is 150 athletes due to limited places on the ferry. Race amenities: race number, electronic timing, commemorative T-shirt, finisher's medal, aid stations (water, isotonic drinks, fruit), medical coverage, photography coverage, and 50% off ferry transport. The event includes 13 km and 20 km routes, with participation limited to 150 athletes, and offers commemorative T-shirts, a medal, aid stations, and medical coverage.

name: FAGARAS ROCKS!
organizer: A C U M - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event offering a unique experience on spectacular trails in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic scenery and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, include multiple peaks above 2,500 m and more than 50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m, and are run in semi-autonomous conditions. The event includes several races of varying distances, for experienced runners as well as younger participants and amateurs, with a friendly atmosphere and related activities for participants and their families. The organizers provide facilities such as aid stations, medical assistance, a hot meal on the course, finisher medals, and cash prizes for the mountain races.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of marked routes in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks above 2,500 m and 15 peaks above 2,200 m
50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib (non-personalized bibs after July 15), live satellite tracking for #TheWildTruth, a hot meal on the course for #TheWildTruth, engraved stone finisher medals, a superlight technical shirt for the first 300 entrants in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and themed workshops, aid and hydration stations, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. Multiple route categories, information about camping and parking; the event includes an ultra and a skyrace.

description: The first national road running championships in Bulgaria will take place in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The event features distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as races for children and beginners. It is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over 4,000 BGN. This is an important opportunity for recreational and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 mile (1,609 m), 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21.1 km)
The race takes place in Plovdiv, one of Bulgaria’s major cities
Includes 1 km races for children and beginners
additional: The 1 km mass participation run is free for everyone. Before the championships, there will be Kids’ Athletics activities and a press conference with awards for the best runners of 2024. The race is part of the Run Bulgaria series and serves as preparation for the European Road Running Championships. Distances: 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 1 km for children and beginners; online registration; a 40 BGN entry fee for some distances; free 1 km mass participation start.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area of Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from courses of varying difficulty and technical features, running amid stunning mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of achievement on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and note that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of varying difficulty and technical features
Stunning views in northwestern Bulgaria between the Iskar and Timok rivers
The opportunity to climb peaks and run in nature
additional: A reservation must be made at least one week before the chosen date. The races do not include transportation to the venue. Participants must wear specialized trail running shoes. The voucher is valid for one participant. The race may be canceled in bad weather. Information about the course, registration, and participation requirements is unavailable; the event is part of trail running races in northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event in the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, in the Western Rhodopes. The start and finish are at Olympic Square, at an elevation of 1,062 m. The courses pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic ridge trails, reaching a maximum elevation of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
Panoramic ridge trails reach a maximum elevation of 1,872 m
Three distances with elevation gain of up to +1,887 m and descent of up to −1,885 m
additional: Free parking opens at 05:00 at Vasil Dechev Secondary School. Registration and race-pack collection are from 6:30 to 8:00 at Olympic Square, with on-site payment available via Revolut, PayPal, or ePay. Mountain biking and running starts are separated by distance and begin between 8:30 and 9:30. There is a children's run and a children's program with yoga, games, and cake. The children's awards and awards for all distances are scheduled for the afternoon. The event includes different distances and packages for combined participation, with the mountain biking start scheduled for 08:30 on August 1, 2026.

description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting challenge. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until available places are filled.

Option to compete individually or in teams
Scenic location at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș
additional: Participants can compete individually or in teams (minimum 5 members). Team rankings are determined by adding together the number of laps completed by all team members. Entry fees are non-refundable. Registration confirmation is emailed immediately after payment is processed. An official T-shirt and partnerships to support participants are available. Endurance cycling event, with a schedule on July 31 and August 1, 2026; entry fees, rules, and results are available on the website.

name: MOGOȘA EVERESTING
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, in Mogoșa, Maramureș. Participants can compete individually or in teams, with team rankings based on the total number of laps completed by all members. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers an authentic mountain running experience focused on effort and team spirit. Entry fees are affordable, and there is a special category for children and juniors under 18.
course_highlights: Mountain running on a multi-lap course
Team rankings based on the total number of laps completed
Individual and team participation (minimum 5 members)

Registration confirmation is sent by email immediately after payment is processed. Entry fees are non-refundable. Participation includes a kit and official T-shirt. The event has multiple categories and takes place on mountainous terrain with repeated climbs; entry fees vary depending on the date.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through the forest, marked clearly during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for outdoor activity.
course_highlights: 10.5 km trail course with 215 m of positive elevation gain
Mostly through the forest on the Cornești Plateau
Marked with visible tape during the day and reflective signs at night
additional: The event includes 24-hour individual MTB and trail running events, as well as four-member relay teams, an individual 12-hour run, and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The time limit for completing a lap is 2 hours for MTB and 3 hours for running. Participants can store their personal equipment in tents in the start/finish area. Rankings are based on the distance completed within the allotted time. The event features multiple categories and prizes for the top finishers, and takes place in the natural setting of the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara on August 1, 2026, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and supports the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, suitable for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation to encourage people to take up running and get involved in the community.
course_highlights: Route through Franz Joseph Park, Timișoara
Night event starting at 20:30
Friendly atmosphere and an active running community
additional: The event is part of the Alergotura series, which gives club members free access to Politehnica Timișoara’s running base and organizes team-building activities. No information was found about participation fees or online registration for this edition. The event also includes weekly runs and other sports activities in Timișoara, promoting health and social connections in the community.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three routes of different lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 9 p.m. by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the route, giving even the slowest runners enough time to finish. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy Fruška Gora at night.
course_highlights: Three routes: 7 km, 11 km, and 19 km
9 p.m. start by the Na Vencu restaurant
Time limit: 4 hours and 15 minutes
additional: The routes have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes, allowing even the slowest participants to finish. The event is intended for hikers, runners, and lovers of nature and Fruška Gora. It features trails for different fitness levels, suitable for both hikers and runners. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle in nature.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriško venac, Fruška gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Freedom Monument at Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which run through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Lake Ledinci. The race combines adrenaline-fueled obstacles with beautiful scenery and ends in an atmosphere of community and celebration at the end of the season. This event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forest of Fruška Gora
Water obstacles at Lake Ledinci
A night race requiring a headlamp, with an adrenaline-fueled journey through the dark
additional: The start and finish are at Iriški Venac, by the “Na Vencu” restaurant. A headlamp is mandatory for the night race. The competition is part of the Invictus OCR League, with scoring at three locations. Every competitor receives a medal at the finish. The race is adapted to different fitness levels. The event is part of a challenge combining obstacle races and trail races, offering a unique experience in the nature of Fruška Gora.

description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on 2 August 2026, starting at 06:00. The event includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with routes through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The organizers provide transport, accommodation and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the cut-off time.

A 10 km prologue with 900 m of positive elevation gain from the village of Chuprene to Gorski Rai Hut (untimed)
additional: The race has a limited number of participants (30 for the first edition). You must have completed races with cut-off times in 2025 or provide evidence of similar achievements. Transport is arranged from Sofia to Kom Hut and from Kom Hut to the village of Chuprene. Accommodation, dinner and breakfast at Kom and Gorski Rai huts are included. Everyone who finishes successfully receives branded clothing. The event includes a prologue, organized transport, accommodation, breakfasts and branded clothing for finishers. Limited to 30 participants; selection is based on experience.

name: 10α Παραποτάμια
description: The Pantavrechei Mountaineering Club is organizing the 10th consecutive edition of the Riverside Races on August 2, 2026, in Prodromos, Evrytania. These are mixed river-crossing and trail races, with two routes of 8 and 14 kilometers starting at Dipotama Prousou and finishing in the square in Prodromos. The course includes sections through the water, trails with 350 meters of elevation gain, and two water stations. The event is co-organized with the Evrytania Regional Unit and the Municipality of Karpenisi, under the auspices of the SEGAS Association of Central Greece.
course_highlights: Two routes of 8 and 14 km with a shared start and finish
Crossings through the waters of the Krikelopotamos and Prousiotis rivers
350 meters of elevation gain and two water stations
additional: The time limit is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Participants who do not finish within this time must sign a declaration and continue at their own risk. The race starts from the Bakoyannis Bridge. The event includes mixed races and trails, with an emphasis on nature and the local community.

name: Parapotamia -Krikelopotamos o bregmenos dromos
description: The Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos: The Wet Road race is organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania region. This mountain race crosses rivers and trails, offering a unique experience in a natural setting rich in history and beauty. Founded in 2015, the club is active in the region and maintains trails while promoting mountain sports. Taking part in the race supports the continuation of the club’s activities and helps showcase the area.
course_highlights: Routes crossing rivers and trails in South Evrytania
A natural mountain setting rich in history
Trail maintenance and promotion by the organizing club
additional: The Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club was founded in 2015 and organizes the Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos: The Wet Road river-and-trail race. The club opens and maintains trails and recognizes people who have contributed to the region. The club can be contacted by phone and email for registration and information. The event includes trails, river crossings, and local music, with online registration. It takes place on August 2, 2026, in the Evrytania region.

name: Retezat Mountain Run
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Râușor area of Hunedoara, offering four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the Easy Run to the Marathon. The routes cross the wild and hard-to-reach landscapes of Retezat National Park, with aid stations in spectacular natural settings, including Bucura glacial lake. The event is organized by a non-profit association dedicated to mountain conservation and involves a team of volunteers and professionals to ensure safety and the smooth running of the race. Participants enjoy an authentic mountain running experience, with cash and in-kind prizes, as well as a friendly, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation gain, up to 3340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in remote areas accessible only on foot or by air
The route passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest glacial lake in Romania
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the ski slope. There is a technical briefing and a Pasta Party before the race. Mandatory equipment includes mountain running shoes and a windstopper/rain jacket. The routes are marked and monitored by volunteers, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended that participants leave their cars in the car park at the end of the paved road; the competition area is a 10-minute walk away. Various distances, extensive logistical support, online registration available, an event with a long tradition and recognition in the mountain community.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event includes marathon, half-marathon and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local figures, offering an experience immersed in nature on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the atmosphere, creating a warm and welcoming community. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.
course_highlights: Easy trails and dirt roads through Homu Forest
Varied scenery, from old-growth forest to colorful agricultural fields
No asphalt or concrete, making the routes ideal for natural running
additional: The event includes children’s races “In Memoriam” Professor Liviu Marinescu, Latin dancing and a campfire (weather permitting). Participants must send proof of payment of the entry fee by email or WhatsApp. The fee can also be paid by bank transfer or Revolut. The routes are accessible, with no major difficulties and no asphalt or concrete. The event is dedicated to the memory of local figures and supports Mia’s Children Association. Routes include a half-marathon (21 km), cross-country race (10 km) and children’s races (4.2 km), with staggered starts and social and cultural activities.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
location: Rausor, Retezat Mountains, Hunedoara County, Romania
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with courses climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to the nearly 40 km Marathon, with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The courses cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term continuity plan.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gain, up to 3,340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in wild areas accessible only on foot or by air
The marathon course passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest in the country
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place Friday from 15:00 to 23:00 and Saturday from 6:00 to 9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the Râușor ski slope. A technical briefing and a Pasta Party are held before the race. Mandatory equipment includes trail-running shoes and a windproof/rain jacket. The courses are marked and monitored, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended to leave your car in the parking area at the end of the paved road, a 10-minute walk from the start. Courses have significant elevation gain and difficult mountain terrain, with limited support in some areas; mountain weather conditions should be taken into account.

name: 2ο Olympia Night Run «Run Under Zeus»
description: The 2nd Olympia Night Run “Run Under Zeus” is a night race held in the heart of Ancient Olympia, honoring the tradition of the first Olympic Games. The race takes place under the light of the full moon, bringing to life the myth of Hercules and Zeus and offering a unique running experience in a historic and mythical setting. The event is supported by the Greek National Tourism Organization and aims to combine sport with a message of life and culture.
course_highlights: Night race under the light of the full moon
Route through the heart of Ancient Olympia
Historic and mythical setting with views of the Aegean Sea
additional: The race honors the tradition of the first Olympic Games, which were organized by the Curetes and held under the light of the full moon. It is supported by PharmaLead and the Greek National Tourism Organization. Greek Olympians embrace the event, giving the race an athletic and cultural character. A night race with a cultural character; participation may be possible through registration; the route passes significant archaeological sites in the area.

name: RILA RUN
description: Ride Or Run - Rila is a popular and unconventional race held in the Rila Mountains, starting in the village of Pastra and finishing at Kalin Reservoir. The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with more than 1,800 meters of elevation gain. The race attracts both cyclists and runners, who face a serious challenge in mountain conditions. After a hiatus of several years, the event once again brings together the top athletes in this discipline.
course_highlights: 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road
More than 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Route from the village of Pastra to Kalin Reservoir in the Rila Mountains
additional: The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with aid stations at 5, 10, and 15.3 km. The event offers running, cycling, and duathlon races.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing passionate runners together in a remarkable natural setting. The courses are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.
course_highlights: Spectacular courses through northern Romania
Running amid nature and authentic scenery
An event bringing together nature and community spirit
additional: Online registration is open until 1 August 2026. Those whose registrations are confirmed by 20 June are guaranteed the official race T-shirt in their race kit. The organizer will decide whether race-day registration will be permitted and will announce this in advance. Trail running, spectacular courses, outdoor event scheduled for 9 August 2026

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, environmental and social responsibility, with the help of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as the most beautiful part of life: taking part is considered a victory, and finishing a triumph. The event welcomes everyone, encouraging young people and children to take part in creative and enjoyable activities.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promoting health, well-being and social cohesion
additional: People over 15 may participate in the race. Minors require parental consent to take part. The event is organized on a nonprofit basis with the help of volunteers and promotes social responsibility and cohesion. Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, open to participants over 15, promote health and social cohesion. The Namati race on 9 August 2026 is the largest mountain race in Western Macedonia.

name: Ultra Race Romania

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Avans de 500€ urmat de 5 rate lunare de 475€ fiecare

description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route in the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary landscapes and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After finishing the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event emphasizes the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.
course_highlights: A 250 km route split into 6 stages in the Carpathian Mountains
Legendary places such as Lake Vulturilor and Cașoca Waterfall
Wild landscapes and local mysteries in the Buzău area
additional: The race is self-sufficient, with tent accommodation during the 6 stages. Medical assistance, water at checkpoints and camps, hot meals, bus transportation before and after the race, finisher medals, and T-shirts are provided. After the race, a 2-day cultural tour of Brașov, Bran, and Sinaia is organized, with hotel accommodation and meals included. SPOT satellite live tracking is available for competitors. Participants must be prepared for wilderness conditions, with mandatory equipment and strict safety rules; the event also includes a cultural excursion after the race.

name: Oltenia Forest Run
description: Oltenia Forest Run is a running and orienteering competition held in the wooded area of Băile Govora, for running and orienteering enthusiasts of all ages. The running course is marked and suited to participants in good enough health to undertake physical exertion. The event promotes respect for the environment and participant safety, and provides a race kit with a race bib and a gift. It combines sport and nature and is suitable for children, young people, adults, and veterans.
course_highlights: Marked running course through wooded areas
Orienteering section for all age categories
Compliance with environmental protection and safety rules
additional: The race kit contains a race bib to be worn visibly and a gift. Registration is available online via a form or on site, subject to availability. Participants must follow environmental protection rules during the race. Trail running and orienteering in forest terrain; online or on-site registration (limited places); event in August 2026, with prizes and certificates for participants.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically challenging sections with fast descents and requires strength, speed, and skill. In addition to the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain, passing over Yastrebets, Aleko, Musala, and Mancho
16 km Yastrebets Trail Run with 1,000 m of elevation gain on a marked course
Technical, rocky, and steep sections with panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race pack collection on the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards for the winners at 11:00 for the Yastrebets Trail Run and at 15:00 for Musala Extreme. The team race has no limit on the number of participants per team. Duathlon with cycling the following day on a route through Lakatiska Rila. The course has technical sections requiring mountain-running skills; registration and an entry fee are required; mandatory equipment applies; shorter-distance races and a team race are available; duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains. The race requires technical skills on rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, takes place alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain over the peaks of Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho
Technical rocky and steep sections requiring skill and care
Panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race-pack collection takes place the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards are presented after each distance. Participants can also enter the team race or the duathlon with cycling the following day. The course is 38 km long with 2,200 m of elevation gain, including a climb to Musala Peak and sections through mountain shelters and trails. The registration deadline is August 10, and the race supports initiatives to restore vegetation.

name: THE COLOR RUN - MAMAIA BY NIGHT
description: The Color Run - Mamaia by Night is a 5-kilometer race full of color and energy, held on a course in Mamaia near the large parking lot in front of Hotel Rex. The event celebrates health, joy, and originality: participants are showered with fluorescent powder at every kilometer, and the fun continues with a cloud of colored powder at the finish. The race is untimed, with the focus on a joyful experience and a festival atmosphere featuring music and interactive moments. It is suitable for all ages, including young children, and promises a memorable evening of running and outdoor fun.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Mamaia, starting and finishing in the large parking lot in front of Hotel Rex
Fluorescent powder stations at every kilometer
A cloud of colored powder and a festival atmosphere with music and UV lights
additional: Access to the event area begins at 18:00, and starts take place in successive waves between 20:00 and 20:20. The colored-powder moment will be announced by the MC on race day. The standard kit includes a fluorescent T-shirt, 2 temporary tattoos, a finisher medal, and fluorescent powder. Children aged 0–6 can participate for free without a kit, but receive a medal and powder. The T-shirt and race bib must be worn throughout the event, and access to the event area is via the wristband received at the entrance. Urban/seaside terrain; online registration; includes colored powders, medals, T-shirts, and temporary tattoos; no bag drop; strict rules against animals and vehicles.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running race in the XLkmrun series, held in the area around the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different fitness levels. The routes follow natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: Mountain running in the area around the village of Kătina
Three distances: 4.8 km, 9.6 km and 14.4 km
Routes on natural trails and cart roads
additional: The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities. Each event offers a choice of several distances. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. No specific information is available about start times, fees or participant caps. The event includes three distances and takes place in August 2026.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The race offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Krepost Stadium
The course passes the Roman fortress wall
The course runs through two beautiful parks in Hisarya
additional: Both professional athletes and children and teenagers take part in the race. Lectures and an athletics academy for children are also included. The event is part of the larger RUN BULGARIA initiative. The next race is scheduled for August 16, 2026. As part of the RUN BULGARIA series, it offers prizes for the winners and participation opportunities for all ages.

name: Βαλτινές Διαδρομές
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιποπουλιωτών Αθήνας – Πειραϊά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The “Valtines Routes” road races are being held for the fourth consecutive year alongside the Inachos River, in N. Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania. The Chalkiopoulites Association of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit” invites you to take part in a celebration of culture and sport, held as part of the cultural events taking place from August 10 to 17. The races include three routes, with electronic timing and support from volunteers and the local community.
course_highlights: Three routes alongside the Inachos River
Electronic timing
Organized by the Chalkiopoulites Association of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit”
additional: The races take place on Sunday, August 11, 2024, starting at 18:30. The event is supported by volunteers and the local community of Chalkiopoulo. Timing is electronic. The event is part of cultural events running from August 10 to 17. Routes of 1,000 m, 10,000 m, and 5,000 m; electronic timing; cultural events; volunteer support; out-and-back routes finishing at the Primary School.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique running experience on specially prepared outdoor trails surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running as a community.
course_highlights: Night course in Dumbrava Sibiului, outdoors
Running on natural terrain with forest scenery
Event with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu
additional: Marked and illuminated course, races for children, prizes and medals for participants

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
location: Muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului, Sibiu, Romania
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is the most beautiful night cross-country race in Romania, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked courses after dark. Adult races are available over 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children’s races over 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age categories from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the open category winners in the 9 km race.
course_highlights: Fully marked night course at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum
Adult race distances: 4.5 km and 9 km; children’s distances: 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m
The races start after dusk, with the children’s races beginning at 20:00
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited: 150 in the children’s races, 300 in the 4.5 km race and 300 in the 9 km race. Race kits are handed out after signing a declaration of personal responsibility, which will be sent by email and must be brought signed when collecting the kit. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place across the 22 men’s and women’s categories. The event includes outdoor trail races and prizes for the top performers, and takes place at locations such as the Open-Air Museum, the Zoo and Astra Museum. Registration is online, and the event promises an experience full of energy and fun.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers through the heart of the Rhodope Mountains
Passes by the Wonderful Bridges and the Chimneys
The route includes Tsirikova Church and wild natural scenery
additional: The race is a benchmark for wilderness and natural beauty, combining sport and culture in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: 2X2 Race
price_range: 500,00 lei (X1 Race), 250,00 lei (X2 Race), 350,00 lei (2X2 Race)
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course with 4,200 m of positive elevation gain passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m D+) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m D+), are also highly technical and intense, intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.
course_highlights: Entire course above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains
Passes over Moldoveanu (2,544 m) and Negoiu (2,535 m)
Significant elevation gain: 4,200 m D+ for 2X2 Race, 2,400 m D+ for X1 Race, and 1,900 m D+ for X2 Race
additional: Race kits can be collected at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac on August 23 between 18:00 and 22:00, with collection on Saturday morning possible in exceptional circumstances. Participants must present their ID card and complete a declaration of responsibility. Race entries cannot be transferred, but the kit may be collected by another designated person. Limited number of competitors: 200 for each race. The race follows the principle of total self-sufficiency, with no aid stations provided along the course (except for the aid stations for 2X2 Race). Trail ultramarathon, registration at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac, kit collection on August 23, technical high-altitude mountain terrain

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event celebrating Romania’s unique nature and heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a 39.3 km challenge with 1,292 m of elevation gain, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.
course_highlights: 39.3 km route with 1,292 m of elevation gain
Checkpoints and hydration stations with water and snacks every 5–10 km
Panoramic landscapes and passages through the villages of Ciosa and Lunca Ilvei
additional: The 2026 edition T-shirt can be purchased as an add-on during registration. The event also includes races for children, with a special 1 km race supported by volunteers and entertainers. The marathon has 5 checkpoints and hydration stations, and visiting all of them is mandatory for the race to be validated. Participants can purchase T-shirts and other merchandise. The event also includes activities for families and children, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a connection with nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
location: Planinarski dom u Rastištu, Tara, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the mountain lodge in Rastište. The event features three different technically demanding and physically challenging courses designed for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.
course_highlights: Technically demanding and physically challenging courses in Tara National Park
Three races of different distances and elevation gains: 46 km with 3300D+, 24 km with 1700D+, and 10 km with 700D+
Start and finish at the mountain lodge in Rastište
additional: Registration opens on February 1, 2026. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards. The race counts as the 5th round of the PSS National Mountain Running Series. Sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area. The competition includes three races of different distances and difficulty levels, focusing on technically demanding and physically challenging terrain. In addition to the races, sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Χίου
description: The 14th Chios Half Marathon is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. The race and accompanying sports and cultural activities will take place in the traditional settlement of Kampos, Chios, on August 23, 2026. Alongside the half marathon, there will also be 1.5 km (children’s), 5 km, and 10.5 km races, as well as races for people with disabilities. This celebration of sport and culture invites runners of all ages and abilities to participate.
course_highlights: Routes through the traditional settlement of Kampos, Chios
Additional races for people with disabilities and a 1.5 km children’s race
Cultural activities alongside the races
additional: The event includes accompanying sports and cultural activities. It is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. Races are available for people with disabilities, as well as a 1.5 km children’s race and 5 km and 10.5 km races. Routes through natural landscapes, road and trail events, and activities on the island of Chios.

name: Στη Σκιά του Κριάκουρα
description: The “In the Shadow of Kriakouras” mountain race is being held for the 12th year in Theodoriana, Arta, offering two challenging courses of 10 and 23 kilometres. The routes cross fir forests, rivers and trails of exceptional natural beauty and difficulty, revealing the secrets of the Tzoumerka mountains. The race is dedicated to the person who inspired the first event in 2014 and serves as a qualifying race for participation in major mountain marathons. The start and finish are in the central square of Theodoriana, with all races starting at 10:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Challenging 10 km and 23 km routes amid exceptional natural beauty
Sections through fir forests, three fast-flowing rivers and trails
A wide variety of natural terrain, including wild-boar wallows and bear habitat
additional: Entry includes a technical T-shirt, commemorative medal, electronic timing, individual refreshments and a meal featuring traditional products after the race. Race bibs can be collected from the race office on Saturday from 18:00 to 21:00 and on Sunday from 8:00 to 9:30. There are 12 aid stations on the 23 km course and 4 on the 10 km course. Hiking poles and GPS devices are permitted. Camping is available, along with a wide range of accommodation options in the area. The race takes place on 23 August 2026 and is open to both men and women. The event promotes sport, connection with nature and local tradition.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run a 6.8 km course in repeated loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-oriented experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.
course_highlights: A 6.8 km course run once every hour
Spectacular scenery in the Brebu area, Dâmbovița, Romania
A continuous format that lasts until only one runner remains in the race
additional: The race consists of 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, and continues until only one runner remains. Community is central to the event, and the organizers provide participants with support throughout. Registration is open after July 21 if places are still available; volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

name: Adventure Sky Run
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km trail course, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers impressive natural scenery and the chance to push beyond your limits.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km single-track course climbing toward Zeleni Preslap, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
The 55 km course connects the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs can be collected on August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 20:00 at Hotel Rila, Borovets Resort, and on the morning of August 29, 2026, before the start. Separate starts: 06:00 for 55 km, 09:00 for 12 km and 25 km. Award ceremony after the race and organized transport for 55 km participants to Samokov and Borovets. Distances: 12 km, 25 km, and 55 km; registration and equipment requirements; held in Borovets and Malyovitsa; mountain running in the Rila Mountains.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2026
location: Malyovitsa Sports Center, Bansko Ski Resort, Samokov, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, with three distances passing through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km route with climbs and single-track trails, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, with technical and rocky sections. The race offers impressive natural scenery and challenges for runners with different levels of experience. The organizers provide aid stations and transport after the finish of the longest distance.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through centuries-old Rila pine forests
25 km of single-track trails and a climb toward Malyovitsa Peak with panoramic views
55 km ultramarathon climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs are distributed on 28.08.2026 in front of Hotel Rila in Borovets resort and on 29.08.2026 in front of the Malyovitsa Central Mountain School for the shorter distances. The time limit is 14 hours for the 55 km and 9 hours for the 25 km. Participants must bring their own water container, as there are no bottles at the aid stations. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the 55 km finish, organized transport to Samokov and Borovets is available. Advance registration and payment are mandatory; equipment is required for 55 km participants; the race is intended for advanced runners; there is no race-day registration except for the children's run.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race, part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in the Western Balkan Mountains. The start is at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), with impressive views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a rich program for children after the race.
course_highlights: Climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), the westernmost peak in Bulgaria above 2,000 m
Views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains
Three distances with substantial elevation gain, starting at 405 m above sea level
additional: Free parking at Yordan Radichkov Square, next to the Municipality building. On-site payment by bank transfer, Revolut, PayPal or ePay during registration from 6:30 to 8:00. Children’s yoga, games and cake after the race. Mountain running and mountain biking starts over different distances, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The race is part of an ultramarathon series and is intended for runners seeking a serious mountain challenge.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain-running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Routes through nature where two national parks meet
Four main races and a children’s race
additional: Race kits can be picked up from 16:00 to 22:00 on the day before the event and from 7:00 to 8:00 on race day. The Scorota route starts at 8:00, while the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes start at 9:00. All participants who finish within the time limit receive a finisher’s medal and a limited-edition cap. There are support stations along the route and at the finish, individual timing with online results, access to a wine tasting and a traditional dinner, an ambulance at the start/finish, and access to workshops and a social area with a campfire and live music. The event takes place on mountain and nature trails, with accommodation available in the Valea Iarului area and other facilities for participants.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the tradition of mountain running in the area, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes surrounded by nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits and related activities such as tastings and socializing.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Aid stations and individual timing with online rankings
Access to Retezat National Park and traditional culinary experiences
additional: Race kits can be collected between 16:00 and 22:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:00 on race day. Starts are scheduled for 8:00 for the Scorota route and 9:00 for the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes. Participants receive a limited-edition cap, a finisher medal, aid stations along the route, individual timing, wine tasting, access to the campsite and a traditional dinner. Practical first-aid courses and photography exhibitions are also organized. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the men's and women's open categories, as well as in the age categories. The race is 26 km long, with approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain, and is recognized as a landmark trail-running event in Romania. Participation includes access to accommodation areas and information about the race kit.
