description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on 29 August 2026 on Mount Avala. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the unique atmosphere of a nighttime adventure with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks, and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with awards for the top male and female finishers in both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on Mount Avala, starting in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: Headlamps are required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be gifted. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. Distances of 6 km and 10 km, headlamps required, limit of 500 participants, start at 20:30, in Belgrade, race village for visitors

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci that combines running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program lasting throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and sporting challenges.
course_highlights: Running and cycling along the banks of the Danube
Orienteering and water jumping
Hiking and outdoor sports activities
additional: The event also includes film screenings, live music, and volleyball matches, creating a rich and varied program for participants and visitors. Registration is open for the Inđija Trejl 08 trail race, which is part of the Dunavske Čarolije event series, with the possibility of early registration discounts.

name: Black Yard Ultra
location: Black Yard Ultra, Βερδικούσια, Λάρισας, Greece
description: BLACK YARD Ultra by Mamali Festival is a challenging ultra trail race that starts and finishes at Mamali Festival Base Camp, at an elevation of approximately 1,454 meters. It features a Last Runner Standing ultra race, a 12-kilometer race, and a 1-kilometer children’s race. The 12-kilometer loop has 514 meters of ascent and runs mainly on trails and dirt roads. The ultra requires experience, as the laps become increasingly demanding and the time allowed to complete them decreases. Base Camp offers camping facilities, showers, food, and a festival atmosphere, creating a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: 12 km loop with 514 meters of ascent
10 km of trail and 2 km of dirt road
Race elevation of approximately 1,454 meters
additional: The Last Runner Standing race allows 2 hours for the first lap, with the time decreasing by 3 minutes for each subsequent lap. Mandatory gear: headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, and emergency blanket. Base Camp offers free camping, showers, toilets, food, electricity, and a festival atmosphere. Aid stations provide electrolytes, bananas, water, Coca-Cola, and snacks; after 4 hours, potatoes, pasta, and soup are also available. Maximum number of participants: 100. A medical certificate is required. August weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 35°C and 25 mm of rainfall, making an early morning start essential. Trail, ultra race, Last Runner Standing format, camping available, registration requires a medical certificate, mandatory gear includes a headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, and emergency blanket.

description: Mamali BlackYard Ultra 2026 is a Last Runner Standing-style endurance race held in the mountain setting of Mamali, at an elevation of 1,454 meters, on August 29–30, 2026. Runners are challenged to complete consecutive laps of the same course. A 12-kilometer trail race is also held for those seeking a fast-paced mountain experience. There is also a non-timed 1-kilometer children’s race, ideal for families. The event offers a fully organized Base Camp with free camping, coffee, refreshments, and a festival atmosphere throughout the race.
course_highlights: Last Runner Standing-style endurance race with consecutive laps
Mountain course at an elevation of 1,454 meters
Fast-paced 12-kilometer trail race
additional: The event uses electronic chip timing. Race-pack pickup takes place at least one hour before the race and on the previous day at a location to be announced. A Base Camp operates at the start and finish area, offering free camping in an enclosed area, coffee, refreshments, rest areas, and a festival atmosphere. The course may be modified or postponed in the event of dangerous weather conditions. Trail and ultra race, festival atmosphere, camping facilities, medical certificate required, specific equipment required (headlamp, batteries, clothing, food), limited entries (up to 100 participants).

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain-running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic nature experience for runners of all levels. The competition includes two main races: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both follow varied, unprepared routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with the support of Păulești Town Hall and promotes respect for the natural environment and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting the rehabilitation of Romania’s wildlife.
course_highlights: 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 2.5-hour time limit
21 km half marathon with approximately 550 m of elevation gain and a 4-hour time limit
Unprepared routes marked with tape, colored spray paint, and signs, crossing wilderness areas and forest roads
additional: The routes are not closed to traffic, and participants must observe traffic rules. Each race has a time limit: 2.5 hours for the cross-country race and 4 hours for the half marathon. The organizers provide mountain-running training guides. The first 350 participants received free registration at previous editions. The start and finish are on the plateau next to the Păulești Mountain Rescue Base. Mountain routes with 350 m D+ of elevation gain for the cross-country race and 550 m D+ for the half marathon; online registration and results; event supported by Păulești Town Hall.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
location: Parcul Zăvoi, Râmnicu Vâlcea, Vâlcea County, Romania
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing connections between participants and shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.
course_highlights: Running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint courses in Zăvoi Park
An event for sociable athletes, with an emphasis on motivation and connection
A friendly atmosphere and support for nature and sustainability
additional: In-person races in Râmnicu Vâlcea on 30–31 August 2026, and a virtual race available anytime, anywhere for participants around the world.

The race starts at 8:30 p.m. and offers a unique nighttime experience on Mount Avala, with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is required. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top finishers in the men’s and women’s categories at both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: A headlamp is required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but entries can be gifted. Changing and storage of belongings are self-service. The race pack includes a T-shirt. Use of a headlamp is mandatory. The number of participants is limited to 500.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλληλεγγύης Ι.Ν. Αγίου Χαραλάμπους
CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Alba County, Romania
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering races for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The varied routes feature significant elevation changes, providing a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, and is intended both for experienced runners and for those looking to make the transition to ultramarathon running. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: 69.4 km ultramarathon with +2730 m of elevation gain
23.9 km half marathon with 918 m of elevation gain
10 km Silviu Pîclișan Cross-Country Race, held in memory of Cugir runner Silviu Pîclișan
additional: Staggered starts: Ultramarathon at 07:00, Half Marathon at 09:00, Cross-Country Race at 09:30, Children’s Race at 12:00. Multiple refreshment points along the routes. Technical briefings are held before the starts. After the competition, a Gulaș Party and award ceremonies for all races are organized. Cut-off times and safety rules are communicated and enforced. The routes include trails, forests, hills, and areas with beautiful natural scenery. Mountain routes, a trail-running event, various races for different levels, promotion of outdoor exercise.

description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each featuring spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport, nature, and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.
course_highlights: Popular Race (5 km) on an accessible route through the forest and along the Milcov River
Cross-Country Race (12 km, +500 m elevation gain) with challenging climbs through the vineyards of Crama Sârba Odobești
Half Marathon (22 km, +850 m elevation gain), combining mountain running with vineyard and historic scenery
additional: Race pack pickup and participant registration take place between 07:30 and 09:30. The starts are staggered: Half Marathon at 10:15, Cross-Country Race at 10:30, and Popular Race at 10:40. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30, and the event officially closes at 14:30. The start location is in Odobești’s recreation area, with parking available. You can travel by train to Focșani station and then take local transport or a taxi. Participation is by donation, and the event includes prizes for the fastest participants and for those who demonstrate team spirit and perseverance. Full course routes and details are available on the official website.

Teteven's Peaks
price_range: от 39 EUR до 115.39 EUR в зависимост от периода на регистрация
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast amid the beautiful scenery of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a walk with a mountain guide. Participants can enjoy fresh air, picturesque views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, and provides medals, T-shirts, and personalized race numbers with timing chips.
course_highlights: Start in front of the municipality building in Teteven, followed by a climb to Mount Petrahilya
Aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and food at key points along the route
Impressive views of the Balkan Mountains and the Teteven Balkan
additional: All participants receive a personalized race number with an RFID timing chip and can be tracked in real time. Medical teams and volunteers are present on the course and in the start/finish area. Aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, energy bars, and fruit. After the race, participants can explore the natural beauty around Teteven. Changing rooms and baggage storage are available in the start/finish area. Terrain: mountain trails. Registration includes a T-shirt, medal, insurance, an RFID chip for accurate timing, aid stations, and medical assistance.

description: The Via Pontica cross-border marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route beside Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Zелена стъпка (Green Step) club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The route follows unpaved and farm tracks, with sandy sections beside Lake Durankulak and toward Cosmos campsite
Crossing the state border between Bulgaria and Romania without stopping
A coastal promenade through the Romanian settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai
additional: Children run free of charge and do not cross the border into Romania. Cutoff times: 4:30 hours for 28 km and 3:00 hours for 16 km. The fee includes fruit, water, electronic timing, bus transport for the 16 km race, medical assistance, and toilets at the start/finish. Changing distance is possible for a fee and payment of the difference in fees. T-shirts with an original design are available for an additional charge. Two running distances (16 km and 28 km) and a 2 km children’s race; transport to the start points; registration and fees; prizes for the top three finishers; coastal routes and a crossing of the border into Romania.

name: Екиден маратон
location: Национален стадион „Васил Левски“, София, София-град, България
description: The Sofia Team Marathon is a relay race held on September 6, 2026, at Vasil Levski National Stadium. The race promotes road relay running and marks 140 years since the Unification of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total of 42.195 km, divided into six legs of different lengths, with color-coded bib numbers. The race is organized by the Sports Club “Sport for All Sofia in Europe” and the Bulgarian “Sport for All” Federation to determine the national relay running champions.
course_highlights: Total distance of 42.195 km, divided into 6 legs: 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 7.195 km
Start and finish in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Cutoff time for all teams: 4 hours and 1 minute
additional: Bib numbers and relay batons can be collected on September 5 from 10:00 to 19:30 and on September 6 from 7:30 to 8:30 in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium. Teams register primarily through the website 5kmrun.bg. There are checkpoint cutoff times, with specific times and passing limits for each leg. Registration on September 5 and 6, 2025, in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium; the event includes relays and various distances, including 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 7.195 km.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
price_range: 100 lei (Early Bird), 150 lei (normal), 180 lei (Last Minute), 119 lei (tricou tehnic)
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historic treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, cash prizes, and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.
course_highlights: Course through the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, with unique historic scenery
Start and finish in Piața Cetății, the city’s central square
Accessible, dynamic course for all levels, including an Up Stairs race
additional: All participants in the 5K and 10K races are automatically entered into the prize raffle. The race kit includes a race number, timing chip, and products provided by sponsors. The technical T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on during registration for 119 lei. Kit pickup is recommended on Saturday, 6 September, but is also possible on race morning. There are 5 age categories for the 10K and 7 categories for the 5K. Cash prizes and medals are offered by the main partner, AS World Cargo. Appeals may be submitted to the designated jury members within 15 minutes after finishing. The course includes areas of the city’s historic centre, with the chance to win cash prizes and medals, as well as the option to purchase a personalised technical T-shirt.

description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A variety of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a tradition spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied trails, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Varied mountain trails: Babeș Vertical, 3.8 km with +624 m elevation gain
A 21.6 km half marathon and an 8.8 km cross-country race in the Ciucaș Mountains
The Ridge, a 38.5 km race for experienced runners
additional: Race kits can be collected before the races. The event includes children's races (Kids Race) with separate starts. There are checkpoints and refreshment stations along the routes. The detailed start schedule is available on the website. Registration is open from April 15 to August 20, 2026, giving participants the opportunity to prepare for an unforgettable mountain experience.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at beautiful Lake Vlasina near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, which are suited to different ages and levels of ability. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Every participant receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the shore of Lake Vlasina, surrounded by beautiful natural scenery
Distances for different age groups, from the Mini Kid to the Olympic triathlon
Changing rooms close to the start and finish
additional: Registration is complete only from the date the entry fee is paid. Exceptions allowing payment when collecting the race pack must be approved in advance. International participants may pay when collecting their race pack due to difficulties making payments from abroad. A changing room is provided close to the start and finish. Participants compete at their own risk. Participation includes various competition categories, registration information, water conditions, drafting rules, and accommodation suggestions in the area.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion, with the support of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as a wonderful part of life: taking part is considered a victory, and finishing is a triumph. The event is open to people over 15 and encourages young people and children to participate with their parents’ consent.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promoting health, well-being, and social cohesion
additional: People over 15 may participate in the race. Parental consent is required for minors. The event is organized with the help of volunteers and promotes environmental and social responsibility. Four different routes in mountain areas; participation for ages 15 and over; volunteer involvement; and raising environmental and social awareness.

name: Δρόμος Μάχης Μαραθώνα
location: Μαραθώνας, Δήμος Μαραθώνα, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ανατολικής Αττικής, Ελλάδα
description: The Marathon Battle Road Race is a historic running event organized by the Telmissos Marathon Runners’ Association. The race honors the memory of the Battle of Marathon and offers a unique running experience along a route of historical and natural beauty. Telmissos actively supports the race and invites runners of all levels to take part and run together in Marathon. The event includes accompanying races and group registrations, fostering a spirit of community and sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Historic route in Marathon
Natural scenery with views of Lake Marathon
Accompanying 5- and 10-kilometer races
additional: Telmissos offers group registrations for the Athens Marathon and supports accompanying races and ultramarathons. There is also the option to participate in group training sessions and volunteer. The club’s apparel is available to participants. Routes of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and ultradistance races, with an emphasis on the area’s history and cultural heritage.

name: Ορειβατικός Μαραθώνιος Ολύμπου
description: The Olympus Mountaineering Marathon is a historic race organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Thessaloniki. It is a challenging route across Mount Olympus, offering participants unique natural beauty and challenges. The event includes 5, 15, and 42-kilometer races, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The organizers emphasize athlete safety and support, with aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: 5, 15, and 42-kilometer routes on Mount Olympus
Unique natural scenery and a mountain setting
Aid stations along the route
additional: Athletes who placed first in their category in the previous marathon are eligible for free entry, subject to submitting an application. Payment of fees is facilitated through bank accounts held by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Thessaloniki. Information is available on required equipment, along with suggestions for renting equipment through the club. Races of 5, 15, and 42 kilometers; entry by application; date: 2026-09-06; Litochoro, Pieria.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships

The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course alongside Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and picturesque terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail-running course in the Carpathian Mountains
Picturesque scenery and Transylvanian cultural heritage
Historic location in the town of Râșnov, Romania
additional: The event takes place from 10 to 13 September 2026. The organizers published the first edition of the event program when registration opened. The competition is organized in collaboration with the Local Organizing Committee (LOC). Registration is open, with an early-bird discount available before 10 August 2026. The event includes trail and mountain-running races, with course, rules, and logistics details available in the official event manual.

description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers a unique experience for skyrunning enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging courses of varying lengths. The event attracts runners from around the world, who compete in four distances across beautiful, wild mountain terrain. The organizers provide medical examinations and strict safety rules to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Courses of 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km through Pirin National Park
Mountain terrain with technical sections and scenic views
Checkpoints along the course and staffed aid stations

ITRA points are required to register for the 38 km and 160 km distances. The awards ceremony takes place at the Central Square in Bansko. Transport is arranged for participants in the 25 km distance to the starting point. Registration requires ITRA points for the longer distances; the race includes 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km courses.

name: 20ό Hercules Series
description: The 20th Hercules Series is a series of mountain races held in Ypati, Fthiotida, offering routes of varying distances that cross the most iconic trails of Mount Oiti. The races include challenging routes featuring natural beauty, historic sites, and picturesque villages, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and offers a unique mountain-running experience in a captivating setting.
course_highlights: Routes through the wild trails and fir forests of Oiti
Passage through picturesque villages and alpine meadows
Historic sites and the natural beauty of the area
additional: The event includes multiple distances (1.2K, 7K, 16.7K, 42.6K) and combines natural beauty with historic trails. Support from volunteer groups is available, and group registration is possible. The start and route details are listed on the event’s official pages. The event features races at different distances and offers an opportunity to take part in a local sporting event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail (OUT 100K) is a demanding 101.7-kilometer ultradistance race on Mount Oiti, with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain. The route combines natural and historic trails, passing through mountain villages, dense forests, and Oiti’s highest peak, offering a unique experience that tests the limits of body and mind. The race brings together sport, nature, and history, making it a challenge for mountain-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 101.7-kilometer route with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain
Passes through mountain villages and dense forests
Climb to Oiti’s highest peak
additional: The race is in the UTMB 100K category and awards 4 ITRA points. Volunteers can help at aid stations and at race administration/start. Equipment with a capacity of at least 8 liters is recommended. The race combines hiking and mountain running, with registration through a club. The route follows natural trails and passes through mountain villages, offering an authentic mountain-running experience.

description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three scenic courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an invigorating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 meters of elevation gain across rugged terrain and picturesque ridgelines. The event focuses on the joy of running in nature and supporting environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.
course_highlights: Green Course: 6 km, shady trails, moderate climb, suitable for beginners
Blue Course: 15 km, hills with shady trails and invigorating climbs
Pink Course: 35 km, 1,600 m of elevation gain, rugged terrain and picturesque ridgelines

The start is at Woodrocks, with parking along the road, on the grass where possible. Age categories are 15+ for the Green Course, 16+ for the Blue Course, and 18+ for the Pink Course, with special conditions for minors. Courses feature rugged terrain and forest trails; the start and parking are along the roadside, and registration and kit pickup take place on event day.

description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining picturesque scenery with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, and the organizers promote an active community involved in supporting sport and the environment.
course_highlights: A route through the Dragomirna Beech Forest Reserve, featuring outstanding natural scenery
Various races: marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s races
Professional organization, with race kits and guaranteed prizes

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, environmentally friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run on scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half-marathon, an 8 km cross-country race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Citadel, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.
course_highlights: The 21 km half-marathon route passes through Transylvanian natural landscapes and the authentic atmosphere of the municipality of Aiud
The 8 km cross-country race includes part of the half-marathon route in the Pădurea Poligon area, with panoramic views of the municipality of Aiud
The 2 km family run promotes an active and healthy lifestyle for all ages
additional: Race kits can be collected in the days leading up to the event and on race day at Aiud City Hall and the start area. The official warm-up takes place from 08:30 to 08:50. Fun and educational activities for children are held from 08:00 to 13:00 in the start/finish area. The half-marathon and cross-country race share a start at 09:00 near Aiud Citadel. Routes through nature, registration details, and other information are available on the website; the event takes place in natural and forested areas of Aiud.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: Dragomirna Marathon is an annual running competition held in Mitocu Dragomirnei, Suceava, offering races for all ages and fitness levels, including a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s races. The event promotes sport and the local community, giving participants an enjoyable experience on varied routes with scenic views. The organizers provide participant kits and prizes, and the atmosphere is friendly and motivating for runners. The marathon is supported by ACS Trib and is held in accordance with clear rules to ensure participants’ safety and the smooth running of the competition.
course_highlights: Varied routes for the marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race
Scenic views in the Mitocu Dragomirnei area
Races for children and recreational runners
additional: A participant kit is guaranteed for registrations confirmed by June 30. There are races for children and recreational runners. The event also includes a community and charitable mission, with the involvement of TRIB volunteers. The event features several race categories, with registration details and rules available on the website. Participation is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: Bukovački Marathon – the Long Course is a challenging hiking race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The course is 47.8 km long, with a total elevation gain and loss of 1,350 meters each. It is well maintained and marked with red-and-white hiking trail blazes, and passes significant sites including the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, and Velika Remeta monasteries, as well as Branko’s Grave and monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: 47.8 km course with 1,350 m of elevation gain and loss
Passes the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, and Velika Remeta monasteries
Well-maintained course marked with red-and-white hiking trail blazes
additional: The course was laid out in 2004 and last marked in 2014. The start and finish are in Bukovac, at an elevation of 180 meters. The course takes about 12 hours to complete. It is challenging and intended for experienced hikers. There are checkpoints (KT) along the route. The trail race follows a marked route with checkpoints at attractive locations and is held on the second Saturday in September, starting at 9:30.

name: 8ο Acheloos Run
description: The 8th Acheloos Run is organized by the Oiniades Running Team in Neochori, Messolonghi, and features road races on public roads for all ages. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas alongside the Acheloos River, with flat terrain and historic sites, offering a unique running experience. The finish is near the sea, where runners can enjoy local products and music at a beach party. Volunteers and safety organizations support the event to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Route alongside the calm waters of the Acheloos River
Passes through an environmentally sensitive area and historic villages
Finish near the sea with a beach party and local products
additional: Race packs can be collected at Heroes’ Square in Neochori on Friday, 11 September, and Saturday, 12 September 2026. Participants should be at the start area 45 minutes before the start. Water stations are located at designated distances. The route is supported by volunteers, police, EKAB, and other organizations. Training guidance for runners is available on the official website. The races include 1,000m, 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half-marathon. The start is scheduled for 8:00 a.m. on Sunday, 13 September 2026. The event takes place in a beautiful area close to nature and water, with the aim of promoting sports and social cohesion.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: Oiti Ultra Trail is a challenging 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon held on Mount Oiti, combining natural beauty, history, and endurance. The course includes trails through dense forests, mountain settlements, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering runners a unique experience. The race is part of the events organized by the TRAHINA Fthiotida Runners’ Club and is a UTMB 100K category race with 4 ITRA points. The event connects sport with the nature and history of the region.
course_highlights: 101.7-kilometer course with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain
Passes along historic and natural trails on Mount Oiti
Passes through mountain settlements and over the highest peak of Oiti
additional: The race is a UTMB 100K category race with 4 ITRA points. Volunteers can help at aid stations and with race administration/start operations. The event is supported by local sponsors and co-organizers. Participants receive an OUT medal. Trail running, mountain terrain, high elevation gain, well-marked course, organized aid stations, emphasis on safety and environmental responsibility

description: The Serifos Sunset Race 2026 is a unique sporting event combining running and swimming races on the enchanting island of Serifos, on the weekend of September 12–13, 2026. The routes include 5 km and 10 km running races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach, as well as 750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay. The event offers a unique sunset running experience, ideal for runners and swimmers of all levels. It also provides an opportunity to visit the beautiful island of Serifos and enjoy local activities and hospitality.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach
750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay
A unique sunset running experience on Serifos
additional: The 5 km race starts at 17:50 from Vagia. Lifeguard and rescue coverage is provided. Car and motorcycle rentals are available on the island. Serifos is connected by ferry to Piraeus, Lavrio and other Cyclades islands. Volunteer opportunities are available for the event. The event includes running and swimming races, with detailed information about routes, safety, awards and registration. Events take place at Vagia and Livadi beaches.

Over 600 nature lovers taking part

Participants also take part in plogging activities to clean up the routes. Payment is by card only at registration. Routes are 100% off-road and include forest trails, forest roads, wetlands, reed beds, technical single tracks, and the Măgura Gorgana archaeological site. Event dates: September 12–13, 2026.

name: Patmos ChoRun

The event is organized by the Patmos Gymnastics Club “Stadion” in cooperation with the Municipality of Patmos and the South Aegean Region, under the auspices of the Dodecanese Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS).

The event features various routes and is organized with the support of local authorities and organizations, promoting sport and culture on the island.

name: Hercules Series
description: Hercules Series is a mountain running race series held in Ypati and Oiti on September 12 and 13, 2026. It includes four unique courses of different distances and difficulty levels, as well as a children’s race in Loutra Ypatis. The routes feature demanding climbs and natural beauty, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the mountains. The event is open to everyone and is organized by the Fthiotida Runners’ Club TRACHINA.

name: Arilje TRAIL

The race takes runners through the beautiful landscapes of the Rzav River, Žuta Stena, and the hillsides around Arilje, offering technically demanding sections and unforgettable views. The event brings together runners of all levels, from recreational runners to professionals, and offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and sport.
course_highlights: Courses through dense forests and clear mountain streams

Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

description: OMU Marathon is a 41 km mountain race that climbs to Vf. Omu, the highest point in the Bucegi Mountains, at an elevation of 2,505 m. The route crosses wind-exposed plateaus, dark forests and ancient trails, finishing at Bran Castle and offering an authentic, spectacular mountain experience. The event also includes two shorter races: the 24 km SCARA Skyrace, with over 1,800 m of elevation gain, and the 11 km POARTA Cross, with +/- 420 m of elevation change. All are organised by the Transylvania 100 team. The race promises professional-level support and infrastructure, making for a memorable adventure in the classic Transylvanian landscape.
course_highlights: 41 km route with +/- 3,000 m of elevation change, climbing to Vf. Omu (2,505 m)
Varied mountain trails: exposed plateaus, ancient forests and old trails
Finish at Bran Castle, an iconic landmark and tourist attraction
additional: Registration requires presentation of an identity document. Mandatory equipment includes a race bib with chip, mountain running shoes and a charged mobile phone. For OMU Marathon and SCARA Skyrace, a headlamp, personal cup, water reservoir of at least 1 litre, backpack with waterproof protection, emergency blanket, waterproof hooded jacket, warm long-sleeved clothing and long trousers or suitable combinations are also mandatory. OMU Marathon starts at 08:00, SCARA Skyrace at 09:00 and POARTA Cross at 10:00, all from Bran Castle. Race kits can be collected on Friday and Saturday before the race. Difficult mountain route; mandatory equipment; start and finish at Bran Castle. Registration includes a T-shirt if completed by 15 July 2026.

name: Mogoșa Race
location: Domeniul Mogoșa, Baia Sprie, Maramureș, Romania
price_range: 150-180 ron pentru semimaraton, 50 ron pentru cursa pentru copii
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from a 4 km route open to all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km race, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The competition promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area, in a vibrant, community-focused atmosphere. It is organized by Asociația Baia Mare în Mișcare, which supports physical activity and health in the community.
course_highlights: Varied mountain routes with spectacular views at the foot of the Gutâi Mountains
21 km half marathon with demanding climbs and technical descents
Accessible and engaging 11 km Cros route, ideal for pushing your limits
additional: GPX maps of the routes are available to download. There are also races for children and families (Family Race), as well as an accessible 4 km race for everyone (Mogosa Fun Run). The event is organized by Asociația Baia Mare în Mișcare, which promotes a healthy, active lifestyle. Mountain routes, registration from March to September 2026, multiple race categories, including the fun run and family race.

description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.
course_highlights: 41 km route with +/- 3,000 m elevation gain to Vf Omu (2,505 m)
Trails include windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trackways
Finish at the famous Bran Castle
additional: Mandatory equipment includes race number with chip, suitable mountain running shoes, fully charged mobile phone, and for OMU Marathon and SCARA Skyrace also headtorch, personal cup, water reservoir (min 1L), backpack with waterproof liner, survival foil bag or blanket, waterproof jacket with hood, warm long-sleeved top, and long legged trousers or leggings. Registration and kit pick-up available the day before and on race morning at Bran Castle and Sports Hall in Bran. Participants receive a sports T-shirt if they register by 15 July 2026; the course has mandatory equipment and specific safety rules.

description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green natural oasis of Radmilovac, not far from Belgrade. The race takes runners through orchards, vineyards and fishponds, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category for PhD holders and doctoral students, promoting a healthy lifestyle. The event is organized by the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun and AGRIF runners, and is known for its generous race pack and prizes for the top competitors.
course_highlights: A course through orchards, vineyards and fishponds
The natural oasis of Radmilovac, with Mali Dunav
Close to Belgrade, just 14 km from the city centre
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, electronic timing, an electronic diploma, a finisher’s medal, an eco-friendly multipurpose ceger-zembilj bag and surprises. Parking is provided, and GSP bus routes to the venue are also available. After the race, participants can socialize over food, drinks and music. The field is limited to the 150 fastest runners to register. Trail terrain, medals, T-shirts and event organization services.

name: Soko Čovka trail
description: Soko Čovka Trail is a mountain race held in Lazarevac, Županjac. It is organized by the VIS Mountaineering Club and gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of central Serbia on challenging trails. The race brings together nature and sports enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Lazarevac and Županjac
Mountain terrain with challenging climbs and descents
Views of central Serbia and the surrounding landscapes

name: 1ος Διεθνής Ημιμαραθώνιος «Νικηταράς»
description: The 1st International “Nikitaras 2026” Half Marathon is an off-stadium road race held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli, as part of a three-day series of events in honor of Yiannis Kouros. The race starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli, offering a unique experience for runners wishing to take part in an international half marathon. The event emphasizes safety and course quality, with a limited number of participants to ensure better organization and runners’ well-being.
course_highlights: Starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli
Off-stadium course with varied terrain
Held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli
additional: The race is invitation-only, with a limited number of participants for safety and organizational reasons. The course is mainly hilly, following old paved roads, but also includes dirt roads and trails, where runners are encouraged to bring flashlights in case they pass through at night. Includes a three-day event program, volunteer opportunities, and a route from Ano Doliana to Tripoli.

description: The Ioannina Lake Run is a flat, paved 30-kilometer race around Lake Pamvotida, offering a unique experience amid scenery of natural beauty. It is aimed both at runners trying this distance for the first time and at those seeking strong performances. The start and finish are at Mavili Square in Ioannina, with staggered starts beginning at 8:15 a.m. The event has a long tradition and attracts thousands of runners every year, creating a three-day running festival with races for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Flat, paved 30 km route around Lake Pamvotida
Start and finish at Mavili Square, Ioannina
Scenery of natural beauty with views of the lake and the city
additional: Chips, race bibs, and commemorative items can be collected at Mavili Square on Friday 18/09 (17:00-20:00) and Saturday 19/09 (10:00-21:00). Collection is also available on Sunday before the start, from 7:00 a.m. The start is staggered in groups. The maximum number of participants is 3,000 runners. Runners over 18 years of age are eligible to participate. A medical and cardiac check-up is recommended before taking part. The organizers do not require medical certificates, and runners participate at their own sole responsibility. The course includes 11 aid stations, electronic timing, a commemorative medal, and a finisher’s certificate. There are parallel routes and races for all ages and ability levels, starting and finishing in the heart of the city.

name: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026
description: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026 invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of the Elena Balkan with three challenging distances: 12 km for beginners and speed enthusiasts, with panoramic views; 21 km on a balanced course combining technical sections and impressive scenery; and 33 km, combining the dynamic nature of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, in the town of Elena and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable experiences for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special conditions for taking part.
course_highlights: 12 km – panoramic views, suitable for beginners
21 km – technical forest trails with impressive scenery
33 km – combines the dynamic nature of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route
additional: Participants aged 14 to 18 may take part only in the 12 km race, with written consent from a parent/guardian. Children under 14 may take part in the 12 km race only when accompanied and with a consent declaration from both parents/guardians. Online registration, different categories by age and distance, and a scenic route in the Elena Balkan.

name: XL kmrun - Кремиковци
description: XL kmrun - Kremikovtsi is an organized 5 km run held in Sofia. The event is part of the 5kmrun series, which takes place in several Bulgarian cities and is aimed at runners of all ages and ability levels. The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Semimaraton Brăila
location: Faleza și Parcul Monument, Brăila, Romania
distance_verbose: Semimaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km, 0.6 km
price_range: variază, promoțional până la 05.06.2025 pentru primii 100 înscriși
description: The Brăila Half Marathon is an annual race held along the promenade and in Monument Park in Brăila, offering participants an enjoyable and accessible running experience. The event promotes solidarity by supporting local charitable causes, and runners can turn every kilometre into an act of support for the community. The course is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners, offering an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Brăila in a friendly sporting setting.
course_highlights: Course along the promenade and through Monument Park
Support for local charitable causes
An accessible event for runners of all levels
additional: Entry fees for the Children’s Race are donated in full to charitable causes. Runners can support organisations such as Special Friends Brăila, Alerg pentru Răzvan, Organizația Trebuie! Brăila and Asociația Rotary Club Brăila. Registration is available online, with details on distances, deadlines, fees and donations. The event also includes the Brăila 10K race, with results and further information available on the website and Facebook.

name: Oradea City Running Day

price_tiers.distance: 21 km individual, stafeta firmelor și 10,5 km

description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event held in Oradea, offering running races for all ages and fitness levels. The races include a half marathon, a corporate relay, a 10.5 km race, and a 5 km popular run, all held on an urban route marked with blue arrows that passes through notable areas of the city. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, particularly through the relay race dedicated to company employees. Participants receive starter kits with an electronic chip, and there are refreshment points along the course.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing in Ferdinand Square
Crosses the Centenary Bridge and the promenade alongside the Crișul Repede
Course marked with blue arrows, with multiple laps for the half marathon and 10.5 km race
additional: Starter kits can be collected in Ferdinand Square, next to the Regina Maria Theatre, on Saturday, September 19, between 16:30 and 20:00, and Sunday, September 20, between 8:00 and 9:30. The time limit is 2h50min for the half marathon and 1h25min for the 10.5 km race. The relay is 4x5.2 km, with each participant completing one lap. Registration is not available on race day. Race numbers with electronic chips are used, and there are refreshment points along the course. The route includes the city's streets, bridges, and scenic areas; online registration; kit collection on September 19 and 20; no refunds after payment.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest teambuilding event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a running race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. Organizers Runners Club ensure a friendly, professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.
course_highlights: Urban course through the streets of Cluj-Napoca
Event dedicated to corporate teams for teambuilding
Dynamic, friendly atmosphere supported by Runners Club
additional: The event is part of IndividuALL Running Series and is supported by official partners such as Emerson. Free group training sessions are held regularly for the local running community in Cluj-Napoca. The event includes both individual and team races, with registration limited to 1,300 participants. Race kits can be collected at Cluj Arena from 19–21 September 2026, and include medals, timing, and other services. The course is urban, in the Piața Unirii area, and takes place in conditions suitable for participants of all ages.

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking and a 3x7 km relay, allowing runners of different levels and ages to take part. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a big-hearted city and its generous hosts.
course_highlights: The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, with no major climbs
Three laps through the most beautiful areas of Zrenjanin, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods
Start in front of City Hall in the city center
additional: The events include a 21.1 km half marathon, a 14 km race, a 7 km fun run, 7 km Nordic walking and a 3x7 km relay. Registration is through the trka.rs portal. The organizer provides medical assistance and aid stations along the course at intervals of up to 5 km. Participants take part at their own risk, and written consent is required for underage participants. Different age categories are available, and registration is through the trka.rs portal. The race is known for its good organization and friendly atmosphere.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Διπλός Μαραθώνιος Δρόμος “Γιάννης Κούρος 2026”
organizer: Γιάννης Κούρος – Πέρα από τα όρια
description: The 1st International Double Marathon “Yiannis Kouros 2026” is a demanding ultramarathon of approximately 455 kilometers, starting and finishing in Tripoli. The race crosses varied terrain, mainly hilly, old paved roads, as well as dirt roads and trails. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for the night sections. The time limit is 84 hours, and entry is by invitation, with strict performance criteria. The race is part of a three-day celebratory program honoring Yiannis Kouros and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli.
course_highlights: Approximately 455 kilometers across varied terrain
Mainly hilly, old paved roads, as well as dirt roads and trails
Night sections where a headlamp is recommended
additional: Entry is by invitation, with a limited number of participants and strict performance criteria (for example, mileage requirements from previous 24-hour, 48-hour, or 6-day races). The time limit is 84 hours. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for trails they may run on at night. Participation includes the double marathon, a half marathon, and parallel events. Registration opens by July 2026. The organizers aim to establish the event as a regular fixture and attract runners from around the world.

name: 3ο Dadia Trail Run
location: Δάσος της Δαδιάς, Σουφλί, Έβρος, Greece
description: The 3rd Dadia Trail Run is a mountain race held in the Dadia Forest, in Soufli, Evros, every September since 2024. The race is organized to help regenerate the natural environment and promote mass participation in sports, inspired by the message that hope can be reborn from the ashes. The event is supported by the «ORAMA» Authentic Athens Marathon Runners’ Group and retired General Charalambos Lalousis, Honorary Chief of the Hellenic Army General Staff, who has a special connection to the area. The race invites everyone to take an active part in the effort to regenerate the forest and life.
course_highlights: Route through the Dadia Forest
Natural environment of particular ecological importance
Mountain race with a strong focus on regeneration and environmental awareness
additional: The race promotes environmental awareness and the local community, welcoming runners of all levels. The event includes different routes and showcases the area’s natural beauty.

name: 9ο Lesvos Trail
description: The 9th Lesvos Trail is a mountain race held in Lepetymnos, Lesvos, offering 15 km, 6 km and 1 km routes. The routes cross the Lepetymnos mountain range and pass through agricultural and livestock-farming areas, combining natural beauty with local character. The event is supported by the Molyvos Tourism Board and has been moved to an autumn date because of restrictions in the area. The race is ideal for runners seeking a trail-running experience in a warm but beautiful setting.
course_highlights: 15 km, 6 km and 1 km routes in mountainous terrain
Passage through agricultural and livestock-farming areas
Routes shaped by the landscape and local restrictions
additional: The event was moved from its original spring date to September because of measures related to foot-and-mouth disease. September weather is warm, with an average temperature of 31°C and a low of 18°C, and average rainfall of 30 mm. The event was moved from spring because of restrictions related to the disease, with an emphasis on local nature and an authentic island experience.

name: 10ο Lailias Mountain Running
description: The 10th Lailias Mountain Running race will be held on September 20, 2026, at the Lailias Ski Center near Serres. This mountain running event features two courses, 6Km and 21Km, giving runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural pine forest and unexplored trails of Lailias. The race is intended for both beginners and more experienced runners, with 200m and 1350m of elevation gain respectively, offering a unique mountain running experience in a magnificent setting.
course_highlights: 6Km course with 200m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
21Km course with 1350m of elevation gain on unexplored trails
Natural pine forest and magnificent scenery in the Lailias mountain range
additional: Registration opens from 01/06/2026. A volunteer registration form is available. The 6Km course is intended for newcomers to mountain running. Water and isotonic drink aid stations are available along the 6Km course. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, and closes on September 13, 2026. The event also includes other categories, such as races for children and different difficulty levels.

description: Run Greece Trikala 2026 is a running event offering 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a power-walking event and races for children and families. The event prioritizes runner safety and support, with aid stations and medical coverage. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. Runners who complete the 10 km race receive a medal and a certificate of participation. The event is an opportunity for athletic activity and community participation in the city of Trikala.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes, plus power walking
Races for children and families (Family Run)
Support stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Registration for the 10 km race includes a race number with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher medal, a certificate of participation with times, a race T-shirt, support services, and medical coverage. Registration closes no later than 3 days before the race, or earlier if the participant limits are reached. The entry fee can be paid by card only. Cancellations and refunds are not accepted. The children's races cover approximately 600 meters, are untimed, and are intended for students in grades 4, 5, and 6 (born 2015–2017). Participation is free and includes registration and collection of race materials.

description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event where participants cross the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge taking place throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with varied distances, some reaching thousands of kilometres. The event emphasises community spirit and supporting causes, and offers a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.
course_highlights: Virtual routes ranging from 300 km to over 6,000 km
The option to take part in multiple sports and combinations (duathlon, triathlon)
Event running throughout 2026, with online progress tracking
additional: The event is virtual and non-competitive, with the option to participate individually or in teams. Participants can choose multiple sports and routes, and their progress is tracked online on the website platform. A finisher medal is awarded to everyone who completes the challenge. Registration is open until 31 August 2026. The event includes an element of surprise and challenge, and is intended for runners seeking unique experiences and a fresh way to test their limits.

name: Thessaloniki Stage Run
location: Seich Sou Forest, Thessaloniki, Central Macedonia, Greece
description: The Thessaloniki Stage Run is a multi-stage race in the Seich Sou suburban forest in Thessaloniki, designed for runners of all levels. It consists of three race stages: a 15 km night race, a challenging 40 km race, and a fast 25 km race, offering a complete trail-running experience. The organizers encourage participants to run all three stages to fully enjoy the journey through the forest. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and atmosphere against the backdrop of the city lights.
course_highlights: 15 km night race with 500 m of positive elevation gain
40 km race with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, challenging and technical
Fast 25 km race with 1,200 m of positive elevation gain on forest trails
additional: Athletes can cancel their entry by August 20 and receive a 50% refund. No refunds are available after this date. Post-finish snacks, aid at the stations, a commemorative gift, and a medal are provided. Participants are advised to carry a small backpack with solid food and a suitable container for liquids. The finish time limits are the same for all races, and athletes who finish after the cutoff are recorded as having abandoned (DNF). The event includes multiple routes, with registration information available on the website.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place at the end of September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and earns points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.
course_highlights: Routes cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains
Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Aid stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, and Rhodope specialties
additional: The entry pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts. A medical examination before participation is mandatory. Medical assistance and mountain insurance are provided. Aid stations offer water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The course has minimal asphalt sections. Electronic timing of results. Information about accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photography and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, highlighting nature, history, and adventure, while supporting environmental causes.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gain; all qualify for the UTMB Index and earn points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the fairytale-like Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 13 to 100 km through the Rhodope Mountains
Total positive elevation gain of up to 4,170 m on the 100 km course
UTMB Index-qualifying race with marked and secured routes
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, gifts, and a special surprise. Medical examinations are mandatory and are conducted on site at no extra cost. Aid stations offer water, hot and refreshing drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides mountain insurance and medical assistance during the race. A medical certificate is not required; participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, transport to the start points is provided, the event supports green initiatives, and it is well organized.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive long-distance race of 10.25 km and a short 2023-meter distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining seaside scenery with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.
course_highlights: Long-distance 10.25 km course along the Black Sea beach
Short 2023-meter distance for beginners
Return on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake
additional: In the days before the race, “Children’s Athletics” activities are held to recruit new talents for the Atlet 2004 athletics club in Pomorie. The course includes running along the Black Sea beach and returning on the dirt road beside Pomorie Lake; distances are 10.25 km and 2023 m for beginners.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: The Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Ramparts Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The courses combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them suitable for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A spectacular mountain course starting and finishing at the Porolissum Roman Camp
Natural scenery and historical features along the course
Three races suited to different fitness levels and ages
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, September 25, 2026, between 15:00 and 20:00 at the sports hall of Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, 2026, between 07:30 and 11:30 in the start area at the amphitheater in the Porolissum Roman Camp. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, the 12 km race at 10:15, and the 1.6 km race at 13:00. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule up to September 20, 2026. The event also includes the 23 km race, with special conditions for minor participants, and is expected to take place in temperatures of 16–18°C. Rules for multiple races and details about registration and participants’ responsibilities are provided.

organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)

description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual trail running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Mureș Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes (ASCOTID). The courses include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a social and health-focused purpose.
course_highlights: Trail course in the Cornești Plateau area, the highest point in the city
Approximately 584 m of elevation gain for the half marathon and 256 m for the cross-country race
Various events: 21 km half marathon, 10 km race, 5 km race, and races for children and families
additional: Online registration is open until 14 September 2026. After this date, registration is available only on the day before or on race day, without a participation kit. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer, and registration is validated within 3 working days after payment is confirmed. Participants may transfer their place to another competitor if they withdraw. Changing events is possible for an additional fee of 50 lei until 16 September 2026. The children’s and family events have short distances and adjusted time limits. Online registration is open until 15 September 2024, with on-site registration possible after that date; the event includes several race categories, and details about fees and registration procedures are available on the website.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charitable sporting competition held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, in the Sucevița area. The event aims to support palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of people going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately challenging races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The routes offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests of Bucovina, with views of the Sucevița Valley and the monastery
Steep climbs on Dealul Furcoi, continuing along the Obcina ridge
Checkpoints, hydration, and food stations along the route
additional: The event offers three races: 20 km, 9 km, and a children’s race. The routes are moderately challenging, with checkpoints and hydration stations. The time limit for the 9 km race is 2.5 hours. Participants are encouraged to run regardless of experience, and registration closes 4 days before the event. A closing ceremony is organized for all participants. Participation includes multiple race distances, online registration, and a festive closing event with music and traditional food.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
location: Alba Carolina, Alba Iulia, Alba County, Romania
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a running community. The event is a festival of running, combining a passion for sport with exploration and appreciation of local values. The organizers focus on providing a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through the Alba Carolina Citadel, a restored and iconic historic monument
Star Transmission Half Marathon (21 km) and Star Assembly Cross-Country Race (11 km)
Support stations along the route with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: The race kit includes a personalized race bib, a personalized technical shirt for the main races and a cotton shirt for the Family Run, electronic chip timing, hydration stations along the route, a refreshment pack at the finish, metal and wooden finisher medals, cash and equipment prizes, official photographs, a DJ at the event, surprise prize drawings, an ambulance for emergencies, and a post-race recovery workout. Multiple race distances are offered, including a half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, a 2.7 km Family Run, and a Kids Race; the event includes activities promoting health and tourist exploration of the city and the Alba Carolina Citadel.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
location: Castrul Roman Porolissum, Moigrad, Sălaj, Romania
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, welcoming both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race-kit pickup available in the days before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: A spectacular course starting and finishing at the Porolissum Roman Fort
Mountain running amid historic and natural scenery
Multiple races: 23 km, 12 km, and 1.6 km for different levels of fitness
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, September 25, from 15:00 to 20:00 at the Sports Hall of Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, from 07:30 to 11:30 in the start area at the Amphitheatre in the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, followed by the 12 km and 1.6 km races. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule until September 20, 2026. The event includes multiple race categories, with registration information and rules available on the official website.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: a marathon, a half marathon, and a cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, combining physical challenges with storybook scenery and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and refreshment stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.
course_highlights: The marathon route passes through the Plaiului Gorges Geological Reserve and Huda lui Papară Cave
The half marathon includes the steep climb up Piatra Secuiului and a section along Creasta de Cocoș
The cross-country race offers an accessible mountain experience, with peaceful scenery in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif
additional: Registration is free for people with disabilities. Places are limited: 100 for the marathon, 250 for the half marathon, and 200 for the cross-country race. Race kits are distributed in Cluj-Napoca and Rimetea in the days before the race. There are technical briefings for each event before the start. Medals are awarded only to those who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the raffle held after the awards ceremony; attendance is required for the draw. Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes, mountain and cultural scenery, event in September 2026
