description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sports and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the area’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packets can be collected until 11:00.
course_highlights: The course runs through Župa’s vineyards and gentle slopes
Views of the surrounding mountains of Kopaonik, Željin, Goč, and Jastrebac
Passes by the medieval town of Koznik
additional: The entry fee includes tastings at the aid stations and mini fair, an official race T-shirt, a race bib, a finisher’s medal, a gift bag, a souvenir, and catering at the aid stations and finish. Race packets can be collected until 11:00 on race day. Participation includes tastings, a race T-shirt, a medal, souvenirs, and catering. Registration is available online until August 31, 2026. The event takes place among the vineyards and natural scenery of Župa, with the race starting at 12:00 and race packets available for collection until 11:00.

name: 44ο Σπάρταθλον
description: The Spartathlon is a historic and extremely demanding ultramarathon race from Athens to Sparta, retracing the steps of the ancient runner Pheidippides. The course covers approximately 246 kilometers over varied terrain, from flat sections to steep climbs and descents, with elevation reaching up to 1,200 meters. The race starts at 07:00 on the morning of September 26, 2026, and lasts up to 36 hours, with strict time limits at checkpoints. It is intended for experienced, well-prepared runners who meet specific performance standards in previous ultradistance races.
course_highlights: A 246 km route from Athens to Sparta, with climbs reaching up to 1,200 meters
Traverses country roads, trails, vineyards, and olive groves
Aid stations every 3–5 km providing food, water, and medical support
additional: The race is held under strict medical and police supervision, with doctors, physiotherapists, and ambulances available throughout. There are time limits at every checkpoint, and runners who fail to meet them are disqualified. Participation requires official acceptance by the International Spartathlon Association and full acceptance of the race conditions. Applicants must have prior ultramarathon experience. Registration runs from January 25 to February 25, 2026. The race will take place on September 26, 2026.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run of the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.
course_highlights: International route between Ruse and Giurgiu
Road course with scenic views
Race promoting friendship between Bulgaria and Romania

description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and Arena Națională. The race runs in one direction, with no turns, along some of the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheering points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km course measured and certified by World Athletics
Start at Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and finish at Arena Națională
Refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5
additional: Race kits can be collected at Running Expo, Arena Națională, VIP terrace, on Friday 19 September from 16:00 to 20:00, Saturday 20 September from 10:00 to 20:00, and on Sunday 21 September in the morning for participants from outside Bucharest/Ilfov. The complete kit includes a technical T-shirt, products and services from partners, a finisher medal, and the opportunity to be included in the rankings and prize awards. The course has refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5, offering water, isotonic drinks, fruit and glucose. The minimum age for participation is 14; minors must be accompanied by an adult. The event includes social causes, volunteering opportunities, and distribution of the race kit at the finish. The course is prepared with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation and taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition; it is a call to action for exercise and community involvement.
course_highlights: Course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium
Passes through Crâng Park and along the city’s main boulevards and streets
A vibrant event in the heart of Buzău
additional: The Sport Expo for race-kit collection takes place on Saturday, September 26, from 10:00 to 20:00. There is a time limit for completing the first lap of the 21k race, with a cutoff time of 10:30. The awards ceremony takes place from 14:00 to 15:00 on race day. The event includes children’s races and activities promoting health and community involvement.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba na Rajcu is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk tradition.
course_highlights: Hand-mowing grass on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters
Mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire
International team competition in hand-mowing grass
additional: The competition takes place on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters, which the mowers cut in two swaths. Mowing is judged on speed and quality, and the winner receives an award. Mowers must bring their own mowing equipment and wear the required traditional attire. The program also includes an exhibition of tools, folk performances, and a concert by a brass band. Events include traditional activities, hiking tours, and trail-marking courses, with a focus on preserving and promoting the natural and cultural values of Rajac.

name: Ainos Mountain Marathon
description: The Ainos Mountain Marathon is a challenging mountain marathon held on Mount Ainos in Kefalonia. The 40.5-kilometer course crosses mountainous terrain on technical trails, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 meters, and offers panoramic views of the surrounding islands and the mountains of central Greece and the Peloponnese. There are also a 23.5 km half marathon and an 11.1 km trail race, starting from the village of Pyrgi. The event provides bus transfers for athletes, free post-race food, and special offers on ferry tickets and accommodation.
course_highlights: 40.5 km course with 2,500 m of elevation gain
Passes Megas Soros summit (1,628 m), with panoramic sea views for 8.5 km
Technical trails and challenging mountain terrain
additional: Athletes are transported by bus from Poros and Pyrgi to the start. Free food is provided after the race with a special card. The following day, free transport and a guided tour of the Melissani and Drogarati caves are offered. A pasta party is held on the evening before the race. Special offers are available on ferry tickets, and free accommodation is offered to the first 50 athletes. The race features technical trails and challenging terrain, and offers entry packages with discounts and benefits, as well as pre- and post-race events such as a pasta party and tours of the area.

Children’s races and a Family Run for the whole family
Medical coverage and volunteer support along the entire course

description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the town of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. Following its successful hosting of the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses in Central Balkan National Park, with its extensive network of hiking trails
Distances with significant elevation gain: Vertical Kilometer (3.8 km / 830 m D+), 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Scenic views and challenging terrain, including mountain peaks and the Balkan Range ridge
additional: From 05.01.26 to 31.01.26 inclusive, there is a 10% discount on registration with promo code "BALKANIADA10". The event has several start times for the different distances on 4 October 2026 in the town of Karlovo. Registration is through the Tracksport.live system. description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional event held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women and young athletes, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Course in Varna’s Sea Garden
Various distances for men, women and young athletes
Participation by leading Bulgarian runners and clubs
additional: Held in the Sea Garden; various distances for men, women, junior men and junior women; results for different age groups

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race, where each 6.7 km lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour. Participants start running at the top of every hour, and those who fail to finish in time or withdraw are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing competitors’ physical and mental limits. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that brings sport, community, and nature together.
course_highlights: Set course of 6.7 km per lap
Each lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour
Immediate elimination for finishing late or withdrawing
additional: The race is run in hourly laps, with each lap starting at the next fixed hour after the previous one ends. It is a test of mental and physical endurance, where the opponent is time, the course, and your own mind. The event includes distances such as 12.5 km, 24 km, 44 km, and 103 km, promoting solidarity and respect for nature.

description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain-running race in Bucovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two moderately difficult races, 12 km and 22 km, on routes consisting mainly of mountain trails, with sections through forests and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița ski slope, and the route reaches Vârful Diecilor at an elevation of 1,301 meters. Participants must be prepared for nighttime mountain running and bring suitable equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: Moderately difficult route with 95–100% mountain trail
80% forest and 20% open meadows on both races
The route reaches Vârful Diecilor, elevation 1,301 m
additional: Participants must carry a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and a headlamp with spare batteries. Equipment for adverse weather conditions is required, such as a long-sleeved shirt or waterproof shell. There are hydration points and two feeding points, at the start and at Vârful Diecilor. Medical assistance is provided by mountain rescuers; no ambulance is stationed at the start/finish. The entry fee is non-refundable in the event of withdrawal. Registration is valid once payment has been confirmed. Minors must provide a statement from a parent or guardian. Mountain, nighttime, hydration and feeding points, mountain rescue assistance, strict participation rules.

name: Harvest Run

The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and recreational or experienced runners. Each edition supports social causes, turning running into an act of solidarity and support for the community. Participants enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with courses suited to all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Varied courses: half marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and children’s races
An event for all ages, from 6-year-olds to adults and families
Location in Vladimirescu, Arad, with an active community and support for social causes
additional: The community gathers every Tuesday at 19:00 for group training at Harvest Arad Church. The event supports social and educational projects, including initiatives for children and teenagers from disadvantaged backgrounds. It includes various race categories and has a charitable purpose, supporting social and community causes.

The course starts in the area around the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience with a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, ensuring it runs smoothly and provides facilities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

Accessible, well-marked urban course in Cluj-Napoca
Friendly atmosphere and support from the local running community
additional: Race kits are distributed at the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall, side entrance facing the tram line. Video footage of the previous edition is available to give you a sense of the atmosphere and course. The event is part of the IndividuALL Running Series and is supported by official sponsors and partners. description: The 2nd Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-distance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, Phthiotis. Participants run a 6.706-meter loop, with a start every hour for those who continue, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, fair play, and environmental protection, offering an experience that combines natural beauty and endurance. The start and finish are in Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: A 6.706-meter loop over mixed terrain (asphalt, paved sections, dirt roads, and trails)
Approximately 90 meters of elevation gain, with uphill and downhill sections
Passes the newly built chapel of Saint Paisios and follows a 3-kilometer forest road
additional: The race takes place in a sensitive environment, with strict adherence to nature-protection rules. Athletes run a loop, with a start every hour for those still in the race. The route is available for download in GPX format for use on GPS watches. The race includes rules, route information, and results, with participants from various runners and detailed data on the official website.

name: 27ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Νεάπολης Αγρινίου
description: The 27th Neapoli Agrinio Popular Road Race is a traditional road race held in the beautiful area of Neapoli, Aetolia-Acarnania. The race covers approximately 10 kilometers and offers an enjoyable route for runners of all levels. The welcoming event aims to promote sports and the local community. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event focused on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 9.7 kilometers in the Neapoli Agrinio area
An enjoyable urban and semi-urban setting
Suitable for runners of all levels
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, with a 9.7-kilometer road race, and is one of the area's most important local sporting events.

name: MakrakomiBackyardUltra
description: The Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a demanding ultradistance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, West Phthiotis. Participants are asked to run a 6,706-meter loop every hour, with a new start for the remaining athletes, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, culture, and environmental protection, offering a unique experience in a natural and environmentally sensitive setting. The start and finish are at Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.

Approximately 90 meters of elevation gain across uphill and downhill sections

The race consists of 6,706-meter laps, emphasizing environmental sensitivity and runners’ endurance.

The race features teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km by completing two laps of the flat 2 km course. 2 km lap, completed twice by each participant
Relay race with teams of 4

Corporate relay race, team building, online registration, charitable initiatives, prizes and certificates for companies.

description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure, with courses passing through beautiful Bulgarian countryside from the village of Neofit Rilski to Ovech Fortress. The races include running and cycling over various distances, starting and finishing at Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with varying elevation gain and cut-off times, suitable for different levels of fitness. A children’s run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature lovers looking for a serious challenge and adventure.
course_highlights: Courses with total elevation gain and loss of up to 870 meters
Start and finish at Historical Park
A variety of running and cycling distances: 42 km, 25 km, 13 km, and a children’s run
additional: A 700 m children’s run with treats for all children. Cut-off times for the different distances range from 2 to 7 hours. Mandatory equipment and participation declarations are required. All finishers receive a unique medal. Online registration, checkpoints, GPX tracks, medical support, and aid stations along the course. The start is at 9:00, the awards ceremony begins at 14:30, and the event closes at 17:00.

name: Brașov Running Festival
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an energetic atmosphere filled with music and fun. The festival features a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and children’s races to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of the Tractorul district in Brașov and offers a complete experience, with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.
course_highlights: tRUNsylvania 10K — the flagship race, certified with a World Athletics Elite Label
A variety of races: 5K Open, Wheelchair Race 5K, Kids Races, Fun Race 3K, Trail to Road
Cheering zones with live performances along the course
additional: Spectators can attend free of charge throughout the event. The tRUNsylvania 10K is broadcast live on national TV channels and online. All participants receive the official race shirt provided by technical sponsor Joma. A cloakroom is available for personal belongings, but bulky items are not accepted. Race bibs are personal and must be worn throughout the race. Includes an earlier 5 km race during the day, with courses of approximately 3.5 km in the Tractorul district of Brașov.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
location: Bd. V. Pârvan 4, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to the full marathon of 42 km. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.
course_highlights: A full 42 km marathon course for experienced runners
A 21 km half marathon for those ready to take on half the challenge
Fun runs and children’s races, with distances from 200 m to 1 km
additional: The event includes races for all ages and experience levels, with age categories from 4 years old through adulthood. Facilities include checkpoints, medical staff, and portable toilets. Training programs are available for the 5, 10.5, 21, and 42 km distances, created by an experienced university coach. The maximum time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 3 hours for the half marathon. Participants can choose from several distances, including the marathon, half marathon, relay, and children’s races; the event promotes freedom and health in the community; registration and race details are available on the official website.

description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual Cross Country running competition held in the Breazu area, Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry cabin in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, and forest and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents, and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sport and supports local social causes, offering a chance for runners to enjoy themselves and meet fellow enthusiasts. The half-marathon distance and the other races suit different training levels, and event arrangements include water stations and course marshals.
course_highlights: Courses combining forest roads, meadows, and agricultural roads
Varied terrain with flat sections, descents, and climbs
Water stations at km 3, 5, and 8.5, used twice for the half-marathon
additional: The courses are monitored by marshals and photographers, and traffic is not closed. The event supports local social causes through voluntary donations. Warming up before running is recommended. There are checkpoints 200 m from the start/finish for all races. Forest and meadow courses, Cross Country race, social involvement, promotion of nature and a healthy lifestyle

name: Γύρος Λιμνοθάλασσας Αιτωλικού
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Αιτωλικού, Αιτωλικό, Μεσολόγγι, Ελλάδα
organizer: Αθλητικός και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Αιτωλικού
description: The Aitoliko Lagoon Circuit is an established road race held every September and organized by the Aitoliko Runners’ Athletic and Cultural Association. The race takes place in the beautiful town of Aitoliko, known as the Little Venice of Greece. Its route circles the lagoon, offering unique natural beauty and an enjoyable sporting experience. Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with many children in shorter races. The event combines sport and culture, with activities held at Aitoliko’s Eastern Beach, creating a celebration for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: A route around the Aitoliko Lagoon, surrounded by natural scenery and beautiful landscapes
Passes over two stone arch bridges, each approximately 300 meters long
The town of Aitoliko, known as the Little Venice of Greece, with waters and a small island in the center of the lagoon
additional: Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with a large number of children in a 1,000-meter race. The events are held at Aitoliko’s Eastern Beach, combining sport and culture on a nonprofit basis. Routes by the lake and beach, registration through the official site, high-standard events with medical coverage, around 500 participating athletes, and an awards ceremony.

description: The 1st Salamina Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new series of road races combining Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The routes pass along ancient paths and through natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience that honors the country’s rich cultural heritage. The race is open to runners of all levels and promotes health, well-being, and social connection. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 5-kilometer and 1-kilometer races for children, as well as races for people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Routes along ancient paths and through natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Race amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic participation certificate, course and finish-line refreshments, medical support, baggage storage, and changing facilities. The organizers provide transportation for athletes who wish to use it. Participation in the 1,000-meter race is free for students from primary, middle, and high schools when registered as a group through their school and in coordination with the organizer. The event includes various routes and cultural elements, with the date and details to be officially announced. It is expected to attract runners from across Greece and abroad.

name: 4ο Γόμφοι Trail
description: The 4th Gomfoi Trail semi-mountain race, “On the Paths of Our Ancestors,” will take place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in the area of Gomfoi, Trikala. This unique event features two semi-mountain courses starting and finishing in Gomfoi’s central square, following trails, forest roads, and rural roads at the foothills of Mount Itamos and across the Thessalian plain. The race aims to showcase the area’s natural beauty and historical heritage, while promoting sports tourism and fair play.
course_highlights: Routes at the foothills of Mount Itamos and in the Pindus mountain range
Trails, forest roads, and rural roads
Water and refreshment stations along the routes
additional: Runners must be at Gomfoi’s central square by 08:00 a.m. The longer course has a time limit of 3 hours, and the shorter course has a limit of 1.5 hours. There are 4 refreshment and water stations on the longer course and 1 on the shorter course. Participants collect a timing chip, race number, and commemorative items on the Saturday before the race or on race day up to one hour before the start. Routes follow trails, forest roads, and rural roads, with a race for all ages and voluntary participation.

name: 5ο Armeno Gate Trail Race
description: The 5th Armeno Gate Trail Race is a mountain race held in the Karystos area of Evia. It is a local event supported by the Armeno Gate Trail Organizing Committee, with Ultra Effort Coaching and Chalkida Sports Academy as co-organizers. The race offers an authentic mountain-running experience, ideal for runners seeking routes in a natural setting. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia. October weather is usually cool and favorable for races.
course_highlights: Mountain race in the Karystos area
Natural setting with a local character
5 km, 12.5 km and 20 km routes
additional: October weather is usually cool, with temperatures from 13°C to 25°C and average rainfall of 35 mm, making it ideal for mountain-running races. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia, with an emphasis on the local community and mountain nature. No specific entry-fee information is available.

name: Spetses Mini Marathon
description: The Spetses Mini Marathon is Greece’s largest multi-sport event, held on the beautiful island of Spetses. It features running and swimming races for all ages and levels, with a participation medal for everyone and awards by age group. The courses offer unique experiences, with refreshment stations and beautiful scenery, while the organizers take care of athletes’ comfort and safety. The event attracts runners and swimmers from around the world, offering a celebration of sport and culture.
course_highlights: 5K, 10K, and 25K running courses with refreshment stations at various points
1.5K and 3K swimming races with refreshment stations
Children’s races with separate awards and participation medals
additional: All participants receive a participation medal, and age-group awards are presented. Participants must be at least 12 years old for the shorter races and at least 18 years old for the longer races. Refreshment stations are located at specific kilometer points along each course. Race registration is open from October 1 to 5 at specific times. Participants receive a 30% discount on ferry tickets. The island has a Mediterranean climate, with ideal weather conditions in October. Private cars are not allowed on the island, but parking is available at Costa, with ferry services and water taxis for transfers. Over the three-day period from October 2–4, 2026, the event includes running and swimming races, as well as activities for families and visitors.

name: Run Greece Piraeus
description: Run Greece Piraeus 2026 offers a unique road-running experience in the heart of Piraeus, with routes suitable for runners of all levels. It includes 10 km and 5 km races, a dynamic walking event, a children’s race, and a family run. The event welcomes everyone, promoting sport and social participation in a beautiful urban setting. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with electronic timing and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: Urban route in Piraeus
10 km and 5 km routes, children’s race, and Family Run
Electronic timing for all races
additional: Registration closes no later than 3 days before the race. Electronic timing and race-number collection are provided. Medical support is available, along with information about personal data protection. The entry fee for the 5 km race is 15 euros and includes a race number, results, services, and a certificate. Participation is open to people over 12 years old, with discounts for specific groups and age categories.

name: IRAKLEIOS ATHLOS
description: HERAKLEIOS ATHLOS is a mountain running race held on Mount Erymanthos, in the Micha-Tsapournia area of the Municipality of Erymanthos, Achaia. It includes three courses: 21 km, 9 km, and a 2 km children’s race. The varied terrain includes fir forest, alpine zone, and forest dirt roads. The race combines athletic challenge with connection to nature and environmental awareness, promoting the protection of the Erymanthos ecosystem. The event provides electronic timing, medical coverage, refreshments, medals, and technical T-shirts for participants in the longer courses.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 1,800 m of positive elevation gain; 42% fir forest and 55% alpine zone
9 km course with 700 m of positive elevation gain; 70% fir forest
2 km children’s course through safe fir forest for ages 5–17
additional: The event provides electronic timing, refreshments, medical coverage and rescue teams, a post-race meal, a prize draw, a commemorative medal, and a technical T-shirt for participants in the 9 km and 21 km races. Age and gender categories are offered, with trophy presentations. Athletes participate at their own risk. A medical certificate or a guardian’s declaration of responsibility is required for children. Courses: 21 km and 9 km, plus 2 km children’s races; elevation gain of up to 1,800 m; routes through fir forest and alpine zone. A declaration or medical certificate is required. Awards are presented to the top men and women.

name: Xeskouriazo Trail
description: The ΞεΣκουριάΖω mountain running race has been organized since 2013 by the Women’s Association of Megali Panagia on Mount Kakavos in Halkidiki. Dedicated to environmental protection and opposition to gold-copper mining, the race promotes trail running and showcases the area’s natural beauty. The courses start and finish at Chorostasi Square in Megali Panagia and offer a unique mountain experience with significant elevation gain. The race welcomes athletes from across Greece and aims to keep the mountains alive and protected.
course_highlights: 25 km course with 1,200 m of elevation gain on Mount Kakavos
15 km course with 625 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Chorostasi Square in Megali Panagia
additional: Aid stations at various kilometres provide electrolytes, water, dried fruit and snacks. Bringing your own cup or bottle is recommended to avoid plastic. A race pack and bib number are provided. Camping is available for athletes and visitors. Registration is also possible on race day until 9:00 a.m., subject to availability. The event includes different difficulty levels and awareness-raising activities, and supports the local community and the environment.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλμυρού «Δίδυμες Μετεωρίτικες Λίμνες Ζερέλια»
A³ Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Стара Загора, Стара Загора парк Аязмото

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races on mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains and connecting the area’s 39 hamlets. It is one of the region’s first mountain marathons, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid spectacular natural scenery. The event is for runners passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connects 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) distances
additional: The routes pass through scenic areas and may include varied mountain terrain; registration details are not specified

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: The Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for runners of all levels. The courses include the full marathon of 42 km, the half marathon of 21 km, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course passing important landmarks of the capital, with hydration and support points along the way.
course_highlights: Urban course through Bucharest’s iconic landmarks
A variety of races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, popular race, and 4x relay
Start and finish in Constitution Square
additional: Race kits are collected before the race at the designated location. The event includes hydration points and medical support along the course. Pacemakers are available for the main races. After the race, participants receive prizes and medals. The organizers support charitable causes through the registration of partner NGOs. The event includes charitable partnerships, exhibitions, and prizes for winners, with details about registration and kit collection available on the official website.

description: B2Run Athens 2026 is a corporate 5-kilometer running event held at the iconic Olympic Stadium at OAKA. More than 2,000 runners from various industries take part wearing their company colors, strengthening team spirit and cooperation among colleagues. After the race, a lively after-run party follows, with live music, a DJ, food, and an awards ceremony, making B2Run a unique experience combining sport and entertainment for the corporate world.
course_highlights: 5 kilometers inside the Olympic Stadium at OAKA
Start and finish inside the iconic stadium
Lively after-run party with live music and a Street Food Festival
additional: Participants receive a race bib with an electronic timing chip, a finisher's medal, and a backpack with gifts. Support stations and medical services are available during the race. After the race, a party is held featuring live music, a DJ set, a Street Food Festival, and an awards ceremony. Parking is provided for private vehicles and buses. Arrivals begin at 16:00, and the race starts at 18:00. Teams have a Team Captain who coordinates and encourages their members. The event includes a 5K race, a post-race food festival, team activities, and the option of space in tents.
